    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [overlayView]);

'use client';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { NotificationBell } from '@/components/notifications/notification-bell';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useShell } from './shell-context';
const PAGE_TITLES: Record<string, string> = {
  '/': 'Dashboard',
  '/inbox': 'Inbox',
  '/voice': 'Voice',
  '/schedule': 'Schedule',
  '/templates': 'Templates',
  '/contacts': 'Contacts',
  '/integrations': 'Integrations',
  // Config
  '/config/agents': 'AI Agent',
  '/config/funnel': 'Funnel',
  '/config/sequences': 'Follow-up Sequences',
  '/config/webhooks': 'Webhooks',
  '/config/channels': 'Channels',
  '/config/communications': 'Communications',
  '/config/payments': 'Payments',
  // Admin
  '/admin': 'Admin Panel',
  '/admin/team': 'Team',
  '/admin/billing': 'Billing',
  '/admin/api-keys': 'API Keys',
  '/admin/demo': 'Demo Requests',
  // Platform
  '/platform/demo-accounts': 'Demo Accounts',
};
const DETAIL_TITLES: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [
  [/^\/contacts\/[^/]+$/, 'Contact details'],
  [/^\/voice\/[^/]+$/, 'Call details'],
];
function getPageTitle(pathname: string): string {
  const exact = PAGE_TITLES[pathname];
  if (exact) return exact;
  const detail = DETAIL_TITLES.find(([pattern]) => pattern.test(pathname));
  if (detail) return detail[1];
  const parent = Object.keys(PAGE_TITLES)
    .filter((route) => route !== '/' && pathname.startsWith(route + '/'))
    .sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)[0];
  return parent ? PAGE_TITLES[parent] : 'CRM';
}
export function Header() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { user, signOut } = useAuth();
  const { data: currentUser } = useCurrentUser();
  const { setMobileNavOpen } = useShell();

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  Command,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandInput,
  CommandItem,
  CommandList,
} from '@/components/ui/command';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  LayoutDashboard, MessageSquare, Users, Calendar, Bot, Plug, Settings,
} from 'lucide-react';
const navItems = [
  { label: 'Dashboard', href: '/', icon: <LayoutDashboard className="h-4 w-4" /> },
  { label: 'Inbox', href: '/inbox', icon: <MessageSquare className="h-4 w-4" /> },
  { label: 'Contacts', href: '/contacts', icon: <Users className="h-4 w-4" /> },
  { label: 'Schedule', href: '/schedule', icon: <Calendar className="h-4 w-4" /> },
  { label: 'AI Agents', href: '/config/agents', icon: <Bot className="h-4 w-4" /> },
  { label: 'Integrations', href: '/integrations', icon: <Plug className="h-4 w-4" /> },
  { label: 'Settings', href: '/admin', icon: <Settings className="h-4 w-4" /> },
];
export function CommandPalette() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setOpen((o) => !o);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handler);
  }, []);
  const navigate = (href: string) => {
    router.push(href);
    setOpen(false);
  };
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogContent className="p-0 gap-0 max-w-lg overflow-hidden" aria-describedby={undefined}>
        <DialogTitle className="sr-only">Command palette</DialogTitle>
        <Command>
          <CommandInput placeholder="Search pages, contacts, conversations..." />
          <CommandList>
            <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
            <CommandGroup heading="Navigate">
              {navItems.map((item) => (
                <CommandItem
                  key={item.href}
                  onSelect={() => navigate(item.href)}
                  className="cursor-pointer gap-2"
                >
                  {item.icon}
                  {item.label}
                </CommandItem>
              ))}
            </CommandGroup>
          </CommandList>
        </Command>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

              Page {data.meta.page} of {data.meta.total_pages} ·{' '}
              {data.meta.total.toLocaleString()} contacts
            </p>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                disabled={page === 1}
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(data.meta.total_pages, p + 1))}
                disabled={page === data.meta.total_pages}
              >
                <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
      {/* Create Contact Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Add Contact</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <form onSubmit={handleCreate} className="space-y-4 mt-2">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-primary mb-1.5">First name</label>
                <Input
                  required
                  value={form.first_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, first_name: e.target.value }))}
                  placeholder="Ana"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-primary mb-1.5">Last name</label>
                <Input
                  required
                  value={form.last_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, last_name: e.target.value }))}
                  placeholder="García"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-primary mb-1.5">Email</label>
              <Input
                type="email"
                value={form.email}
                onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, email: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="ana@example.com"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-primary mb-1.5">Phone</label>
              <Input
                value={form.phone}
                onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, phone: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="+1 555 000 0000"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                className="bg-accent hover:bg-accent-hover text-on-accent"
                disabled={createContact.isPending}
              >
                {createContact.isPending ? 'Creating…' : 'Create Contact'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { MessageSquare, Phone, Calendar, GitBranch, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { useContactActivity } from '@/hooks/useContactActivity';
import type { ActivityEvent } from '@/services/activity.service';
interface Props {
  contactId: string;
}
function getDateLabel(timestamp: string) {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(timestamp).getTime();
  const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
  if (days === 0) return 'Today';
  if (days === 1) return 'Yesterday';
  return `${days} days ago`;
}
function formatDateTime(timestamp: string) {
  const d = new Date(timestamp);
  return (
    d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }) +
    ' · ' +
    d.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
  );
}
function EventIcon({ type }: { type: ActivityEvent['type'] }) {
  const cls = 'h-4 w-4';
  if (type === 'message') return <MessageSquare className={cls} />;
  if (type === 'voice_call') return <Phone className={cls} />;
  if (type === 'appointment_event') return <Calendar className={cls} />;
  if (type === 'funnel_change') return <GitBranch className={cls} />;
  return <MessageSquare className={cls} />;
}
function ActorChip({ actor }: { actor?: string }) {
  if (!actor) return null;
  return (
    <span className="ml-1.5 inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-surface-raised px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-secondary">
      {actor}
    </span>
  );
}
function EventLabel({ event }: { event: ActivityEvent }) {
  if (event.type === 'message') {
    return (
      <span>
        <span className="font-medium capitalize">{event.sender}</span>{' '}
        {event.direction === 'inbound' ? 'sent' : 'received'} a message via{' '}
        <span className="font-medium">{event.channel}</span>
        {event.content ? (
          <span className="ml-1 text-muted">
            — &ldquo;{String(event.content).slice(0, 60)}
            {String(event.content).length > 60 ? '…' : ''}&rdquo;
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (event.type === 'voice_call') {
    return (
      <span>
        Voice call ·{' '}
        <span className="font-medium capitalize">{event.call_status}</span>
        {event.duration
          ? ` · ${Math.floor(Number(event.duration) / 60)}:${String(Number(event.duration) % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`
          : ''}
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (event.type === 'appointment_event') {
    return (
      <span className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-y-0.5">
        <span>{event.action}</span>
        <ActorChip actor={event.actor} />
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (event.type === 'funnel_change') {
    return (
      <span className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-y-0.5">
        Stage changed:{' '}
        <span className="font-medium ml-1">{event.from_stage}</span>
        <span className="mx-1">→</span>
        <span className="font-medium">{event.to_stage}</span>
        <ActorChip actor={event.actor} />
      </span>
    );
  }
  return <span>System event</span>;
}
export function ActivityTimeline({ contactId }: Props) {
  const { data, isLoading, fetchNextPage, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage } =
    useContactActivity(contactId);
  // Sort all events newest-first after merging pages.
  const allEvents = (data?.pages.flatMap((p) => p.events) ?? [])
    .filter((e) => !(e.type === 'message' && e.channel === 'voice' && e.sender_type === 'system'))
    .sort(
      (a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime(),
    );
  // Group by date label (preserving newest-first order)
  const groups: { label: string; events: ActivityEvent[] }[] = [];
  for (const event of allEvents) {
    const label = getDateLabel(event.timestamp);
    const existing = groups.find((g) => g.label === label);
    if (existing) {
      existing.events.push(event);
    } else {
      groups.push({ label, events: [event] });
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="col-span-full bg-surface border border-subtle rounded-xl p-6">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary mb-6">Activity Timeline</h3>
      {isLoading && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-10">
          <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-muted" />
        </div>
      )}
      {!isLoading && allEvents.length === 0 && (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted">No activity yet</p>
      )}
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {groups.map(({ label, events }) => (
          <div key={label}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-secondary uppercase tracking-wide">
                {label}
              </span>
              <div className="flex-1 h-px bg-divider" />
            </div>
            <ul className="space-y-3">
              {events.map((event) => (
                <li key={event.id} className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-surface-raised text-secondary mt-0.5">
                    <EventIcon type={event.type} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 text-sm text-primary">
                    <EventLabel event={event} />
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted shrink-0 mt-0.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {formatDateTime(event.timestamp)}
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {hasNextPage && (
        <div className="mt-4 flex justify-center">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => fetchNextPage()}
            disabled={isFetchingNextPage}
          >
            {isFetchingNextPage && <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin mr-2" />}
            Load older activity
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useConversations, useSetPinned } from '@/hooks/useConversations';
import { ConversationListItem } from './conversation-list-item';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { Inbox, Pin, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { Conversation } from '@/services/conversations.service';
type SortOrder = 'newest' | 'oldest';
const CHANNELS = [
  { id: 'whatsapp', label: 'WhatsApp' },
  { id: 'sms', label: 'SMS' },
  { id: 'voice', label: 'Voice' },
  { id: 'webchat', label: 'Web' },
  { id: 'facebook', label: 'Facebook' },
  { id: 'instagram', label: 'Instagram' },
  { id: 'email', label: 'Email' },
] as const;
interface ConversationListPanelProps {
  selectedId: string | null;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
}
export function ConversationListPanel({ selectedId, onSelect }: ConversationListPanelProps) {
  const [order] = useState<SortOrder>('newest');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedChannel, setSelectedChannel] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [assignedTo, setAssignedTo] = useState<'ai' | 'human' | null>(null);
  const { data, isLoading } = useConversations({ 
    search: search || undefined,
    channel: selectedChannel || undefined,
    assigned_to: assignedTo || undefined,
  });
  const setPinned = useSetPinned();
  // Backend returns newest-first (pinned first, then last_message_at DESC).
  // "Oldest" is just the reverse — cheap client-side flip, no extra round trip.
  const orderedItems = order === 'newest' ? data?.items : [...(data?.items ?? [])].reverse();
  // Splitting here renders pinned items in their own section (matches the
  // pattern other inbox tools use — pinned items don't scroll away with
  // normal list activity).
  const pinned = orderedItems?.filter((c) => c.is_pinned) ?? [];
  const rest = orderedItems?.filter((c) => !c.is_pinned) ?? [];
  const renderItem = (conv: Conversation) => (
    <ConversationListItem
      key={conv.id}
      conversation={conv}
      isActive={conv.id === selectedId}
      onClick={() => onSelect(conv.id)}
      onTogglePin={() => setPinned.mutate({ id: conv.id, pinned: !conv.is_pinned })}
    />
  );
  return (
    <div className="w-[320px] shrink-0 flex flex-col border-r border-subtle bg-surface">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="px-4 pt-4 pb-3 border-b border-subtle shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-primary">Inbox</h2>
          {data?.meta?.total !== undefined && (
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted font-medium">
              {data.meta.total} conversations
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {/* Search */}
        <div className="relative mb-3">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted" />
          <Input
            placeholder="Search…"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            className="pl-8 h-8 text-xs bg-surface-raised border-subtle"
          />
        </div>
        {/* Channel filters */}
        <div className="mb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted uppercase tracking-wide">
              Channels
            </span>
            {selectedChannel && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedChannel(null)}
                className="text-[10px] text-accent hover:text-accent-hover font-medium"
              >
                View all
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {CHANNELS.map((channel) => {
              const isActive = selectedChannel === channel.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={channel.id}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedChannel(isActive ? null : channel.id)}
                  className={cn(
                    'inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium transition-all',
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-olive-dark text-accent border border-accent/20'
                      : 'bg-surface-raised text-secondary hover:bg-surface-hover border border-transparent'
                  )}
                >
                  {channel.label}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

interface ConversationViewPanelProps {
  conversationId: string | null;
}
export function ConversationViewPanel({ conversationId }: ConversationViewPanelProps) {
  const { data: conversation, isLoading: convLoading } = useConversation(conversationId);
  const sendMessage = useSendMessage(conversationId, conversation?.contact_id);
  const resolve = useResolveConversation();
  const { typingUsers, sendTyping, stopTyping } = useTypingIndicator(conversationId);
  if (!conversationId) {
    return (
      <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center bg-surface-raised">
        <div className="text-center px-6">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-surface-raised flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3">
            <Send className="h-5 w-5 text-muted" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-secondary">Select a conversation</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted mt-1">to start messaging</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const contact = conversation?.contact;
  const fullName = contact
    ? [contact.first_name, contact.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'Anonymous'
    : '…';
  return (
    <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 bg-surface">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="h-16 px-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-subtle shrink-0">
        {convLoading ? (
          <Skeleton className="h-5 w-40" />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-olive-dark text-accent flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold">
              {getInitials(fullName)}
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">{fullName}</p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {conversation?.channel && <ChannelBadge channel={conversation.channel} showLabel />}
                <Badge variant={conversation?.status === 'open' ? 'secondary' : 'default'} className="text-[10px]">
                  {conversation?.status}
                </Badge>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <PresenceIndicators conversationId={conversationId} />
          {conversation?.status !== 'resolved' && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => resolve.mutate(conversation!.id)}
              disabled={resolve.isPending}
              className="gap-1.5"
            >
              <CheckCheck className="h-4 w-4" />
              Resolve
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <ActiveCallIndicator conversationId={conversationId} />
      {conversation?.contact_id ? (
        <ActivityTimeline
          // Force a full remount per conversation — without this, React reuses
          // the same instance across selections, so scroll position, refs, and
          // the scroll-to-bottom effect's stale-length comparison all leak
          // from whichever conversation was open before.
          key={conversationId}
          conversationId={conversationId}
          contactId={conversation.contact_id}
          typingUsers={typingUsers}
        />
      ) : (
        <ActivityTimeline
          key={conversationId}
          conversationId={conversationId}
          contactId=""
          typingUsers={typingUsers}
        />
      )}
      <MessageComposer
        conversationId={conversationId}
        channel={conversation?.channel ?? 'sms'}
        onSend={async (content) => { await sendMessage.mutateAsync({ content }); }}
        isSending={sendMessage.isPending}
        sendTyping={sendTyping}
        stopTyping={stopTyping}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

  merged.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(b.timestamp).getTime());
  return merged;
}
function ActivityEventRow({ event }: { event: ActivityEvent }) {
  switch (event.type) {
    case 'message':
      return <MessageBubble message={activityMessageToMessage(event)} />;
    case 'voice_call':
      return (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="flex my-1 justify-start">
          <VoiceCallCard
            duration={event.duration}
            transcript={event.transcript_preview}
            recordingUrl={event.recording_url}
            direction={event.direction}
          />
        </motion.div>
      );
    case 'system_event':
      return <SystemEvent content={event.content} timestamp={event.timestamp} />;
    case 'ai_decision':
      return (
        <AiDecisionCard
          decisionType={event.decision_type}
          details={event.details}
          timestamp={event.timestamp}
        />
      );
    case 'funnel_change':
      return (
        <FunnelStageEvent
          fromStage={event.from_stage}
          toStage={event.to_stage}
          reason={event.reason}
          timestamp={event.timestamp}
        />
      );
    case 'appointment_event':
      return <AppointmentEvent action={event.action} timestamp={event.timestamp} />;
    case 'contact_data_updated':
      return <ContactDataUpdatedEvent changedFields={event.changed_fields} timestamp={event.timestamp} />;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}
// Virtuoso needs a starting index that can only ever go down as older pages
// get prepended (it uses this to keep item identity/scroll-anchor stable
// across prepends). This ceiling just needs to comfortably exceed how many
// events a single contact could ever load across a session.
const START_INDEX = 1_000_000;
export function ActivityTimeline({ conversationId, contactId, typingUsers }: ActivityTimelineProps) {
  const virtuosoRef = useRef<VirtuosoHandle>(null);
  const { data, fetchNextPage, hasNextPage, isLoading, isFetchingNextPage } =
    useContactActivity(contactId);
  const { streamingMessages } = useRealtimeMessages(conversationId);
  // data.pages is a new array reference on every query settle, but the merge
  // itself (flatMap + dedup Set + sort) is real work that scales with total
  // loaded events — worth skipping on renders that don't touch it (typing
  // indicator toggling, scroll events, etc.).
  const sortedEvents = useMemo(() => mergeActivityPages(data?.pages), [data?.pages]);
  const firstItemIndex = START_INDEX - sortedEvents.length;
  const hasStreaming = streamingMessages.size > 0;
  const hasTyping = typingUsers.length > 0;
  return (
    <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 overflow-hidden relative" style={{ contain: 'layout' }}>
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex-1 px-4 py-2 space-y-3">
          {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
            <div key={i} className={`flex ${i % 2 === 0 ? 'justify-start' : 'justify-end'}`}>
              <Skeleton className="h-12 w-48 rounded-xl" />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : sortedEvents.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex-1 py-12 text-center text-sm text-muted">No activity yet</div>
      ) : (
        // Virtuoso only mounts what's actually visible (plus a small overscan
        // buffer) instead of every loaded event's full component tree —
        // without this, a contact with hundreds of messages loaded across
        // several "scroll up for more" cycles keeps every one of them
        // mounted forever, and it only gets slower from there. It also owns
        // prepend-without-jumping and follow-to-bottom natively, replacing
        // what used to be a hand-rolled scroll-position-preservation effect.
        <Virtuoso
          ref={virtuosoRef}
          className="thin-scrollbar flex-1 px-4 py-2 virtuoso-viewport-fix"
          style={{ overflowX: 'hidden' }}
          data={sortedEvents}
          firstItemIndex={firstItemIndex}
          initialTopMostItemIndex={sortedEvents.length - 1}
          alignToBottom
          followOutput={(isAtBottom) => (isAtBottom ? 'auto' : false)}
          startReached={() => {
            if (hasNextPage && !isFetchingNextPage) fetchNextPage();
          }}
          itemContent={(_index, event) => (
            <div className="w-full min-w-0 max-w-full">
              <ActivityEventRow event={event} />
            </div>
          )}
          components={{
            Header: () =>
              isFetchingNextPage ? (
                <div className="space-y-2 mb-3">
                  {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className={`flex ${i % 2 === 0 ? 'justify-start' : 'justify-end'}`}>
                      <Skeleton className="h-10 w-40 rounded-xl" />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : null,
            Footer: () =>
              hasStreaming ? (
                <AnimatePresence>
                  {Array.from(streamingMessages.entries()).map(([id, content]) => (
                    <StreamingMessageBubble key={id} content={content} />
                  ))}
                </AnimatePresence>
              ) : null,
          }}
        />
      )}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {hasTyping && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
            className="px-4 pb-1 overflow-hidden"
          >
            <TypingIndicator senderType={typingUsers[0].senderType} />
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

  async findAll(
    organizationId: string,
    query: PaginationQuery & { status?: string; channel?: string; assigned_to?: 'ai' | 'human' },
  ): Promise<PaginatedResponse<ConversationWithContact>> {
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const limit = query.limit ?? 20;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
    const where: Record<string, unknown> = { organization_id: organizationId };
    if (query.status) where['status'] = query.status;
    if (query.channel) where['channel'] = query.channel;
    // bot_active is the same flag `handoff()` toggles: true while the AI owns
    // the conversation, false once a human has taken over.
    if (query.assigned_to === 'ai') where['bot_active'] = true;
    if (query.assigned_to === 'human') where['bot_active'] = false;
    // Use query builder to properly handle NULL values in ordering.
    // Pinned conversations float to the top, then by most recent activity.
    // NULLS LAST ensures conversations without messages don't appear first.
    const qb = this.conversationRepo.createQueryBuilder('conv')
      .where(where)
      .orderBy('conv.is_pinned', 'DESC')
      .addOrderBy('conv.last_message_at', 'DESC', 'NULLS LAST')
      .skip(skip)
      .take(limit);
    const [conversations, total] = await qb.getManyAndCount();
    if (conversations.length === 0) {
      return { items: [], meta: buildPaginationMeta(total, page, limit) };
    }
    const conversationIds = conversations.map((c) => c.id);
    const contactIds = [...new Set(conversations.map((c) => c.contact_id).filter(Boolean))];
    // Batch-fetch contacts
    const contacts = await this.clientService.findByIds(contactIds, organizationId);
    const contactMap = new Map(contacts.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
    // Batch-fetch last messages via DISTINCT ON (most efficient for Postgres)
    type LastMsgRow = { id: string; conversation_id: string; content: string; sent_at: string; direction: string };
    const lastMsgs = (await this.messageRepo.query(
      `SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.conversation_id) m.id, m.conversation_id, m.content, m.sent_at, m.direction
       FROM conversations.messages m
       WHERE m.conversation_id = ANY($1)
       ORDER BY m.conversation_id, m.sent_at DESC`,
      [conversationIds],
    )) as LastMsgRow[];
    const lastMsgMap = new Map(lastMsgs.map((m) => [m.conversation_id, m]));
    // Batch-count unread inbound messages — anything after last_read_at, or
    // every inbound message when the conversation has never been opened.
    type UnreadRow = { conversation_id: string; count: string };
    const unreadRows = (await this.messageRepo.query(
      `SELECT m.conversation_id, count(*) AS count
       FROM conversations.messages m
       JOIN conversations.conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id
       WHERE m.conversation_id = ANY($1)
         AND m.direction = 'inbound'
         AND m.sent_at > COALESCE(c.last_read_at, 'epoch'::timestamptz)
       GROUP BY m.conversation_id`,
      [conversationIds],
    )) as UnreadRow[];
    const unreadMap = new Map(unreadRows.map((r) => [r.conversation_id, Number(r.count)]));
    const items: ConversationWithContact[] = conversations.map((conv) => {
      const c = contactMap.get(conv.contact_id);
      const lm = lastMsgMap.get(conv.id);
      return Object.assign(conv, {
        contact: c
          ? { id: c.id, first_name: c.first_name, last_name: c.last_name ?? null, email: c.email ?? null, phone: c.phone ?? null }
          : undefined,
        last_message: lm
          ? { content: lm.content, created_at: lm.sent_at, direction: lm.direction }
          : undefined,
        unread_count: unreadMap.get(conv.id) ?? 0,
      });
    });
    return { items, meta: buildPaginationMeta(total, page, limit) };
  }
  async findById(id: string, organizationId: string): Promise<ConversationWithContact> {
    const conv = await this.conversationRepo.findOne({
      where: { id, organization_id: organizationId },
    });
    if (!conv) throw new NotFoundException(`Conversation ${id} not found`);
    // Opening a conversation marks it read — fire-and-forget, doesn't block the response.
    void this.conversationRepo.update({ id, organization_id: organizationId }, { last_read_at: new Date() });
    if (conv.contact_id) {
      const contacts = await this.clientService.findByIds([conv.contact_id], organizationId);
      const c = contacts[0];
      if (c) {
        return Object.assign(conv, {
          contact: { id: c.id, first_name: c.first_name, last_name: c.last_name ?? null, email: c.email ?? null, phone: c.phone ?? null },
        });
      }
    }
    return conv as ConversationWithContact;
  }

export interface PaginationQuery {
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
  search?: string;
  sort_by?: string;
  sort_order?: 'asc' | 'desc';
}
export interface PaginatedResponse<T> {
  items: T[];
  meta: PaginationMeta;
}
export interface PaginationMeta {
  total: number;
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  total_pages: number;
  has_next: boolean;
  has_prev: boolean;
}
export function buildPaginationMeta(
  total: number,
  page: number,
  limit: number,
): PaginationMeta {
  const total_pages = Math.ceil(total / limit);
  return {
    total,
    page,
    limit,
    total_pages,
    has_next: page < total_pages,
    has_prev: page > 1,
  };
}

const PAGE_SIZE = 25;
function formatDuration(sec: number | null): string {
  if (sec == null) return '—';
  const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
  const s = sec % 60;
  return m > 0 ? `${m}m ${s}s` : `${s}s`;
}
function formatDate(iso: string | null): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleString();
}
function contactName(call: VoiceCall): string {
  const c = call.contact;
  if (!c) return 'Unknown contact';
  return [c.first_name, c.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'Unnamed';
}
/** The counterparty number: on outbound calls that's who we dialed (phone_to), on inbound who dialed us (phone_from). */
function counterpartyPhone(call: VoiceCall): string {
  return call.direction === 'outbound' ? call.phone_to : call.phone_from;
}

  const [selectedFunnelId, setSelectedFunnelId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [configureOpen, setConfigureOpen] = useState(false);
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newFunnelName, setNewFunnelName] = useState('');
  const { data: stages = [] } = useFunnelStages(selectedFunnelId);
  const selectedFunnel = funnels?.find((f) => f.id === selectedFunnelId);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (funnels && funnels.length > 0 && !selectedFunnelId) {
      setSelectedFunnelId(funnels[0].id);
    }
  }, [funnels, selectedFunnelId]);
  const handleCreateFunnel = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newFunnelName.trim()) return;
    try {
      const funnel = await createFunnel.mutateAsync({ name: newFunnelName.trim() });
      setSelectedFunnelId(funnel.id);
      setCreateOpen(false);
      setNewFunnelName('');
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'Failed to create funnel', variant: 'error' });
    }
  };
  if (funnelsLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-5">
        <PageHeader />
        <Skeleton className="h-10 w-48" />
        <div className="flex gap-4">
          {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
            <Skeleton key={i} className="h-80 w-72 shrink-0 rounded-card" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!funnels?.length) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-5">
        <PageHeader />
        <FunnelTemplateSelector onCreated={setSelectedFunnelId} />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <PageHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Select value={selectedFunnelId ?? undefined} onValueChange={setSelectedFunnelId}>
            <SelectTrigger aria-label="Funnel" className="h-8 w-48 text-sm">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Select a funnel" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {funnels.map((f) => (
                <SelectItem key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                  {f.name}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setConfigureOpen(true)} disabled={!selectedFunnel}>
            <Settings2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Configure
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>
            <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> New funnel
          </Button>
        </div>
      </PageHeader>
      {selectedFunnelId && (
        <Tabs defaultValue="board">
          <TabsList className="mb-3">
            <TabsTrigger value="board">
              <Columns3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Board
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="list">
              <List className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> List
            </TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
          <TabsContent value="board">
            <FunnelKanbanView stages={stages} onConfigure={() => setConfigureOpen(true)} />
          </TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="list">
            <FunnelListView stages={stages} onConfigure={() => setConfigureOpen(true)} />
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      )}
      {selectedFunnel && (
        <StagesDrawer funnel={selectedFunnel} open={configureOpen} onOpenChange={setConfigureOpen} />
      )}
      <Dialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-sm">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>New funnel</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <form onSubmit={handleCreateFunnel} className="space-y-4 mt-2">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="new-funnel-name" className="block text-xs font-medium text-primary mb-1">
                Name
              </label>
              <Input
                id="new-funnel-name"
                required
                value={newFunnelName}
                onChange={(e) => setNewFunnelName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Sales Q2, Main Pipeline…"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={createFunnel.isPending || !newFunnelName.trim()}>
                {createFunnel.isPending ? 'Creating…' : 'Create'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

function outcomeKind(stage: FunnelStageCount): 'won' | 'lost' | null {
  const type = stage.stage_type?.toLowerCase();
  if (type === 'won' || type === 'lost') return type;
  const name = stage.stage.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (name === 'won' || name === 'lost') return name;
  return null;
}
function FunnelPipeline({ stages }: { stages: FunnelStageCount[] }) {
  const pipeline = stages.filter((stage) => outcomeKind(stage) === null);
  const wonCount = stages.filter((stage) => outcomeKind(stage) === 'won').reduce((sum, stage) => sum + stage.count, 0);
  const lostCount = stages.filter((stage) => outcomeKind(stage) === 'lost').reduce((sum, stage) => sum + stage.count, 0);
  const max = Math.max(...pipeline.map((stage) => stage.count), 1);
  
  if (pipeline.length === 0) {
    return <p className="py-12 text-center text-sm text-muted">No funnel data yet</p>;
  }
  const stageHeight = 56;
  const stageGap = 4;
  const totalHeight = pipeline.length * stageHeight + (pipeline.length - 1) * stageGap;
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
        <svg
          viewBox={`0 0 100 ${totalHeight}`}
          preserveAspectRatio="none"
          className="h-auto w-full max-w-md"
          style={{ height: totalHeight }}
        >
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id="funnelGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">

              <stop offset="100%" style={{ stopColor: 'var(--color-olive)', stopOpacity: 0.4 }} />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>
          {pipeline.map((stage, index) => {

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useCurrentUser } from '@/hooks/useTeam';
import { useImpersonation } from '@/contexts/impersonation-context';
import { EventTemplateMatrix } from './_components/EventTemplateMatrix';
import { EmailDesigner } from './_components/EmailDesigner';
import { DeliveryLogTable } from './_components/DeliveryLogTable';
type OrgTab = 'design' | 'history';
export default function CommunicationsPage() {
  const { data: currentUser } = useCurrentUser();
  const { isImpersonating } = useImpersonation();
  const isPlatformAdmin = currentUser?.is_platform_admin === true && !isImpersonating;
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<OrgTab>('design');
  return (
    <div>
      {/* Page header */}
      <div className="pb-5">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-primary">Communications</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-secondary mt-0.5">
          {isPlatformAdmin
            ? 'Manage system templates for every event and channel'
            : 'Configure brand identity and notification preferences'}
        </p>
      </div>
      {isPlatformAdmin ? (
        <EventTemplateMatrix />
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Tabs */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mb-5 border-b border-subtle">
            <TabButton active={activeTab === 'design'} onClick={() => setActiveTab('design')}>
              Design
            </TabButton>
            <TabButton active={activeTab === 'history'} onClick={() => setActiveTab('history')}>
              History
            </TabButton>
          </div>
          {activeTab === 'design' && <EmailDesigner />}
          {activeTab === 'history' && <DeliveryLogTable />}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
function TabButton({
  active,
  onClick,
  children,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors relative ${
        active
          ? 'text-primary'
          : 'text-secondary hover:text-primary'
      }`}
    >
      {children}
      {active && (
        <span className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-0.5 bg-accent rounded-full" />
      )}
    </button>
  );
}
'use client';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';

import { PaymentServicesTab } from './_components/PaymentServicesTab';
import { TransactionsTab } from './_components/TransactionsTab';
import { AttentionTab } from './_components/AttentionTab';
import { usePaymentsNeedingAttention } from '@/hooks/usePayments';
import { useCurrentUser } from '@/hooks/useTeam';
export default function ConfigPaymentsPage() {

      <Tabs defaultValue={attention.length ? 'attention' : 'connection'} key={attention.length ? 'attention' : 'default'}>
        <TabsList className="mb-5">
          <TabsTrigger value="connection">Stripe connection</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="services">Services</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="transactions">Transactions</TabsTrigger>
          {isAdmin && (
            <TabsTrigger value="attention">Needs attention{attention.length ? ` (${attention.length})` : ''}</TabsTrigger>
          )}

        <TabsContent value="services">

        <TabsContent value="transactions">
          <TransactionsTab />
        </TabsContent>
        {isAdmin && (
          <TabsContent value="attention">
            <AttentionTab />
          </TabsContent>
        )}
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-primary">{isAI ? 'AI' : 'Human'}</p>

}
'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useHandoff } from '@/hooks/useConversations';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Bot, User } from 'lucide-react';
interface AgentStatusToggleProps {
  conversationId: string;
  botActive: boolean;
}
export function AgentStatusToggle({ conversationId, botActive: initialBotActive }: AgentStatusToggleProps) {
  const [botActive, setBotActive] = useState(initialBotActive);
  const handoff = useHandoff();
  const handleToggle = async () => {
    const next = !botActive;
    setBotActive(next);
    try {
      await handoff.mutateAsync(conversationId);
    } catch {
      setBotActive(!next);
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-1.5">
      <Button
        variant={botActive ? 'default' : 'outline'}
        size="sm"
        className={`flex-1 h-7 text-xs gap-1 ${botActive ? 'border border-accent/20 bg-olive-dark text-accent hover:bg-olive-dark' : ''}`}
        onClick={handleToggle}
        disabled={handoff.isPending}
      >
        <Bot className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        AI Active
      </Button>
      <Button
        variant={!botActive ? 'default' : 'outline'}
        size="sm"
        className={`flex-1 h-7 text-xs gap-1 ${!botActive ? 'border border-warning/25 bg-warning/10 text-warning hover:bg-warning/15' : ''}`}
        onClick={handleToggle}
        disabled={handoff.isPending}
      >
        <User className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        Human
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { Repeat, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import { automationService, type AutomationSequence } from '@/services/automation.service';
import { useSequenceSteps } from '@/hooks/useSequenceTemplates';
import { useCancelSequence } from '@/hooks/useAutomation';
import {
  actionMeta, strategyLabel, SEQUENCE_TYPE_LABELS,
} from '@/components/sequences/sequence-constants';
interface Props {
  contactId: string;
}
/**
 * Automation state for a contact — deliberately separate from FunnelStageCard.
 * The funnel is the commercial pipeline; this is the follow-up execution state.
 * They are orthogonal axes and both belong on the lead.
 */
export function FollowUpCard({ contactId }: Props) {
  const { data: sequences, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['sequences', 'contact', contactId],
    queryFn: () => automationService.listSequences({ contact_id: contactId, status: 'active' }),
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
  const active: AutomationSequence | undefined = sequences?.items?.[0];
  const { data: steps } = useSequenceSteps(active?.id ?? null);
  const cancel = useCancelSequence();
  const handleCancel = async () => {
    if (!active) return;
    if (!window.confirm('Cancel the automatic follow-up for this contact?')) return;
    try {
      await cancel.mutateAsync(active.id);
      toast({ title: 'Follow-up cancelled' });
    } catch (err) {
      toast({ title: (err as Error).message, variant: 'error' });
    }
  };
  const currentStep = steps?.find((s) => s.position === active?.current_attempt);
  const StepIcon = currentStep ? actionMeta(currentStep.action).icon : Repeat;
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-subtle bg-surface p-5">
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
        <Repeat className="h-4 w-4 text-muted" />
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Follow-up</h3>
      </div>
      {isLoading ? (

    const secondaryLimit = limit * 5;
    // Voice calls
    // Filtered and ordered on the same expression the event is timestamped
    // with, otherwise a call whose started_at differs from created_at lands out
    // of order or is skipped when the cursor moves past it.
    let callsQb = this.callRepo
      .createQueryBuilder('c')
      .where('c.contact_id = :id', { id })
      .andWhere('c.organization_id = :orgId', { orgId: organizationId })
      .andWhere('COALESCE(c.started_at, c.created_at) < :cursor', { cursor: cursorDate });
    if (windowStart) {
      callsQb = callsQb.andWhere('COALESCE(c.started_at, c.created_at) >= :windowStart', { windowStart });
    }
    const calls = await callsQb
      .orderBy('COALESCE(c.started_at, c.created_at)', 'DESC')
      .take(windowStart ? secondaryLimit : limit)
      .getMany();
    // Appointments — join user to resolve actor name; use created_at for timestamp
    let appointmentsQb = this.appointmentRepo
      .createQueryBuilder('a')
      .leftJoin(UserEntity, 'u', 'u.id = a.created_by')
      .addSelect('u.full_name', 'actor_name')
      .where('a.contact_id = :id', { id })
      .andWhere('a.organization_id = :orgId', { orgId: organizationId })
      .andWhere('a.created_at < :cursor', { cursor: cursorDate });
    if (windowStart) {
      appointmentsQb = appointmentsQb.andWhere('a.created_at >= :windowStart', { windowStart });
    }
    const appointmentRaw = await appointmentsQb
      .orderBy('a.created_at', 'DESC')
      .take(windowStart ? secondaryLimit : limit)
      .getRawMany<{
        a_id: string;
        a_created_at: Date;
        a_title: string;
        a_status: string;
        a_origin: string;
        a_created_by: string | null;
        actor_name: string | null;
      }>();
    // Contact data updates
    let dataUpdatesQb = this.dataUpdateRepo
      .createQueryBuilder('d')
      .where('d.contact_id = :id', { id })
      .andWhere('d.organization_id = :orgId', { orgId: organizationId })
      .andWhere('d.created_at < :cursor', { cursor: cursorDate });
    if (windowStart) {
      dataUpdatesQb = dataUpdatesQb.andWhere('d.created_at >= :windowStart', { windowStart });
    }
    const dataUpdates = await dataUpdatesQb
      .orderBy('d.created_at', 'DESC')
      .take(windowStart ? secondaryLimit : limit)
      .getMany();
    // Funnel history — join user to resolve actor name
    let historyQb = this.historyRepo
      .createQueryBuilder('h')
      .leftJoin(FunnelStageEntity, 'fs', 'fs.id = h.from_stage_id')
      .leftJoin(FunnelStageEntity, 'ts', 'ts.id = h.to_stage_id')
      .leftJoin(UserEntity, 'u', 'u.id = h.changed_by')
      .addSelect('fs.name', 'from_name')
      .addSelect('ts.name', 'to_name')
      .addSelect('u.full_name', 'actor_name')
      .where('h.contact_id = :id', { id })
      .andWhere('h.created_at < :cursor', { cursor: cursorDate });
    if (windowStart) {
      historyQb = historyQb.andWhere('h.created_at >= :windowStart', { windowStart });
    }
    const history = await historyQb
      .orderBy('h.created_at', 'DESC')
      .take(windowStart ? secondaryLimit : limit)
      .getRawMany<{
        h_id: string;
        h_created_at: Date;
        h_changed_by: string | null;
        from_name: string | null;
        to_name: string | null;
        actor_name: string | null;
      }>();
    // Merge and sort. System messages (handoff, captured data, etc.) are
    // timeline events, not bubbles — except voice, which CallEntity already
    // covers as voice_call and would otherwise duplicate.
    const messageEvents: ActivityEvent[] = messages.flatMap((m): ActivityEvent[] => {
      const timestamp = m.sent_at.toISOString();
      const isSystem = m.type === 'system' || m.sender_type === 'system';
      if (isSystem && m.channel === 'voice') return [];
      if (isSystem) {
        return [{ type: 'system_event' as const, id: m.id, content: m.content, timestamp }];
      }
      return [{
        type: 'message' as const,
        id: m.id,
        content: m.content,
        sender: m.sender_type === 'user' ? 'contact' : m.sender_type === 'ai' ? 'ai' : 'agent',
        channel: m.channel,
        timestamp,
        direction: m.direction as 'inbound' | 'outbound',
        sender_type: m.sender_type,
        message_type: m.type,
        metadata: m.metadata,
      }];
    });
    const callEvents: ActivityEvent[] = calls.map((c) => ({
      type: 'voice_call' as const,
      id: c.id,
      duration: c.duration_seconds ?? 0,
      call_status: c.status,
      direction: c.direction,
      recording_url: c.recording_url,
      timestamp: (c.started_at ?? c.created_at).toISOString(),
    }));
    const appointmentEvents: ActivityEvent[] = appointmentRaw.map((a) => ({
      type: 'appointment_event' as const,
      id: a.a_id,
      action: `Appointment ${a.a_status}`,
      appointment_id: a.a_id,
      title: a.a_title,
      status: a.a_status,
      actor: a.actor_name ?? (a.a_origin === 'ai' ? 'AI' : null),
      timestamp: new Date(a.a_created_at).toISOString(),
    }));
    const funnelEvents: ActivityEvent[] = history.map((h) => ({
      type: 'funnel_change' as const,
      id: h.h_id,
      from_stage: h.from_name ?? 'Unknown',
      to_stage: h.to_name ?? 'Unknown',
      actor: h.actor_name ?? (h.h_changed_by ? 'Agent' : 'System'),
      timestamp: h.h_created_at.toISOString(),
    }));
    const dataUpdateEvents: ActivityEvent[] = dataUpdates.map((d) => ({
      type: 'contact_data_updated' as const,
      id: d.id,
      changed_fields: d.changed_fields,
      timestamp: d.created_at.toISOString(),
    }));
    // No arbitrary final slice — messages are already capped at `limit`, and
    // every secondary type is bounded by that same message window (or by its
    // own `limit` in the no-messages-yet fallback), so nothing here needs
    // truncating a second time. That second truncation was the actual bug:
    // slicing the merged, mixed-type list to `limit` let a burst of one event
    // type (e.g. automation appointments) push real messages off the page.
    const merged = [...messageEvents, ...callEvents, ...appointmentEvents, ...funnelEvents, ...dataUpdateEvents].sort(
      (a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime(),
    );
    const next_cursor = hasFullMessagePage ? windowStart!.toISOString() : null;
    return { events: merged, next_cursor };
  }

export function ContactHeader({
  contact,
  onEdit,
  stages = [],
}: Props & { stages?: { id: string; name: string }[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4 bg-surface border border-subtle rounded-xl p-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-olive-dark text-accent text-xl font-bold shrink-0">
          {getInitials(contact)}
        </div>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">
            {contact.first_name} {contact.last_name}
          </h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-1 text-sm text-secondary">
            {contact.phone && <span>{contact.phone}</span>}
            {contact.email && contact.phone && <span>·</span>}
            {contact.email && <span>{contact.email}</span>}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
            {contact.lead_score !== undefined && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium bg-olive-dark text-accent">
                Score: {contact.lead_score}
              </span>
            )}
            {contact.lead_stage && (() => {
              const name = getStageName(contact, stages);
              return name ? (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium bg-surface-raised text-primary">
                  {name}
                </span>
              ) : null;
            })()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onEdit}>
          <Edit2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-1.5" />
          Edit
        </Button>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push(`/inbox?contactId=${contact.id}`)}
        >
          <MessageSquare className="h-4 w-4 mr-1.5" />

  async findAll(
    organizationId: string,
    query: ContactQuery,
  ): Promise<{ items: ContactEntity[]; meta: ReturnType<typeof buildPaginationMeta> }> {
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const limit = query.limit ?? 20;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
    const qb = this.contactRepo
      .createQueryBuilder('c')
      .leftJoinAndSelect('c.company', 'company')
      .where('c.organization_id = :orgId', { orgId: organizationId });
    if (query.field && query.value && SEARCHABLE_COLUMNS.includes(query.field as SearchableColumn)) {
      qb.andWhere(`c.${query.field} ILIKE :fieldValue`, { fieldValue: `%${query.value}%` });
    } else if (query.search) {
      const q = `%${query.search}%`;
      qb.andWhere(
        '(c.first_name ILIKE :q OR c.last_name ILIKE :q OR c.email ILIKE :q OR c.phone ILIKE :q)',
        { q },
      );
    }
    if (query.stage_id) {
      qb.andWhere('c.lead_stage = :stageId', { stageId: query.stage_id });
    }
    qb.orderBy('c.created_at', 'DESC').skip(skip).take(limit);
    const [items, total] = await qb.getManyAndCount();
    return { items, meta: buildPaginationMeta(total, page, limit) };
  }

    total: number;

    human_handled: number;

    const startOfMonth = new Date();
    startOfMonth.setDate(1);
    startOfMonth.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    @Query('limit') limit: string | undefined,
    @Query('offset') offset: string | undefined,

    const o = offset ? +offset : 0;
    const [items, total] = await this.callsService.findByOrg(tenant.organization_id, l, o);
