Your exact problem already exists today: /config and /platform have child pages but no page of their own, so they 404. The plan adds a /config page that sends each role to the first settings page it can see, and a /platform page that sends you to /platform/demo-accounts.
404 page inside the app: there's no not-found.tsx or error.tsx anywhere, so a wrong URL shows Next's default page without the sidebar or header. The plan adds a "page doesn't exist" screen inside the app with Inbox/Contacts buttons, plus an error page.
Missing records: an opened drawer, e.g. ?lead=<id>, whose record doesn't exist shows "Not found" and clears itself; /contacts/<deleted id> keeps its in-page message.
Admin-only pages keep their URLs. They move into a Next.js route group with a guard (route groups don't change the URL). An agent who opens one is redirected with a message. An agent opening /config/payments goes to /payments, where they have the day-to-day view.
Links the API puts in notifications keep working:

import { Controller, Get, Post, Put, Patch, Delete, Body, Param, HttpCode, HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags, ApiBearerAuth } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import {
  AIAgentsService,
  CreateAIAgentDto,
  UpdateAIAgentDto,
  CreateCaptureFieldDto,
  UpdateCaptureFieldDto,
} from './ai-agents.service';
import { CurrentTenant } from '../../common/decorators/current-tenant.decorator';
import { PlanFeature } from '@crm/shared';
import type { TenantContext } from '@crm/shared';
import { RequiresPlanFeature } from '../billing/billing-access.decorators';
@ApiTags('ai-agents')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@Controller({ path: 'ai-agents', version: '1' })
export class AIAgentsController {
  constructor(private readonly service: AIAgentsService) {}
  // --- ProSales-backed agent config (the real thing — one agent per org).
  // Static "config" routes MUST be declared before the ":id" routes below,
  // otherwise Express/Nest would match "config" as an :id. ---
  @Post('config/provision')
  @RequiresPlanFeature(PlanFeature.AI_RESPONSES)
  provisionAgent(
    @CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext,
    @Body() body: { agent_type?: string },
  ) {
    return this.service.provisionAgent(tenant.organization_id, body?.agent_type);
  }
  @Get('config')
  getConfig(@CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext) {
    return this.service.getConfig(tenant.organization_id);
  }
  // Generate the whole config from a plain-language brief (ProSales LLM
  // extractor). Returns the generated config for a read-only summary; the
  // config/* PUT routes above still allow fine edits afterwards.
  @Post('config/from-brief')
  configureFromBrief(@CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext, @Body() body: { brief: string }) {
    return this.service.configureFromBrief(tenant.organization_id, body.brief);
  }
  @Put('config/identity')
  updateIdentity(@CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext, @Body() body: unknown) {
    return this.service.updateIdentity(tenant.organization_id, body);
  }
  @Put('config/personality')
  updatePersonality(@CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext, @Body() body: unknown) {
    return this.service.updatePersonality(tenant.organization_id, body);
  }

bash
command:
mkdir -p /tmp && cat > /workspace/apps/api/src/common/decorators/admin-only.decorator.ts <<'EOF'
import { UserRole } from '@crm/shared';
import { Roles } from './roles.decorator';

/** Roles allowed to change organization configuration (AI agent, channels, webhooks, prices). */
export const ORG_ADMIN_ROLES: UserRole[] = [UserRole.OWNER, UserRole.ADMIN];

/**
 * Restricts a route to organization owners and admins. API keys (role
 * `api_key`) and agents get 403 — none of the routes using this are part of
 * the documented API-key contract.
 */
export const AdminOnly = () => Roles(...ORG_ADMIN_ROLES);
EOF

import re
def guard(path, methods_to_guard, import_line="import { AdminOnly } from '../../common/decorators/admin-only.decorator';"):
    s=open(path).read()
    for sig in methods_to_guard:
        # sig is the decorator line like "  @Post('config/provision')"
        assert s.count(sig)==1, (path, sig, s.count(sig))
        s=s.replace(sig, sig+"\n  @AdminOnly()")
    # add import after last import line
    lines=s.split('\n')
    last=max(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('import ') or l.startswith("} from"))
    lines.insert(last+1, import_line)
    open(path,'w').write('\n'.join(lines))

My script put the decorator after the whole multi-line match instead of after the decorator line in two places. Reverting that file and redoing it properly:

bash
command:
cd /workspace/apps/api/src/modules && git checkout ai-agents/ai-agents.controller.ts && cat > /tmp/guard.py <<'EOF'
import sys
def guard(path, sigs, import_line="import { AdminOnly } from '../../common/decorators/admin-only.decorator';"):
    s=open(path).read()
    for sig in sigs:
        # sig may be multi-line for disambiguation; decorator goes right after its FIRST line
        assert s.count(sig)==1, (path, sig, s.count(sig))
        first, sep, rest = sig.partition('\n')
        s=s.replace(sig, first+"\n  @AdminOnly()"+(sep+rest if sep else ''))
    lines=s.split('\n')
    last=max(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('import ') or l.startswith("} from"))
    lines.insert(last+1, import_line)
    open(path,'w').write('\n'.join(lines))
EOF

/**
 * Channel configs hold provider credentials (Meta page tokens, app secrets,
 * webhook verify tokens, Telnyx/Retell API keys…). They must never reach the
 * browser. The edit form sends `***` back for untouched secrets, which
 * ChannelsService.update() already ignores, so masking is safe for editing.
 */
export const MASKED_VALUE = '***';

const EXPLICIT_SENSITIVE_KEYS = new Set([
  'api_key',
  'password',
  'access_token',
  'page_access_token',
  'api_secret',
  'app_secret',
  'auth_token',
  'hmac_secret',
  'verify_token',
]);

/** Any key ending in token / secret / password / api_key is treated as a credential. */
const SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN = /(token|secret|password|api_?key)$/i;

export function isSensitiveConfigKey(key: string): boolean {
  return EXPLICIT_SENSITIVE_KEYS.has(key) || SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN.test(key);
}

export function maskChannelConfig(config: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {
  const masked: Record<string, unknown> = { ...(config ?? {}) };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(masked)) {
    if (isSensitiveConfigKey(key) && typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0) {
      masked[key] = MASKED_VALUE;
    }
  }
  return masked;
}

  async findById(channelId: string): Promise<ChannelEntity | null> {
    const cacheKey = `channel:id:${channelId}`;
    const cached = await this.redis.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return JSON.parse(cached) as ChannelEntity;
    }
    const channel = await this.channelRepo.findOne({ where: { id: channelId } });
    if (channel) {
      await this.redis.setex(cacheKey, CHANNEL_CACHE_TTL, JSON.stringify(channel));
    }
    return channel ?? null;
  }
  // Lookup by widget_id stored in config JSONB — used by webchat ingestion
  async findByWidgetId(widgetId: string): Promise<ChannelEntity | null> {
    const cacheKey = `channel:widget:${widgetId}`;
    const cached = await this.redis.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return JSON.parse(cached) as ChannelEntity;
    }
    const channel = await this.channelRepo
      .createQueryBuilder('c')
      .where(`c.config->>'widget_id' = :widgetId`, { widgetId })
      .getOne();
    if (channel) {
      await this.redis.setex(cacheKey, CHANNEL_CACHE_TTL, JSON.stringify(channel));
    }
    return channel ?? null;
  }

import { isSensitiveConfigKey, maskChannelConfig, MASKED_VALUE } from './channel-config-mask';

describe('maskChannelConfig', () => {
  it('masks every credential the channel integrations actually store', () => {
    const masked = maskChannelConfig({
      page_access_token: 'EAAG-real-token',
      app_secret: 'meta-app-secret',
      verify_token: 'hub-verify',
      api_key: 'telnyx-key',
      hmac_secret: 'retell-hmac',
      access_token: 'tok',
      auth_token: 'twilio-auth',
      password: 'pw',
    });
    for (const value of Object.values(masked)) expect(value).toBe(MASKED_VALUE);
  });

  it('keeps the non-secret fields the UI and webhooks rely on', () => {
    const config = {
      phone_number: '+34600000000',
      widget_id: 'w-1',
      agent_id: 'agent_1',
      inbound_agent_id: 'agent_in',
      account_sid: 'AC123',
      push_name: 'Clinic',
      messaging_profile_id: 'mp-1',
    };
    expect(maskChannelConfig(config)).toEqual(config);
  });

  it('leaves empty or non-string values untouched and never mutates the input', () => {
    const config = { api_key: '', page_access_token: null, nested: { token: 'x' } };
    const copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(config));
    expect(maskChannelConfig(config)).toEqual(config);
    expect(config).toEqual(copy);
  });

  it('treats future *_token / *_secret keys as sensitive by default', () => {
    expect(isSensitiveConfigKey('refresh_token')).toBe(true);
    expect(isSensitiveConfigKey('client_secret')).toBe(true);
    expect(isSensitiveConfigKey('phone_number')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('handles a missing config', () => {
    expect(maskChannelConfig(undefined)).toEqual({});
  });
});

export type PublicAutomationAgent = Omit<AutomationAgentEntity, 'auth_header_value'> & {
  /** Whether an X-API-Key is configured. The key itself never leaves the server. */
  has_auth_header: boolean;
};

export function toPublicAutomationAgent(agent: AutomationAgentEntity): PublicAutomationAgent {

@ApiBearerAuth()
@Controller({ path: 'ai/agents', version: '1' })
export class AutomationAgentsController {
  constructor(private readonly agentTriggerService: AgentTriggerService) {}
  @Get()
  async findAll(@CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext) {
    const agents = await this.agentTriggerService.findAll(tenant.organization_id);
    return agents.map(toPublicAutomationAgent);
  }
  @Post()
  @AdminOnly()

  }
  @Patch(':id')
  @AdminOnly()
  async update(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() dto: UpdateAutomationAgentDto,

  deactivate(@Param('id') id: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext) {
    return this.agentTriggerService.deactivate(id, tenant.organization_id);
  }
}

Now a spec that pins down the role metadata: every protected write is admin-only, the reads stay open, and agents can resolve payment attention.

bash
command:
cd /workspace/apps/api/src && cat > common/decorators/admin-only.routes.spec.ts <<'EOF'
import 'reflect-metadata';
import { UserRole } from '@crm/shared';
import { ROLES_KEY } from './roles.decorator';
import { ORG_ADMIN_ROLES } from './admin-only.decorator';
import { AIAgentsController } from '../../modules/ai-agents/ai-agents.controller';
import {
  AutomationAgentsController,
  AutomationToolsController,
} from '../../modules/ai-automation/automation-agents.controller';
import { ChannelsController } from '../../modules/integrations/channels.controller';
import { WahaChannelController } from '../../modules/integrations/waha-channel.controller';
import { IntegrationsController } from '../../modules/integrations/integrations.controller';
import { PaymentServiceController } from '../../modules/payments/payment-service.controller';
import { PaymentsController } from '../../modules/payments/payments.controller';

type Ctor = { prototype: Record<string, unknown>; name: string };

function rolesOf(controller: Ctor, method: string): UserRole[] | undefined {
  const handler = controller.prototype[method];
  if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new Error(`${controller.name}.${method} does not exist`);
  return Reflect.getMetadata(ROLES_KEY, handler);
}

/**
 * The four configuration areas the product owner restricted to admins
 * (AI agent, channels, webhooks, service prices). Every write is owner/admin
 * only; reads stay open because agents need them (capture-field labels,
 * channel badges, the payment-link service picker).
 */
const ADMIN_ONLY: Array<[Ctor, string[]]> = [
  [AIAgentsController, [
    'provisionAgent', 'configureFromBrief', 'updateIdentity', 'updatePersonality', 'updateRules',
    'updateStrategies', 'updateQualification', 'create', 'update', 'activate', 'deactivate',
    'reorderCaptureFields', 'createCaptureField', 'updateCaptureField', 'deleteCaptureField',
  ]],
  [AutomationAgentsController, ['create', 'update', 'deactivate']],
  [AutomationToolsController, ['create']],
  [ChannelsController, ['create', 'testConnection', 'update', 'deactivate', 'remove']],
  [WahaChannelController, ['createSession', 'getQr', 'requestPairingCode', 'relink', 'unlink']],
  [IntegrationsController, ['create', 'testWebhook', 'update', 'remove']],
  [PaymentServiceController, ['create', 'update', 'remove']],
];

const OPEN_READS: Array<[Ctor, string[]]> = [
  [AIAgentsController, ['getConfig', 'findAll', 'findOne', 'getCaptureFields']],
  [AutomationAgentsController, ['findAll']],
  [ChannelsController, ['findAll', 'findOne']],
  [PaymentServiceController, ['findAll']],
];

describe('admin-only configuration routes', () => {
  it.each(ADMIN_ONLY.flatMap(([c, methods]) => methods.map((m) => [c.name, m, c] as const)))(
    '%s.%s is owner/admin only',
    (_name, method, controller) => {
      expect(rolesOf(controller, method)).toEqual(ORG_ADMIN_ROLES);
    },
  );

  it.each(OPEN_READS.flatMap(([c, methods]) => methods.map((m) => [c.name, m, c] as const)))(
    '%s.%s stays readable by every role',
    (_name, method, controller) => {
      expect(rolesOf(controller, method)).toBeUndefined();
    },
  );

  it('lets agents see and resolve payments that need attention', () => {
    for (const method of ['findNeedingAttention', 'resolve']) {
      expect(rolesOf(PaymentsController as unknown as Ctor, method)).toEqual([
        UserRole.OWNER,
        UserRole.ADMIN,
        UserRole.AGENT,
      ]);
    }
  });
});
EOF

45 route checks pass. I'll add a direct RolesGuard check confirming that an agent and an API key really get 403 on these routes, while an owner and an admin get through.

bash
command:
cd /workspace/apps/api && cat >> src/common/decorators/admin-only.routes.spec.ts <<'EOF'

describe('RolesGuard on an @AdminOnly route', () => {
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-var-requires
  const { Reflector } = require('@nestjs/core');
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-var-requires
  const { RolesGuard } = require('../guards/roles.guard');
  const guard = new RolesGuard(new Reflector());
  const handler = ChannelsController.prototype.update;

  function contextFor(role: string) {
    return {
      getHandler: () => handler,
      getClass: () => ChannelsController,
      switchToHttp: () => ({ getRequest: () => ({ tenant: { organization_id: 'org', user_id: 'u', role } }) }),
    } as never;
  }

  it.each(['owner', 'admin'])('lets %s through', (role) => {
    expect(guard.canActivate(contextFor(role))).toBe(true);
  });

  it.each(['agent', 'viewer', 'api_key'])('rejects %s with 403', (role) => {
    expect(() => guard.canActivate(contextFor(role))).toThrow('Insufficient role');
  });
});
EOF

    expect(toPublicAutomationAgent({ ...base, auth_header_value: null } as AutomationAgentEntity).has_auth_header).toBe(false);
  });
});

/**
 * What the signed-in user may see and do in the web app. This mirrors the API
 * guards so we never show a button the API will reject. The API stays the real
 * barrier; this only keeps the UI honest.
 */
export interface PermissionSubject {
  role?: string | null;
  is_platform_admin?: boolean | null;
}

export interface Permissions {
  /** Owner or admin of the organization (or a platform admin). */
  isAdmin: boolean;
  /** AI agent, channels, webhooks, payment setup & prices (API: @AdminOnly). */
  canManageConfiguration: boolean;
  /** Admin area: team, billing, API keys. */
  canAccessAdmin: boolean;
  /** Payments that need a person after a failed booking (API: owner/admin/agent). */
  canResolvePaymentAttention: boolean;
  /** Book outside calendar rules and delete appointments (API: owner/admin users). */
  canOverrideCalendarRules: boolean;
}

const ORG_ADMIN_ROLES = new Set(['owner', 'admin']);

export function permissionsFor(user: PermissionSubject | null | undefined): Permissions {
  const role = user?.role ?? null;
  const isPlatformAdmin = user?.is_platform_admin === true;
  const isAdmin = isPlatformAdmin || (role !== null && ORG_ADMIN_ROLES.has(role));
  return {
    isAdmin,
    canManageConfiguration: isAdmin,
    canAccessAdmin: isAdmin,
    canResolvePaymentAttention: isAdmin || role === 'agent',
    canOverrideCalendarRules: isAdmin,
  };
}
EOF
cat > hooks/usePermissions.ts <<'EOF'
'use client';

import { useCurrentUser } from '@/hooks/useTeam';
import { permissionsFor, type Permissions } from '@/lib/permissions';

export interface UsePermissionsResult extends Permissions {
  /** True until the current user is known — callers should not decide yet. */
  isLoading: boolean;
  isError: boolean;
}

export function usePermissions(): UsePermissionsResult {
  const { data: user, isLoading, isError } = useCurrentUser();
  return { ...permissionsFor(user), isLoading, isError };
}

import { toast as sonnerToast } from 'sonner';
export type ToastVariant = 'default' | 'info' | 'ai' | 'error' | 'warning';
export interface ToastItem {
  id?: string;
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  variant?: ToastVariant;
  duration?: number;
  action?: { label: string; onClick: () => void };
}
export function toast(item: Omit<ToastItem, 'id'>) {
  const { title, description, variant = 'default', duration, action } = item;
  const opts = {
    description,
    duration,
    ...(action ? { action: { label: action.label, onClick: action.onClick } } : {}),
  };
  switch (variant) {
    case 'error':
      sonnerToast.error(title, opts);
      break;
    case 'info':
      sonnerToast.info(title, opts);
      break;
    case 'warning':
      sonnerToast.warning(title, opts);
      break;
    case 'ai':
      sonnerToast(title, opts);
      break;
    default:
      sonnerToast.success(title, opts);
      break;
  }
}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { usePermissions } from '@/hooks/usePermissions';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import type { Permissions } from '@/lib/permissions';

interface RoleGateProps {
  /** Which permission opens this area. */
  allow: (permissions: Permissions) => boolean;
  /** Where to send users who can't open it. */
  redirectTo?: string;
  /** Shown once when a signed-in user is sent away (not on load errors). */
  deniedMessage?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Page-level role guard. The API enforces the same rules; this only avoids
 * showing screens whose actions would all fail.
 */
export function RoleGate({ allow, redirectTo = '/', deniedMessage, children }: RoleGateProps) {
  const permissions = usePermissions();
  const router = useRouter();
  const notified = useRef(false);
  const hasAccess = allow(permissions);
  const decided = !permissions.isLoading;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!decided || hasAccess) return;
    if (deniedMessage && !permissions.isError && !notified.current) {
      notified.current = true;
      toast({ title: deniedMessage, variant: 'warning' });
    }
    router.replace(redirectTo);
  }, [decided, hasAccess, deniedMessage, permissions.isError, redirectTo, router]);

  if (!decided) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-64 items-center justify-center" role="status" aria-label="Loading">
        <div className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-accent/50 border-t-transparent" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!hasAccess) return null;
  return <>{children}</>;
}
EOF

'use client';

import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { RoleGate } from '@/components/layout/role-gate';

/**
 * AI agent, channels, webhooks and payment setup (Stripe + prices) are
 * owner/admin only — the API rejects every write from other roles. Agents who
 * land on payment setup (old links, bookmarks) go to the operational Payments
 * page, where they do have work to do.
 */
export default function AdminConfigLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const redirectTo = pathname.startsWith('/config/payments') ? '/payments' : '/';
  return (
    <RoleGate
      allow={(p) => p.canManageConfiguration}
      redirectTo={redirectTo}
      deniedMessage="Only admins can change this configuration"
    >
      {children}
    </RoleGate>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import {
  Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { usePaymentsNeedingAttention, useResolvePayment } from '@/hooks/usePayments';
import { schedulingService } from '@/services/scheduling.service';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import type { Payment, PaymentResolution } from '@/services/payments.service';
const REASONS: Record<string, string> = {
  slot_unavailable: 'Paid, but the time was taken before the payment arrived',
  appointment_cancelled: 'The paid appointment was cancelled',
  booking_failed: 'Paid, but the appointment could not be created',
};
function money(cents: number, currency: string): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: (currency || 'usd').toUpperCase() }).format(cents / 100);
}
function who(p: Payment): string {
  if (p.contact) return [p.contact.first_name, p.contact.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
  return p.contact_name ?? 'Deleted contact';
}
/** The contact's upcoming, unpaid bookings the payment can be moved to. */
function useRebookOptions(contactId: string | null) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['appointments', 'rebook-options', contactId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const page = await schedulingService.getAppointments({
        contact_id: contactId!,
        from: new Date().toISOString(),
        sort: 'asc',
        limit: 50,
      });
      return page.items.filter((a) => ['scheduled', 'confirmed'].includes(a.status) && !a.payment_id);
    },
    enabled: !!contactId,
  });
}
function AttentionRow({ payment }: { payment: Payment }) {
  const resolve = useResolvePayment();
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const [appointmentId, setAppointmentId] = useState('');
  const { data: options = [] } = useRebookOptions(payment.contact_id);
  const submit = async (resolution: PaymentResolution) => {
    try {
      await resolve.mutateAsync({
        id: payment.id,
        body: {
          resolution,
          ...(note.trim() ? { note: note.trim() } : {}),
          ...(resolution === 'rebooked' ? { appointment_id: appointmentId } : {}),
        },
      });
      toast({ title: 'Payment resolved' });
    } catch (err) {
      toast({ title: (err as Error)?.message || 'Could not resolve the payment', variant: 'error' });
    }
  };
  return (
    <li className="rounded-xl border border-danger/30 bg-surface p-4 space-y-3" data-testid={`attention-${payment.id}`}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-primary">
            {who(payment)} · {money(payment.amount, payment.currency)}
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-danger">{REASONS[payment.attention_reason ?? ''] ?? payment.attention_reason}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted">{payment.service?.name ?? 'Service'} · paid {payment.paid_at ? new Date(payment.paid_at).toLocaleString() : ''}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Input placeholder="Note (optional): what was agreed with the contact" value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Select value={appointmentId} onValueChange={setAppointmentId}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-64 bg-surface text-primary" aria-label="Appointment for this payment">
            <SelectValue placeholder={options.length ? 'Choose the new appointment' : 'Book one in the agenda first'} />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {options.map((a) => (
              <SelectItem key={a.id} value={a.id}>
                {a.title} · {new Date(a.starts_at).toLocaleString()}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <Button size="sm" disabled={!appointmentId || resolve.isPending} onClick={() => submit('rebooked')}>
          Rebooked
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={resolve.isPending} onClick={() => submit('refunded_manually')}>
          Refunded in Stripe
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={resolve.isPending} onClick={() => submit('dismissed')}>
          Dismiss
        </Button>
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}
/** Paid payments a person has to follow up. Nothing is refunded automatically. */
export function AttentionTab() {
  const { data: payments = [], isLoading } = usePaymentsNeedingAttention();
  if (isLoading) return <p className="text-sm text-secondary">Loading…</p>;
  if (!payments.length) {
    return <p className="text-sm text-secondary">Nothing to review. Paid bookings that need a person will show up here.</p>;
  }
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <p className="text-xs text-secondary">
        Refunds are never automatic: refund in your Stripe dashboard if needed, then mark it here.
      </p>
      <ul className="space-y-3">
        {payments.map((p) => (
          <AttentionRow key={p.id} payment={p} />
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  paymentsService,
  type UpdatePaymentSettingsBody,
  type CreatePaymentServiceBody,
  type UpdatePaymentServiceBody,
} from '@/services/payments.service';
// ── Settings ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function usePaymentSettings() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['payment-settings'],
    queryFn: () => paymentsService.getSettings(),
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}
export function useUpdatePaymentSettings() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (body: UpdatePaymentSettingsBody) => paymentsService.updateSettings(body),
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['payment-settings'] }),
  });
}
// ── Services ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function usePaymentServices() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['payment-services'],
    queryFn: () => paymentsService.getServices(),
    staleTime: 15_000,
  });
}
export function useCreatePaymentService() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (body: CreatePaymentServiceBody) => paymentsService.createService(body),
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['payment-services'] }),
  });
}
export function useUpdatePaymentService() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, body }: { id: string; body: UpdatePaymentServiceBody }) =>
      paymentsService.updateService(id, body),
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['payment-services'] }),
  });
}
export function useDeletePaymentService() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => paymentsService.deleteService(id),
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['payment-services'] }),
  });
}
// ── Payments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function usePayments(contactId?: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['payments', contactId],
    queryFn: () => paymentsService.getPayments(contactId),
    staleTime: 15_000,
  });
}
export function useCreatePayment() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (body: Parameters<typeof paymentsService.createPayment>[0]) => paymentsService.createPayment(body),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['payments'] });
      // A payment link with a booking holds the slot on the agenda.
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['appointments'] });
    },
  });
}
export function usePaymentsNeedingAttention(enabled = true) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['payments', 'attention'],
    queryFn: () => paymentsService.getPaymentsNeedingAttention(),
    enabled,
    staleTime: 15_000,
  });
}
export function useResolvePayment() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, body }: { id: string; body: Parameters<typeof paymentsService.resolvePayment>[1] }) =>
      paymentsService.resolvePayment(id, body),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['payments'] });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['appointments'] });
    },
  });
}

'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function leadHref(contactId: string): string {
  return `/inbox?lead=${encodeURIComponent(contactId)}`;
}

interface LeadChipProps {
  contactId: string | null | undefined;
  name: string;
  secondary?: string | null;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * A contact name that opens the lead where leads are worked: the Inbox.
 * Deleted contacts (no id) render as plain text.
 */
export function LeadChip({ contactId, name, secondary, className }: LeadChipProps) {
  const body = (
    <>
      <span className="block truncate font-medium text-primary">{name}</span>
      {secondary && <span className="block truncate text-xs text-muted">{secondary}</span>}
    </>
  );
  if (!contactId) return <span className={cn('min-w-0', className)}>{body}</span>;
  return (
    <Link
      href={leadHref(contactId)}
      className={cn('group block min-w-0 rounded-sm hover:[&>span:first-child]:text-accent', className)}
      title={`Open ${name} in the Inbox`}
    >
      {body}
    </Link>
  );
}

'use client';

import { Suspense } from 'react';
import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Settings2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { TransactionsTab } from '@/components/payments/TransactionsTab';
import { AttentionTab } from '@/components/payments/AttentionTab';
import { usePaymentsNeedingAttention } from '@/hooks/usePayments';
import { usePermissions } from '@/hooks/usePermissions';

type PaymentsTab = 'transactions' | 'attention';

function PaymentsContent() {
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { canResolvePaymentAttention, canManageConfiguration } = usePermissions();
  const { data: attention = [] } = usePaymentsNeedingAttention(canResolvePaymentAttention);

  const requested = params.get('tab');
  const tab: PaymentsTab =
    requested === 'attention' && canResolvePaymentAttention ? 'attention' : 'transactions';

  const selectTab = (next: string) => {
    const qs = new URLSearchParams(params.toString());
    qs.set('tab', next);
    router.replace(`${pathname}?${qs.toString()}`, { scroll: false });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-primary">Payments</h1>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-secondary">
            Payment links sent to contacts, what was paid, and paid bookings that need a person.
          </p>
        </div>
        {canManageConfiguration && (
          <Link
            href="/config/payments"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control border border-subtle px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-secondary transition-colors hover:border-strong hover:text-primary"
          >
            <Settings2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Stripe & services
          </Link>
        )}
      </div>

      <Tabs value={tab} onValueChange={selectTab}>
        <TabsList className="mb-5">
          <TabsTrigger value="transactions">Transactions</TabsTrigger>
          {canResolvePaymentAttention && (
            <TabsTrigger value="attention">
              Needs attention{attention.length ? ` (${attention.length})` : ''}
            </TabsTrigger>
          )}
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="transactions">
          <TransactionsTab />
        </TabsContent>

        {canResolvePaymentAttention && (
          <TabsContent value="attention">
            <AttentionTab />
          </TabsContent>
        )}
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PaymentsPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <PaymentsContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

'use client';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { SidebarItem } from './sidebar-item';
import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';
export interface SidebarNavItem {
  label: string;
  href: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  exact?: boolean;
}
export interface SidebarSectionProps {
  title: string;
  items: SidebarNavItem[];
  collapsed: boolean;
}
export function SidebarSection({ title, items, collapsed }: SidebarSectionProps) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  return (
    <div className="space-y-0.5">
      {!collapsed && title ? (
        <p className="px-2.5 pb-1 pt-3 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted select-none">
          {title}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {collapsed && (
        <div className="mx-2 my-1 border-t border-subtle" />
      )}
      {items.map((item) => {
        const active = item.exact
          ? pathname === item.href
          : pathname === item.href || pathname.startsWith(item.href + '/');
        return (
          <SidebarItem
            key={item.href}
            label={item.label}
            href={item.href}
            icon={item.icon}
            active={active}
            collapsed={collapsed}
            exact={item.exact}
          />
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

];
export const ADMIN_ITEMS: NavItem[] = [
  { label: 'Panel', href: '/admin', icon: BarChart, exact: true, requires: 'canAccessAdmin' },
  { label: 'Team', href: '/admin/team', icon: Users, requires: 'canAccessAdmin' },
  { label: 'Billing', href: '/admin/billing', icon: CreditCard, requires: 'canAccessAdmin' },
];
export function isNavItemVisible(item: NavItem, permissions: Permissions): boolean {
  return !item.requires || permissions[item.requires] === true;
}
export function visibleItems(items: NavItem[], permissions: Permissions): NavItem[] {
  return items.filter((item) => isNavItemVisible(item, permissions));
}
export function visibleGroups(groups: NavGroup[], permissions: Permissions): NavGroup[] {
  return groups
    .map((group) => ({ ...group, items: visibleItems(group.items, permissions) }))
    .filter((group) => group.items.length > 0);
}
export const SETTINGS_ITEMS: NavItem[] = SETTINGS_GROUPS.flatMap((group) => group.items);
export function navItemMatchesPath(pathname: string, item: SidebarNavItem): boolean {
  if (item.exact) return pathname === item.href;
  return pathname === item.href || pathname.startsWith(item.href + '/');
}
export function isConfigurationPath(pathname: string): boolean {
  return SETTINGS_ITEMS.some((item) => navItemMatchesPath(pathname, item));
}
export function isAdminPath(pathname: string): boolean {
  return ADMIN_ITEMS.some((item) => navItemMatchesPath(pathname, item)) && !isConfigurationPath(pathname);
}

      onSelect={() => onSelect(item.href)}

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setOpen((o) => !o);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handler);
  }, []);
  const navigate = (href: string) => {
    router.push(href);
    setOpen(false);
  };
  const mainItems = platformOnly ? PLATFORM_ITEMS : visibleItems(MAIN_ITEMS, permissions);
  const settingsItems = platformOnly ? [] : visibleGroups(SETTINGS_GROUPS, permissions).flatMap((g) => g.items);
  const adminItems = platformOnly ? [] : visibleItems(ADMIN_ITEMS, permissions);
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogContent className="p-0 gap-0 max-w-lg overflow-hidden" aria-describedby={undefined}>
        <DialogTitle className="sr-only">Command palette</DialogTitle>
        <Command>
          <CommandInput placeholder="Go to…" />
          <CommandList>
            <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
            <CommandGroup heading="Navigate">
              {mainItems.map((item) => (
                <NavCommandItem key={item.href} item={item} onSelect={navigate} />
              ))}
            </CommandGroup>
            {settingsItems.length > 0 && (
              <CommandGroup heading="Settings">
                {settingsItems.map((item) => (
                  <NavCommandItem key={item.href} item={item} onSelect={navigate} />
                ))}
              </CommandGroup>
            )}
            {adminItems.length > 0 && (
              <CommandGroup heading="Admin">
                {adminItems.map((item) => (
                  <NavCommandItem key={item.href} item={item} onSelect={navigate} />
                ))}
              </CommandGroup>
            )}
          </CommandList>
        </Command>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

One correction before wiring these. The API checks the org role only (tenant.role), and a platform admin keeps their own role while impersonating. So the configuration and calendar-override permissions must depend on the org role alone, otherwise the UI could show buttons the API rejects. Only Admin-area access keeps the platform-admin exception, as it did before.

  const role = user?.role ?? null;
  const isPlatformAdmin = user?.is_platform_admin === true;
  // The API guards check the organization role only (tenant.role). A platform
  // admin keeps their own role while impersonating, so configuration rights
  // must follow the org role too, or we'd show buttons the API rejects.
  const isOrgAdmin = role !== null && ORG_ADMIN_ROLES.has(role);
  return {
    isAdmin: isOrgAdmin || isPlatformAdmin,
    canManageConfiguration: isOrgAdmin,
    canAccessAdmin: isOrgAdmin || isPlatformAdmin,
    canResolvePaymentAttention: isOrgAdmin || role === 'agent',
    canOverrideCalendarRules: isOrgAdmin,

}

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { NextRequest } from 'next/server';

const auth = vi.hoisted(() => ({ user: null as null | { id: string } }));

vi.mock('@supabase/ssr', () => ({
  createServerClient: () => ({
    auth: { getUser: async () => ({ data: { user: auth.user } }) },
  }),
}));

import { middleware } from './middleware';

function run(path: string) {
  return middleware(new NextRequest(new URL(path, 'https://app.example.com')));
}

function redirectTarget(res: Response): string | null {
  const location = res.headers.get('location');
  return location ? new URL(location).pathname : null;
}

describe('middleware', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    auth.user = null;
  });

  it.each(['/forgot-password', '/reset-password?token=abc', '/accept-invite?token=x'])(
    'lets a signed-out visitor open %s (password reset must work from the email link)',
    async (path) => {
      expect(redirectTarget(await run(path))).toBeNull();
    },
  );

  it('keeps the reset page reachable for a signed-in user too', async () => {
    auth.user = { id: 'u1' };
    expect(redirectTarget(await run('/reset-password?token=abc'))).toBeNull();
  });

  it('sends signed-out visitors of app pages to /login', async () => {
    expect(redirectTarget(await run('/inbox'))).toBe('/login');
  });

  it('sends signed-in users away from /login', async () => {
    auth.user = { id: 'u1' };
    expect(redirectTarget(await run('/login'))).toBe('/');
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { permissionsFor } from '@/lib/permissions';
import {
  ADMIN_ITEMS,
  MAIN_ITEMS,
  SETTINGS_GROUPS,
  isAdminPath,
  isConfigurationPath,
  visibleGroups,
  visibleItems,
} from './sidebar-nav';

const hrefs = (groups: ReturnType<typeof visibleGroups>) => groups.flatMap((g) => g.items.map((i) => i.href));

describe('sidebar navigation by role', () => {
  it('shows an agent only the settings they may change', () => {
    const agent = permissionsFor({ role: 'agent' });
    const groups = visibleGroups(SETTINGS_GROUPS, agent);
    expect(hrefs(groups)).toEqual(['/config/sequences', '/templates', '/config/communications']);
    expect(groups.map((g) => g.label)).toEqual(['Automation', 'Messaging']);
    expect(visibleItems(ADMIN_ITEMS, agent)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('shows an admin every settings group and the admin area', () => {
    const admin = permissionsFor({ role: 'admin' });
    expect(visibleGroups(SETTINGS_GROUPS, admin).map((g) => g.label)).toEqual([
      'AI Agent',
      'Automation',
      'Messaging',
      'Payments setup',
      'Connections',
    ]);
    expect(hrefs(visibleGroups(SETTINGS_GROUPS, admin))).toContain('/config/channels');
    expect(visibleItems(ADMIN_ITEMS, admin).map((i) => i.label)).toEqual(['Panel', 'Team', 'Billing']);
  });

  it('gives every role the operational Payments page', () => {
    for (const role of ['owner', 'admin', 'agent']) {
      expect(visibleItems(MAIN_ITEMS, permissionsFor({ role })).map((i) => i.href)).toContain('/payments');
    }
  });

  it('knows which area a path belongs to', () => {
    expect(isConfigurationPath('/config/channels')).toBe(true);
    expect(isConfigurationPath('/admin/api-keys')).toBe(true);
    expect(isAdminPath('/admin/api-keys')).toBe(false);
    expect(isAdminPath('/admin/team')).toBe(true);
    expect(isConfigurationPath('/payments')).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { http, HttpResponse } from 'msw';
import { expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { server } from './server';
import { TEST_ACCESS_TOKEN } from '../supabase';
export const API_BASE = 'http://api.test/api/v1';
type Method = 'get' | 'post' | 'put' | 'patch' | 'delete';
export interface CapturedRequest {
  method: string;
  url: URL;
  headers: Headers;
  body: unknown;
}
interface MockApiOptions {
  data?: unknown;
  status?: number;
  message?: string;
  /** Structured error details, as the API's exception filter returns them. */
  errors?: Record<string, unknown>;
}
async function readBody(request: Request): Promise<unknown> {
  const type = request.headers.get('content-type') ?? '';
  if (type.startsWith('multipart/form-data')) return request.formData();
  const text = await request.text();
  return text ? JSON.parse(text) : undefined;
}
/**
 * Registers a one-off handler for `method path` that replies with the API's
 * `{ data }` envelope (or an error / 204) and records every matching request.
 */
export function mockApi(method: Method, path: string, options: MockApiOptions = {}) {
  const { data = null, status = 200, message = 'Request failed', errors } = options;
  const calls: CapturedRequest[] = [];
  server.use(
    http[method](`${API_BASE}${path}`, async ({ request }) => {
      calls.push({
        method: request.method,
        url: new URL(request.url),
        headers: request.headers,
        body: await readBody(request),
      });
      if (status === 204) return new HttpResponse(null, { status });
      if (status >= 400) return HttpResponse.json({ message, ...(errors ? { errors } : {}) }, { status });
      return HttpResponse.json({ data }, { status });
    }),
  );
  return calls;
}
export interface EndpointCase {
  name: string;
  call: () => Promise<unknown>;
  method: Method;
  path: string;
  query?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: unknown;
}
/**
 * One test per endpoint: the request must hit `method path` with exactly the
 * expected query params and JSON body, carry the bearer token, and the
 * service must resolve with the unwrapped `data` of the response.
 */
export function itCallsEndpoints(cases: EndpointCase[]) {
  it.each(cases)('$name → $method $path', async ({ call, method, path, query = {}, body }) => {
    const response = { id: 'response-sentinel' };
    const calls = mockApi(method, path, { data: response });
    await expect(call()).resolves.toEqual(response);
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
    const [request] = calls;
    expect(Object.fromEntries(request.url.searchParams)).toEqual(query);
    expect(request.body).toEqual(body);
    expect(request.headers.get('authorization')).toBe(`Bearer ${TEST_ACCESS_TOKEN}`);
  });
}
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
export function createTestQueryClient() {
  return new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: {
      queries: { retry: false, gcTime: Infinity },
      mutations: { retry: false },
    },
  });
}
export function createQueryWrapper(queryClient = createTestQueryClient()) {
  function QueryWrapper({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
    return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
  }
  return { queryClient, wrapper: QueryWrapper };
}

import {
  Controller, Get, Post, Patch, Body, Param, Query,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags, ApiBearerAuth } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import {
  ConversationManagementService,
  CreateConversationDto,
  SendMessageDto,
} from './conversation-management.service';
import { CurrentTenant } from '../../common/decorators/current-tenant.decorator';
import type { TenantContext, PaginationQuery } from '@crm/shared';
import { CheckPlanLimit } from '../billing/billing-access.decorators';
@ApiTags('conversations')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@Controller({ path: 'conversations', version: '1' })
export class ConversationManagementController {
  constructor(private readonly service: ConversationManagementService) {}
  @Get()
  findAll(
    @Query() query: PaginationQuery & { status?: string; channel?: string; assigned_to?: 'ai' | 'human' },
    @CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext,
  ) {
    return this.service.findAll(tenant.organization_id, query);
  }
  @Get(':id')
  findOne(@Param('id') id: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext) {
    return this.service.findById(id, tenant.organization_id);
  }
  @Get(':id/messages')
  getMessages(@Param('id') id: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext) {
    return this.service.getMessages(id, tenant.organization_id);
  }
  @Post()
  @CheckPlanLimit('conversations')
  create(@Body() dto: CreateConversationDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext) {
    return this.service.create(tenant.organization_id, dto);
  }
  @Post(':id/messages')
  @CheckPlanLimit('messages')
  sendMessage(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() dto: SendMessageDto,
    @CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext,
  ) {
    return this.service.sendMessage(id, tenant.organization_id, dto);
  }
  @Patch(':id/resolve')
  resolve(@Param('id') id: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext) {
    return this.service.resolve(id, tenant.organization_id);
  }
  @Post(':id/handoff')
  handoff(@Param('id') id: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext) {
    return this.service.handoff(id, tenant.organization_id);
  }
  @Patch(':id/pin')
  setPinned(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() dto: { pinned: boolean },
    @CurrentTenant() tenant: TenantContext,
  ) {
    return this.service.setPinned(id, tenant.organization_id, dto.pinned);
  }
}

import {
  ExceptionFilter,
  Catch,
  ArgumentsHost,
  HttpException,
  HttpStatus,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
@Catch()
export class GlobalExceptionFilter implements ExceptionFilter {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(GlobalExceptionFilter.name);
  catch(exception: unknown, host: ArgumentsHost): void {
    const ctx = host.switchToHttp();
    const response = ctx.getResponse<Response>();
    const request = ctx.getRequest<Request>();
    let status = HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;
    let message = 'Internal server error';
    let errors: unknown = undefined;
    if (exception instanceof HttpException) {
      status = exception.getStatus();
      const exceptionResponse = exception.getResponse();
      if (typeof exceptionResponse === 'string') {
        message = exceptionResponse;
      } else if (typeof exceptionResponse === 'object' && exceptionResponse !== null) {
        const resp = exceptionResponse as Record<string, unknown>;
        message = (resp['message'] as string) ?? message;
        errors = resp['errors'];
      }
    } else if (exception instanceof Error) {
      message = exception.message;
      this.logger.error(exception.message, exception.stack);
    }
    if (status >= 500) {
      this.logger.error(
        `[${request.method}] ${request.url} — ${status}: ${message}`,
      );
    }
    response.status(status).json({
      statusCode: status,
      message,
      ...(errors ? { errors } : {}),
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      path: request.url,
    });
  }
}

import { ConflictException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { TenantContext } from '@crm/shared';
/**
 * Who is writing into a conversation. Decides whether the write is allowed
 * (AI and humans never talk at the same time) and how the message is labelled.
 *
 *  - human:      a signed-in user of the CRM (web app).
 *  - ai:         the AI side — ProSales / n8n through an API key or the
 *                `send_message` tool.
 *  - automation: scheduled follow-up steps (sequence engine).
 */
export type MessageActor =
  | { kind: 'human'; userId: string | null }
  | { kind: 'ai' }
  | { kind: 'automation' };
export const AI_ACTOR: MessageActor = { kind: 'ai' };
export const AUTOMATION_ACTOR: MessageActor = { kind: 'automation' };
export const CONTROL_ERROR_CODES = {
  AI_HAS_CONTROL: 'AI_HAS_CONTROL',
  HUMAN_HAS_CONTROL: 'HUMAN_HAS_CONTROL',
} as const;
/** Conversation states in which the lead is still being worked. */
export const CLOSED_CONVERSATION_STATUSES = ['resolved', 'closed', 'archived'] as const;
export function isConversationActive(status: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  return !CLOSED_CONVERSATION_STATUSES.includes((status ?? 'open') as (typeof CLOSED_CONVERSATION_STATUSES)[number]);
}
/** API keys are integrations (n8n / ProSales): the AI side. Everyone else is a person. */
export function actorFromTenant(tenant: TenantContext): MessageActor {
  if (tenant.role === 'api_key') return AI_ACTOR;
  return { kind: 'human', userId: tenant.user_id ?? null };
}
/**
 * The single rule of the inbox: while the AI has control only the AI (and its
 * automations) may write; while a human has control the AI stays silent.
 * Inbound messages (the customer writing) are always accepted.
 */
export function assertMaySend(botActive: boolean, actor: MessageActor, direction: string = 'outbound'): void {
  if (direction === 'inbound') return;
  if (actor.kind === 'human' && botActive) {
    throw new ConflictException({
      message: 'The AI is handling this conversation. Take over before replying.',
      errors: { code: CONTROL_ERROR_CODES.AI_HAS_CONTROL },
    });
  }
  if (actor.kind !== 'human' && !botActive) {
    throw new ConflictException({
      message: 'A person is handling this conversation; automated replies are paused until it is returned to the AI.',
      errors: { code: CONTROL_ERROR_CODES.HUMAN_HAS_CONTROL },
    });
  }
}
/** How a message is labelled in the thread, from who wrote it. */
export function senderTypeFor(actor: MessageActor, direction: string = 'outbound'): string {
  if (direction === 'inbound') return 'user';
  return actor.kind === 'human' ? 'agent' : 'ai';
}

  async sendMessage(

s=s.replace(old,"""  /**
   * Hands a conversation between the AI and a person. Control is per lead:
   * the new state applies to every active conversation of the same contact,
   * so a lead taken over on one channel is never answered by the AI on
   * another. `botActive` sets the state explicitly (idempotent, used by the
   * web app); without it the call toggles, as integrations have always used it.
   */
  async handoff(
    id: string,
    organizationId: string,
    botActive?: boolean,
    actor?: MessageActor,
  ): Promise<ConversationEntity> {
    const conv = await this.conversationRepo.findOne({ where: { id, organization_id: organizationId } });
    if (!conv) throw new NotFoundException(`Conversation ${id} not found`);
    const next = typeof botActive === 'boolean' ? botActive : !conv.bot_active;

    await this.setLeadControl(organizationId, conv.contact_id, next, actor, [conv.id]);
    conv.bot_active = next;
    return conv;
  }

  /** Current AI/human state of a lead, with the conversations it covers. */
  async getLeadControl(organizationId: string, contactId: string): Promise<LeadControlState> {
    const conversations = await this.activeConversationsOf(organizationId, contactId);
    return {
      contact_id: contactId,
      bot_active: !conversations.some((c) => c.bot_active === false),
      conversations,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Sets who handles a lead on all its active conversations (plus any extra
   * conversation ids, e.g. the resolved one a handoff was called on).
   */
  async setLeadControl(
    organizationId: string,
    contactId: string,
    botActive: boolean,
    actor?: MessageActor,
    alsoConversationIds: string[] = [],
  ): Promise<LeadControlState> {
    const active = await this.activeConversationsOf(organizationId, contactId);
    const ids = [...new Set([...active.map((c) => c.id), ...alsoConversationIds])];
    const changed = [
      ...active.filter((c) => c.bot_active !== botActive).map((c) => c.id),
      ...alsoConversationIds.filter((cid) => !active.some((c) => c.id === cid)),
    ];

    if (ids.length) {
      await this.conversationRepo.update(
        { organization_id: organizationId, id: In(ids) },
        { bot_active: botActive },
      );
    }

    for (const conversationId of new Set(changed)) {
      this.rmqClient.emit(RABBITMQ_QUEUES.CONVERSATION_ASSIGN, {
        conversation_id: conversationId,
        organization_id: organizationId,
        bot_active: botActive,
      });
    }

    // The AI escalating to a person: make sure someone notices.
    if (!botActive && changed.length > 0 && actor?.kind === 'ai') {
      void this.notifyHumanNeeded(organizationId, contactId, active[0]?.id ?? alsoConversationIds[0]);
    }

    return this.getLeadControl(organizationId, contactId);
  }

  /**
   * True when a person has taken over the lead — the AI must stay silent.
   * Checks the conversation itself and every active conversation of the lead.
   */
  async isUnderHumanControl(
    organizationId: string,
    ref: { conversationId?: string | null; contactId?: string | null },
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    let contactId = ref.contactId ?? null;
    if (ref.conversationId) {
      const conv = await this.conversationRepo.findOne({
        where: { id: ref.conversationId, organization_id: organizationId },
        select: ['id', 'contact_id', 'bot_active'],
      });
      if (conv?.bot_active === false) return true;
      contactId = contactId ?? conv?.contact_id ?? null;
    }
    if (!contactId) return false;
    const humanOwned = await this.conversationRepo.count({
      where: {
        organization_id: organizationId,
        contact_id: contactId,
        bot_active: false,
        status: Not(In([...CLOSED_CONVERSATION_STATUSES])),
      },
    });
    return humanOwned > 0;
  }

  private activeConversationsOf(organizationId: string, contactId: string): Promise<ConversationEntity[]> {
    return this.conversationRepo.find({
      where: {
        organization_id: organizationId,
        contact_id: contactId,
        status: Not(In([...CLOSED_CONVERSATION_STATUSES])),
      },
      order: { last_message_at: 'DESC' },
    });
  }

  private async notifyHumanNeeded(organizationId: string, contactId: string, conversationId?: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const [contact] = await this.clientService.findByIds([contactId], organizationId);
      const name = contact ? `${contact.first_name} ${contact.last_name ?? ''}`.trim() : '';
      await this.realtimeBroadcast?.notifyOrg(organizationId, {
        type: 'message',
        title: `${name || 'A lead'} needs a person`,
        description: 'The AI handed this conversation over. It will stay silent until you return it.',
        href: `/inbox?lead=${contactId}`,
        conversationId,
        contactId,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.warn(`Could not notify human handover for contact ${contactId}: ${(err as Error).message}`);
    }
  }

""")

    @Optional() private readonly notifyAgentHandler?: NotifyAgentHandler,
    @Optional() private readonly createTaskHandler?: CreateTaskHandler,
    @Optional() private readonly callHandler?: CallHandler,
    @Optional() private readonly billingAccess?: BillingAccessService,

      return;
    }

      // (call → message with no webhook) and the channel the resolver picked

      if (appt.sequence_id) {
        void this.sequenceService.recordStepOutcome(

          appt.metadata?.attempt as number | undefined,
          result.executedAction ?? appt.action,

      }
      if (result.completed) {
        await this.actions.markCompleted(appt.organization_id, appointmentId, result.channel ?? resolved?.channel);
        // If sequence appointment, advance or complete
        if (appt.sequence_id) {
          await this.sequenceService.advanceOrComplete(appt.organization_id, appt.sequence_id);
        }
        try {
          this.rmqClient?.emit(RABBITMQ_QUEUES.FOLLOW_UP_COMPLETED, {
            organization_id: appt.organization_id,
            appointment_id: appt.id,
            contact_id: appt.contact_id,
            action: appt.action,
            channel: result.channel ?? resolved?.channel,
          });
        } catch { /* no consumer registered yet */ }
        this.realtimeService?.broadcastToOrg(appt.organization_id, 'follow_up_completed', {
          appointment_id: appt.id,
          action: appt.action,
          contact_id: appt.contact_id,
        }).catch(() => {});
      }
      // If !result.completed → appointment stays in 'processing'.
      // n8n will complete via complete_follow_up tool.
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      await this.failStep(appt, errorMessage);
      try {
        this.rmqClient?.emit(RABBITMQ_QUEUES.FOLLOW_UP_FAILED, {
          organization_id: appt.organization_id,
          appointment_id: appt.id,
          contact_id: appt.contact_id,
          action: appt.action,
          error: errorMessage,
        });
      } catch { /* no consumer registered yet */ }
    }
  }
  /**
   * A retry keeps the same appointment as the sequence trigger. Once retries
   * are exhausted the step is over, so the sequence must schedule the next
   * agenda or close. Leaving it active with no appointment drops the cadence.
   */
  /** Leaves the step to a person and tells the team it is due. */
  private async handOver(step: ScheduledActionEntity): Promise<void> {
    const moved = await this.actions.markAwaitingUser(step.organization_id, step.id);
    if (!moved) return;
    const contact = await this.contactRepo.findOne({ where: { id: step.contact_id }, select: ['id', 'first_name', 'last_name'] });
    const name = [contact?.first_name, contact?.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'a contact';
    await this.realtimeService
      ?.notifyOrg(step.organization_id, {
        type: 'system',
        title: `Follow-up due: ${step.title}`,
        description: `${name} — mark it done in the agenda when finished`,
        href: '/schedule',
        contactId: step.contact_id,
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    this.logger.log(`Follow-up step ${step.id} handed to the team (${step.action})`);
  }
  private async failStep(appt: { id: string; organization_id: string; sequence_id?: string | null }, error: string): Promise<void> {
    const outcome = await this.actions.markFailed(appt.organization_id, appt.id, error);
    if (outcome === 'failed' && appt.sequence_id) {
      await this.sequenceService.advanceOrComplete(appt.organization_id, appt.sequence_id);
    }
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger, OnModuleDestroy, OnModuleInit, Inject } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Worker, Job } from 'bullmq';
import { MessageEntity } from './message.entity';
import { ChannelsService } from '../integrations/channels.service';
import { ClientManagementService } from '../client-management/client-management.service';
import { SmsService } from '../../infrastructure/sms/sms.service';
import { WahaService } from '../../infrastructure/waha/waha.service';
import { OUTBOUND_DISPATCH_QUEUE, OUTBOUND_DISPATCH_QUEUE_NAME } from './outbound-dispatch.constants';
// This app connects Instagram via "Instagram API with Instagram Login" (IGAA-
// prefixed token, tied to the IG professional account itself — graph.instagram.com)
// and Facebook via a Page-linked token (EAA-prefixed, graph.facebook.com). The
// two products are NOT interchangeable: an IGAA token against graph.facebook.com
// fails with "(#3) Application does not have the capability to make this API
// call" (looks like a permissions/App-Review issue but isn't — it's just the
// wrong host), and either token type against the other host fails to parse.
// Confirmed 2026-09-29 directly against Graph API with the real channel
// tokens: the IGAA token gets a clean 200 from graph.instagram.com/me.
const INSTAGRAM_MESSAGES_URL = 'https://graph.instagram.com/v21.0/me/messages';
const FACEBOOK_MESSAGES_URL = (pageId: string) => `https://graph.facebook.com/v24.0/${pageId}/messages`;
/** Meta's Send API text limits — Instagram rejects the whole call over 1000 chars, Messenger over 2000. */
const INSTAGRAM_MAX_LEN = 1000;
const FACEBOOK_MAX_LEN = 2000;
/**
 * Splits long AI-generated replies into several messages instead of letting
 * Meta reject the whole send with a 400. Breaks on paragraph/sentence/space
 * boundaries so a word is never cut in half; only hard-cuts if a single
 * "word" alone exceeds maxLen.
 */
function splitForMeta(content: string, maxLen: number): string[] {
  if (content.length <= maxLen) return [content];
  const chunks: string[] = [];
  let remaining = content.trim();
  while (remaining.length > maxLen) {
    let cut = remaining.lastIndexOf('\n\n', maxLen);
    if (cut < maxLen * 0.5) cut = remaining.lastIndexOf('\n', maxLen);
    if (cut < maxLen * 0.5) cut = remaining.lastIndexOf(' ', maxLen);
    if (cut < 1) cut = maxLen; // no good boundary — hard cut
    chunks.push(remaining.slice(0, cut).trim());
    remaining = remaining.slice(cut).trim();
  }
  if (remaining) chunks.push(remaining);
  return chunks;
}

  private readonly logger = new Logger(OutboundDispatchProcessor.name);
  private worker: Worker;
  constructor(
    private readonly configService: ConfigService,
    private readonly channelsService: ChannelsService,

    @InjectRepository(MessageEntity)
    private readonly messageRepo: Repository<MessageEntity>,
    @Inject(OUTBOUND_DISPATCH_QUEUE) private readonly _queue: unknown,
  ) {}
  onModuleInit() {
    const host = this.configService.get<string>('redis.host', 'localhost');
    const port = this.configService.get<number>('redis.port', 6379);
    const password = this.configService.get<string>('redis.password', '');
    this.worker = new Worker(
      OUTBOUND_DISPATCH_QUEUE_NAME,
      async (job: Job<OutboundDispatchJobData>) => this.process(job),
      {
        connection: { host, port, password: password || undefined },
        concurrency: 10,
      },
    );
    this.worker.on('failed', (job, err) => {
      this.logger.error(`OutboundDispatch job ${job?.id} failed: ${err.message}`, err.stack);
      // BullMQ only emits 'failed' once attempts are exhausted (a retry that
      // still has attempts left goes back to 'delayed', not 'failed') — safe
      // to mark the message as permanently failed here rather than leaving
      // it at 'pending' forever with no way to tell "not tried yet" apart
      // from "gave up after 3 attempts".
      const messageId = job?.data?.messageId;
      if (messageId) {
        this.messageRepo
          .update({ id: messageId }, { status: 'failed' })
          .catch((updateErr) =>
            this.logger.error(`Failed to mark message ${messageId} as failed: ${updateErr.message}`),
          );
      }
    });
    this.worker.on('error', (err) => {
      // Connection-level errors (e.g. Redis unreachable) — distinct from a
      // job failing. Without this, a broken Redis connection right after
      // deploy fails silently: no job ever reaches process(), so nothing
      // above ever logs either.
      this.logger.error(`OutboundDispatch worker connection error: ${err.message}`, err.stack);
    });
    this.logger.log('OutboundDispatch worker connected and listening');
  }
  async onModuleDestroy() {
    await this.worker?.close();

    const { channel, organizationId, messageId, content, contactId } = job.data;
    const [channelEntity, contact] = await Promise.all([
      this.channelsService.findActiveByType(organizationId, channel),
      this.clientService.findById(contactId, organizationId),
    ]);
    if (!contact) return;
    if (channel === 'sms') {
      await this.dispatchSms(channelEntity, contact, messageId, content);

    if (!channelEntity) return;
    const rawToken = channelEntity.config?.page_access_token as string | undefined;

    if (!accessToken && channel !== 'whatsapp') {

    if (channel === 'instagram') {

    } else if (channel === 'whatsapp') {

    } else if (channel === 'facebook') {
      await this.dispatchFacebook(channelEntity, contact, messageId, content, accessToken!);
    }
  }

    const from = (channelEntity?.config?.from_number as string) || undefined;
    const messagingProfileId = (channelEntity?.config?.messaging_profile_id as string) || undefined;
    const result = await this.smsService.send({ to: phone, text: content, apiKey, from, messagingProfileId });
    await this.messageRepo.update({ id: messageId }, { status: 'sent' });
    this.logger.log(`SMS outbound → to=${phone} telnyx_id=${result.providerId}`);
  }

I'll write a small in-memory conversation repository for the spec. It understands the TypeORM In / Not(In(...)) operators the service uses, so the tests exercise the real queries' logic.

import { ConflictException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { FindOperator } from 'typeorm';
import { ConversationManagementService } from './conversation-management.service';
import {
  actorFromTenant,
  AI_ACTOR,
  assertMaySend,
  AUTOMATION_ACTOR,
  isConversationActive,
  senderTypeFor,
  type MessageActor,
} from './conversation-control';
const HUMAN: MessageActor = { kind: 'human', userId: 'user-1' };
function codeOf(fn: () => unknown): string | undefined {
  try {
    fn();
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof ConflictException) {
      return ((err.getResponse() as { errors?: { code?: string } }).errors ?? {}).code;
    }
    throw err;
  }
  return undefined;
}
describe('conversation control rules', () => {
  it('lets only the AI side write while the AI has control', () => {
    expect(codeOf(() => assertMaySend(true, AI_ACTOR))).toBeUndefined();
    expect(codeOf(() => assertMaySend(true, AUTOMATION_ACTOR))).toBeUndefined();
    expect(codeOf(() => assertMaySend(true, HUMAN))).toBe('AI_HAS_CONTROL');
  });
  it('silences the AI and automations while a person has control', () => {
    expect(codeOf(() => assertMaySend(false, HUMAN))).toBeUndefined();
    expect(codeOf(() => assertMaySend(false, AI_ACTOR))).toBe('HUMAN_HAS_CONTROL');
    expect(codeOf(() => assertMaySend(false, AUTOMATION_ACTOR))).toBe('HUMAN_HAS_CONTROL');
  });
  it('always accepts the customer writing in', () => {
    expect(codeOf(() => assertMaySend(true, HUMAN, 'inbound'))).toBeUndefined();
    expect(codeOf(() => assertMaySend(false, AI_ACTOR, 'inbound'))).toBeUndefined();
  });
  it('labels messages by who wrote them', () => {
    expect(senderTypeFor(HUMAN)).toBe('agent');
    expect(senderTypeFor(AI_ACTOR)).toBe('ai');
    expect(senderTypeFor(AUTOMATION_ACTOR)).toBe('ai');
    expect(senderTypeFor(HUMAN, 'inbound')).toBe('user');
  });
  it('treats API keys as the AI side and users as people', () => {
    expect(actorFromTenant({ organization_id: 'o', user_id: 'creator', role: 'api_key' })).toEqual(AI_ACTOR);
    expect(actorFromTenant({ organization_id: 'o', user_id: 'u9', role: 'agent' })).toEqual({ kind: 'human', userId: 'u9' });
  });
  it('knows which conversations are still being worked', () => {
    expect(isConversationActive('open')).toBe(true);
    expect(isConversationActive('pending')).toBe(true);
    expect(isConversationActive(undefined)).toBe(true);
    expect(isConversationActive('resolved')).toBe(false);
    expect(isConversationActive('archived')).toBe(false);
  });
});
// ── Service behaviour ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
type Row = Record<string, unknown>;
function matches(row: Row, where: Row): boolean {
  return Object.entries(where).every(([key, expected]) => {
    const actual = row[key];
    if (expected instanceof FindOperator) {
      const op = expected as FindOperator<unknown>;
      if (op.type === 'in') return (op.value as unknown[]).includes(actual);
      if (op.type === 'not') {
        const inner = op.value as unknown as FindOperator<unknown>;
        if (inner instanceof FindOperator && inner.type === 'in') return !(inner.value as unknown[]).includes(actual);
        return actual !== inner;
      }
      throw new Error(`unsupported operator ${op.type}`);
    }
    return actual === expected;
  });
}
function memoryRepo(rows: Row[]) {
  return {
    rows,
    create: (data: Row) => ({ ...data }),
    save: jest.fn(async (data: Row) => {
      const saved = { id: data.id ?? `conv-${rows.length + 1}`, bot_active: true, status: 'open', ...data };
      rows.push(saved);
      return saved;
    }),
    findOne: jest.fn(async ({ where }: { where: Row }) => rows.find((r) => matches(r, where)) ?? null),
    find: jest.fn(async ({ where }: { where: Row }) => rows.filter((r) => matches(r, where))),
    count: jest.fn(async ({ where }: { where: Row }) => rows.filter((r) => matches(r, where)).length),
    update: jest.fn(async (where: Row, patch: Row) => {
      rows.filter((r) => matches(r, where)).forEach((r) => Object.assign(r, patch));
    }),
  };
}
function setup(conversations: Row[]) {
  const conversationRepo = memoryRepo(conversations);
  const messages: Row[] = [];
  const messageRepo = {
    create: (data: Row) => ({ ...data }),
    save: jest.fn(async (data: Row) => {
      const saved = { id: `msg-${messages.length + 1}`, ...data };
      messages.push(saved);
      return saved;
    }),
  };
  const rmqClient = { emit: jest.fn() };
  const clientService = { findByIds: jest.fn(async () => [{ id: 'c1', first_name: 'Ana', last_name: 'Pérez' }]) };
  const realtime = { notifyOrg: jest.fn(async () => undefined) };
  const service = new ConversationManagementService(
    conversationRepo as never,
    messageRepo as never,
    rmqClient as never,
    clientService as never,
    {} as never,
    undefined,
    undefined,
    undefined,
    realtime as never,
    undefined,
  );
  return { service, conversationRepo, messages, rmqClient, realtime };
}
const ORG = 'org-1';
describe('ConversationManagementService — who may write', () => {
  it('rejects a person replying while the AI has control, and stores nothing', async () => {
    const { service, messages } = setup([{ id: 'wa', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'whatsapp', status: 'open', bot_active: true }]);
    await expect(service.sendMessage('wa', ORG, { content: 'hola' }, HUMAN)).rejects.toThrow(ConflictException);
    expect(messages).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it('drops a late AI reply once a person has taken over', async () => {
    const { service, messages } = setup([{ id: 'wa', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'whatsapp', status: 'open', bot_active: false }]);
    await expect(service.sendMessage('wa', ORG, { content: 'soy la IA' }, AI_ACTOR)).rejects.toThrow(ConflictException);
    expect(messages).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it('stores a person’s reply with the channel, the author and who sent it', async () => {
    const { service, messages } = setup([{ id: 'wa', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'whatsapp', status: 'open', bot_active: false }]);
    await service.sendMessage('wa', ORG, { content: 'te ayudo yo' }, HUMAN);
    expect(messages[0]).toMatchObject({
      channel: 'whatsapp',
      direction: 'outbound',
      sender_type: 'agent',
      sender_id: 'user-1',
      status: 'pending',
    });
  });
  it('labels AI replies and automated follow-ups as AI', async () => {
    const { service, messages } = setup([{ id: 'sms', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'sms', status: 'open', bot_active: true }]);
    await service.sendMessage('sms', ORG, { content: 'hola' }, AI_ACTOR);
    await service.sendMessage('sms', ORG, { content: 'seguimiento', metadata: { follow_up: true } }, AUTOMATION_ACTOR);
    expect(messages[0]).toMatchObject({ sender_type: 'ai', channel: 'sms' });
    expect(messages[1]).toMatchObject({ sender_type: 'ai', metadata: { follow_up: true, source: 'follow_up' } });
  });
});
describe('ConversationManagementService — lead-level control', () => {
  const lead = () => [
    { id: 'wa', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'whatsapp', status: 'open', bot_active: true },
    { id: 'sms', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'sms', status: 'open', bot_active: true },
    { id: 'old', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'facebook', status: 'resolved', bot_active: true },
    { id: 'other', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c2', channel: 'whatsapp', status: 'open', bot_active: true },
  ];
  it('taking over one channel takes over every active channel of the lead', async () => {
    const { service, conversationRepo } = setup(lead());
    await service.handoff('wa', ORG, false, HUMAN);
    const state = Object.fromEntries(conversationRepo.rows.map((r) => [r.id, r.bot_active]));
    expect(state).toEqual({ wa: false, sms: false, old: true, other: true });
  });
  it('an explicit state is idempotent (two agents clicking never flip it back)', async () => {
    const { service, conversationRepo } = setup(lead());
    await service.handoff('wa', ORG, false, HUMAN);
    await service.handoff('wa', ORG, false, HUMAN);
    expect(conversationRepo.rows.find((r) => r.id === 'wa')?.bot_active).toBe(false);
  });
  it('still toggles when called without a state (existing n8n/ProSales flows)', async () => {
    const { service, conversationRepo } = setup(lead());
    await service.handoff('sms', ORG, undefined, AI_ACTOR);
    expect(conversationRepo.rows.find((r) => r.id === 'wa')?.bot_active).toBe(false);
    await service.handoff('sms', ORG, undefined, AI_ACTOR);
    expect(conversationRepo.rows.find((r) => r.id === 'wa')?.bot_active).toBe(true);
  });
  it('notifies the team when the AI hands a lead to a person', async () => {
    const { service, realtime } = setup(lead());
    await service.handoff('wa', ORG, false, AI_ACTOR);
    await new Promise((r) => setImmediate(r));
    expect(realtime.notifyOrg).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      ORG,
      expect.objectContaining({ title: 'Ana Pérez needs a person', href: '/inbox?lead=c1', contactId: 'c1' }),
    );
  });
  it('does not notify when a person takes over themselves', async () => {
    const { service, realtime } = setup(lead());
    await service.setLeadControl(ORG, 'c1', false, HUMAN);
    expect(realtime.notifyOrg).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('reports the lead as human-owned if any active conversation is', async () => {
    const { service } = setup([
      { id: 'wa', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'whatsapp', status: 'open', bot_active: false },
      { id: 'sms', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'sms', status: 'open', bot_active: true },
    ]);
    expect((await service.getLeadControl(ORG, 'c1')).bot_active).toBe(false);
    expect(await service.isUnderHumanControl(ORG, { conversationId: 'sms' })).toBe(true);
    expect(await service.isUnderHumanControl(ORG, { contactId: 'c1' })).toBe(true);
  });
  it('ignores resolved conversations when deciding who owns the lead', async () => {
    const { service } = setup([
      { id: 'old', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'whatsapp', status: 'resolved', bot_active: false },
    ]);
    expect(await service.isUnderHumanControl(ORG, { contactId: 'c1' })).toBe(false);
  });
  it('a new channel for a human-owned lead starts human-owned', async () => {
    const { service } = setup([
      { id: 'wa', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'whatsapp', status: 'open', bot_active: false },
    ]);
    const { conversation, created } = await service.findOrCreateActiveConversation(ORG, 'c1', 'ch', 'sms');
    expect(created).toBe(true);
    expect(conversation.bot_active).toBe(false);
  });
  it('a new channel for an AI-owned lead keeps the AI', async () => {
    const { service } = setup([
      { id: 'wa', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'whatsapp', status: 'open', bot_active: true },
    ]);
    const { conversation } = await service.findOrCreateActiveConversation(ORG, 'c1', 'ch', 'sms');
    expect(conversation.bot_active).toBe(true);
  });
});

Both failures are in my test's fake repository, not the service. TypeORM's FindOperator.value getter unwraps nested operators, so for Not(In([...])) it returns the array, not the inner In. Using .child instead:

bash
command:
cd /workspace/apps/api && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/modules/conversation-management/conversation-control.spec.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""      if (op.type === 'not') {
        const inner = op.value as unknown as FindOperator<unknown>;
        if (inner instanceof FindOperator && inner.type === 'in') return !(inner.value as unknown[]).includes(actual);
        return actual !== inner;
      }""","""      if (op.type === 'not') {
        // `.value` unwraps nested operators; `.child` is the inner operator itself.
        const inner = op.child;
        if (inner?.type === 'in') return !(inner.value as unknown[]).includes(actual);
        return actual !== op.value;
      }""")
open(p,'w').write(s)

import { AgentTriggerProcessor } from './agent-trigger.processor';

function setup(humanControl: boolean) {
  const agentTriggerService = {
    findAgentsForEvent: jest.fn(async () => [{ id: 'agent-1', workflow_endpoint: 'https://n8n.example/hook' }]),
    log: jest.fn(async () => undefined),
