    agentTriggerService as never,
    {} as never,
    undefined as never,
    undefined as never,
    undefined as never,
    undefined as never,
    {} as never,
    undefined,
    undefined,
    conversations as never,
  );
  const fetchMock = jest.fn(async () => ({ ok: true, status: 200, text: async () => '' }));
  global.fetch = fetchMock as never;
  const run = (data: Record<string, unknown>) =>
    (processor as unknown as { process: (job: unknown) => Promise<void> }).process({ data });
  return { run, agentTriggerService, conversations, fetchMock };
}

const ORG = 'org-1';

describe('AgentTriggerProcessor — a person has taken over', () => {
  it.each([
    ['an inbound message', { event_type: 'message.received', conversation_id: 'conv-1', contact_id: 'c1' }],
    ['a finished call', { event_type: 'call.completed', conversation_id: 'conv-voice', contact_id: 'c1' }],
    ['a payment without a conversation', { event_type: 'payment.received', contact_id: 'c1' }],
  ])('does not send %s to n8n/ProSales', async (_label, event) => {
    const { run, agentTriggerService, conversations, fetchMock } = setup(true);
    await run({ organization_id: ORG, payload: {}, ...event });
    expect(conversations.isUnderHumanControl).toHaveBeenCalledWith(ORG, {
      conversationId: (event as { conversation_id?: string }).conversation_id ?? null,
      contactId: 'c1',
    });
    expect(agentTriggerService.findAgentsForEvent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('keeps triggering the AI while the AI has control', async () => {
    const { run, fetchMock } = setup(false);
    await run({ organization_id: ORG, event_type: 'message.received', conversation_id: 'conv-1', contact_id: 'c1', payload: {} });
    expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith('https://n8n.example/hook', expect.objectContaining({ method: 'POST' }));
  });
});

  async createCheckoutLink(
    organizationId: string,

    const hasSlot = !!(slot?.starts_at && slot.duration_minutes);

      organizationId,

    if (linkedCalendar && !hasSlot && !dto.appointment_id) {

const ORG = 'org-1';
const DTO = { contact_id: 'c1', service_id: 'svc-1', conversation_id: 'conv-1' };

describe('Payment links created by a person inside a conversation', () => {
  it('are refused while the AI has control of the conversation', async () => {
    const { service, stripe } = setup(true);
    await expect(
      service.createCheckoutLink(ORG, DTO as never, { origin: 'human', userId: 'u1' }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ConflictException);
    expect(stripe.checkout.sessions.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('are created once the person has taken over, and remember who created them', async () => {
    const { service, saved } = setup(false);
    const result = await service.createCheckoutLink(ORG, DTO as never, { origin: 'human', userId: 'u1' });
    expect(result.url).toBe('https://checkout.stripe.test/cs_1');
    expect(saved[0].metadata).toEqual({ origin: 'human', created_by: 'u1' });
    expect(saved[0].conversation_id).toBe('conv-1');
  });

  it('never block the AI tool, which charges while the AI has control', async () => {
    const { service, saved, paymentRepo } = setup(true);
    await service.createCheckoutLink(ORG, DTO as never);
    expect(paymentRepo.manager.query).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(saved[0].metadata).toEqual({ origin: 'ai' });
  });

  it('do not check control when the link is not tied to a conversation (e.g. from the agenda)', async () => {
    const { service, paymentRepo } = setup(true);
    await service.createCheckoutLink(ORG, { contact_id: 'c1', service_id: 'svc-1' } as never, { origin: 'human', userId: 'u1' });
    expect(paymentRepo.manager.query).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

  // ── Activity timeline ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Messages anchor the page. They're the overwhelming majority of real
  // content, so this fetches `limit` of them first, then bounds every
  // secondary event type (calls, appointments, funnel changes, data updates)
  // to that same time window instead of giving each its own independent
  // `limit` — the previous approach let a burst of automation bookkeeping
  // (e.g. the Follow-up Engine recreating its "no_response" reminder on every
  // reply) fill its own full quota and crowd real messages out of the final
  // merged-and-sliced page. A contact with no conversations yet (so no
  // messages to bound by) falls back to giving each secondary type its own
  // `limit`, same as before, so those events still surface on their own.
  async getActivity(
    id: string,
    organizationId: string,
    cursor?: string,
    limit = 50,
  ): Promise<ActivityPage> {
    await this.findById(id, organizationId);
    const cursorDate = cursor ? new Date(cursor) : new Date();
    // Query conversations for this contact to get conversation IDs
    const conversations = await this.conversationRepo.find({
      where: { organization_id: organizationId, contact_id: id },
      select: ['id'],
    });
    const conversationIds = conversations.map((c) => c.id);
    // Messages
    let messages: MessageEntity[] = [];
    if (conversationIds.length > 0) {
      messages = await this.messageRepo
        .createQueryBuilder('m')
        .where('m.conversation_id IN (:...ids)', { ids: conversationIds })
        .andWhere('m.organization_id = :orgId', { orgId: organizationId })
        .andWhere('m.sent_at < :cursor', { cursor: cursorDate })
        .orderBy('m.sent_at', 'DESC')
        .take(limit)
        .getMany();
    }
    // A full page of messages means there's more message history further
    // back — bound secondary queries to that window. Fewer than a full page
    // means we've reached the actual start of this contact's messages, so
    // there's no window to bound by; fall back to each type's own budget so
    // anything older (e.g. a call before the first text) still shows up.
    const hasFullMessagePage = messages.length === limit && messages.length > 0;
    const windowStart = hasFullMessagePage ? messages[messages.length - 1].sent_at : null;
    // Only binds in the (rare) case a secondary type is itself dense within
    // the message window — the window is what normally bounds these.
    const secondaryLimit = limit * 5;
    // Voice calls
    // Filtered and ordered on the same expression the event is timestamped
    // with, otherwise a call whose started_at differs from created_at lands out
    // of order or is skipped when the cursor moves past it.

  private async resolveStrategy(
    contact: ContactEntity,
    organizationId: string,
    strategy: string,
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): Promise<ResolvedChannel | null> {
    switch (strategy) {
      case 'auto':
        return this.resolveAuto(contact, organizationId);
      case 'same_channel':
        return this.resolveSameChannel(contact, organizationId, metadata);
      case 'whatsapp_only':
        return this.resolveSpecific(contact, organizationId, 'whatsapp');
      case 'sms_only':
        return this.resolveSpecific(contact, organizationId, 'sms');
      case 'voice_only':
        return this.resolveVoice(contact);
      case 'email_only':
        return this.resolveEmail(contact);

        return this.resolveAuto(contact, organizationId);

  private async resolveAuto(
    contact: ContactEntity,
    organizationId: string,
  ): Promise<ResolvedChannel | null> {
    // 1. Last successful conversation channel
    const lastConv = await this.conversationRepo.findOne({
      where: { contact_id: contact.id, organization_id: organizationId },
      order: { last_message_at: 'DESC' },
      select: ['channel'],
    });
    if (lastConv?.channel) {
      const recipientId = this.getRecipientForChannel(contact, lastConv.channel);
      if (recipientId) {
        const hasActive = await this.orgHasActiveChannel(organizationId, lastConv.channel);
        if (hasActive) return { channel: lastConv.channel, recipientId };
      }
    }
    // 2. Fall back down the org's priority chain (default: WhatsApp → SMS → Email)
    for (const channel of await this.channelPriority(organizationId)) {

      if (!recipientId) continue;
      if (await this.orgHasActiveChannel(organizationId, channel)) {
        return { channel, recipientId };
      }
    }

The resolver already falls back to the next channel when a specific one can't be resolved. So making getRecipientForChannel return nothing for an opted-out channel gives exactly "stop on that channel, the others stay possible". Shared helper first:

bash
command:
cd /workspace/packages/shared/src && cat index.ts && cat > opt-out.ts <<'EOF'
/**
 * Opt-out is per channel: when a contact asks us to stop, we stop contacting
 * them on that channel. Stored as contact tags so people can see and undo it:
 *   - `opt-out`            → every channel (legacy / explicit global opt-out)
 *   - `opt-out:<channel>`  → only that channel (e.g. `opt-out:whatsapp`)
 */
export const OPT_OUT_TAG = 'opt-out';

const CHANNEL_ALIASES: Record<string, string> = { messenger: 'facebook' };

function canonicalChannel(channel: string): string {
  const c = channel.trim().toLowerCase();
  return CHANNEL_ALIASES[c] ?? c;
}

export function optOutTag(channel: string): string {
  return `${OPT_OUT_TAG}:${canonicalChannel(channel)}`;
}

/** True when the contact must not be contacted on `channel`. */
export function isOptedOut(tags: readonly string[] | null | undefined, channel: string): boolean {
  if (!tags?.length) return false;
  return tags.includes(OPT_OUT_TAG) || tags.includes(optOutTag(channel));
}

/** 'all' for a global opt-out, otherwise the channels the contact opted out of. */
export function optedOutChannels(tags: readonly string[] | null | undefined): 'all' | string[] {
  if (!tags?.length) return [];
  if (tags.includes(OPT_OUT_TAG)) return 'all';
  const prefix = `${OPT_OUT_TAG}:`;
  return tags.filter((t) => t.startsWith(prefix)).map((t) => t.slice(prefix.length));
}

import { isOptedOut, optOutTag, optedOutChannels, OPT_OUT_TAG } from '@crm/shared';
import { ConflictException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ChannelStrategyResolverService } from '../modules/automation-engine/channel-strategy-resolver.service';
import { ConversationManagementService } from '../modules/conversation-management/conversation-management.service';
import { AI_ACTOR } from '../modules/conversation-management/conversation-control';

describe('per-channel opt-out rules (@crm/shared)', () => {
  it('blocks only the channel the contact opted out of', () => {
    const tags = ['vip', optOutTag('whatsapp')];
    expect(isOptedOut(tags, 'whatsapp')).toBe(true);
    expect(isOptedOut(tags, 'sms')).toBe(false);
    expect(optedOutChannels(tags)).toEqual(['whatsapp']);
  });

  it('treats the legacy `opt-out` tag as every channel', () => {
    expect(isOptedOut([OPT_OUT_TAG], 'sms')).toBe(true);
    expect(isOptedOut([OPT_OUT_TAG], 'voice')).toBe(true);
    expect(optedOutChannels([OPT_OUT_TAG])).toBe('all');
  });

  it('normalises channel names (messenger is facebook)', () => {
    expect(optOutTag(' WhatsApp ')).toBe('opt-out:whatsapp');
    expect(isOptedOut([optOutTag('facebook')], 'messenger')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('has nothing to block without tags', () => {
    expect(isOptedOut(undefined, 'sms')).toBe(false);
    expect(optedOutChannels(null)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('opt-out is enforced when contacting the lead', () => {
  it('refuses to send on a channel the contact opted out of', async () => {
    const conv = { id: 'wa', organization_id: 'org', contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'whatsapp', bot_active: true };
    const messageRepo = { create: (d: unknown) => d, save: jest.fn() };
    const service = new ConversationManagementService(
      { findOne: jest.fn(async () => conv) } as never,
      messageRepo as never,
      { emit: jest.fn() } as never,
      { findByIds: jest.fn(async () => [{ id: 'c1', tags: [optOutTag('whatsapp')] }]) } as never,
      {} as never,
    );
    const err = await service.sendMessage('wa', 'org', { content: 'hola' }, AI_ACTOR).catch((e) => e);
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(ConflictException);
    expect((err as ConflictException).getResponse()).toMatchObject({ errors: { code: 'CHANNEL_OPTED_OUT', channel: 'whatsapp' } });
    expect(messageRepo.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('follow-ups skip an opted-out channel and use the next one that reaches the contact', async () => {
    const resolver = new ChannelStrategyResolverService(
      { findOne: jest.fn(async () => ({ channel: 'whatsapp' })) } as never,
      { findOne: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'org', settings: {} })) } as never,
      { findActiveByType: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'channel' })) } as never,
    );
    const contact = {
      id: 'c1',
      phone: '+34600000000',
      email: 'ana@example.com',
      channel_ids: { whatsapp: '34600000000' },
      tags: [optOutTag('whatsapp')],
    };
    await expect(resolver.resolve(contact as never, 'org', 'whatsapp_only')).resolves.toEqual({
      channel: 'sms',
      recipientId: '+34600000000',
    });
    await expect(resolver.resolve({ ...contact, tags: [OPT_OUT_TAG] } as never, 'org', 'auto')).resolves.toBeNull();
  });
});

// ── Reaching a lead on another channel ──────────────────────────────────────

/** Why a channel can't be used to start (or continue) a conversation with a lead. */
export type UnreachableReason =
  | 'opted_out'
  | 'no_phone'
  | 'channel_not_connected'
  | 'contact_must_start'
  | 'use_call'
  | 'no_text_dispatch';

export interface ReachableChannel {
  channel: string;
  reachable: boolean;
  reason?: UnreachableReason;
  /** The lead's active conversation on this channel, if there is one. */
  conversation_id?: string | null;
}

/** Channels the inbox can show for a lead, in display order. */
export const LEAD_CHANNELS = ['whatsapp', 'sms', 'facebook', 'instagram', 'webchat', 'email', 'voice'] as const;

export interface ReachabilityInput {
  channel: string;
  optedOut: boolean;
  hasOpenConversation: boolean;
  phone: string | null | undefined;
  whatsappId: string | null | undefined;
  orgHasChannel: boolean;
}

/**
 * Whether a person can write to the lead on `channel` from the CRM. Only
 * WhatsApp and SMS can be started by us (with the phone the contact gave);
 * Messenger, Instagram and web chat must be started by the contact.
 */
export function reachability(input: ReachabilityInput): Pick<ReachableChannel, 'reachable' | 'reason'> {
  if (input.optedOut) return { reachable: false, reason: 'opted_out' };
  if (input.channel === 'voice') return { reachable: false, reason: 'use_call' };
  if (input.channel === 'email') return { reachable: false, reason: 'no_text_dispatch' };
  if (input.hasOpenConversation) return { reachable: true };
  switch (input.channel) {
    case 'whatsapp':
      if (!input.whatsappId && !input.phone) return { reachable: false, reason: 'no_phone' };
      if (!input.orgHasChannel) return { reachable: false, reason: 'channel_not_connected' };
      return { reachable: true };
    case 'sms':
      if (!input.phone) return { reachable: false, reason: 'no_phone' };
      return { reachable: true };
    default:
      return { reachable: false, reason: 'contact_must_start' };
  }
}

export function channelUnreachableError(channel: string, reason: UnreachableReason): ConflictException {
  if (reason === 'opted_out') return channelOptedOutError(channel);
  return new ConflictException({
    message: `The lead can't be contacted on ${channel} from here (${reason.replace(/_/g, ' ')}).`,
    errors: { code: 'CHANNEL_UNREACHABLE', channel, reason },
  });
}

   * The person who starts it owns it: the lead is taken over on every channel.
   */
  async startConversation(
    organizationId: string,
    contactId: string,
    channel: string,
    actor: MessageActor,
  ): Promise<ConversationEntity> {
    const channels = await this.getReachableChannels(organizationId, contactId);
    const target = channels.find((c) => c.channel === channel);
    if (!target) throw new BadRequestException(`Unknown channel '${channel}'`);
    if (!target.reachable) throw channelUnreachableError(channel, target.reason ?? 'contact_must_start');

    const { conversation } = await this.findOrCreateActiveConversation(organizationId, contactId, '', channel);
    if (actor.kind === 'human') {
      await this.setLeadControl(organizationId, contactId, false, actor, [conversation.id]);
      conversation.bot_active = false;
    }
    return conversation;
  }

describe('reaching a lead on another channel', () => {
  const base = { optedOut: false, hasOpenConversation: false, phone: '+34600000000', whatsappId: null, orgHasChannel: true };
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-var-requires
  const { reachability } = require('./conversation-control');

  it('can start WhatsApp or SMS with the phone the contact gave', () => {
    expect(reachability({ ...base, channel: 'whatsapp' })).toEqual({ reachable: true });
    expect(reachability({ ...base, channel: 'sms' })).toEqual({ reachable: true });
  });

  it('explains why a channel cannot be used', () => {
    expect(reachability({ ...base, channel: 'whatsapp', phone: null })).toEqual({ reachable: false, reason: 'no_phone' });
    expect(reachability({ ...base, channel: 'whatsapp', orgHasChannel: false })).toEqual({ reachable: false, reason: 'channel_not_connected' });
    expect(reachability({ ...base, channel: 'instagram' })).toEqual({ reachable: false, reason: 'contact_must_start' });
    expect(reachability({ ...base, channel: 'voice' })).toEqual({ reachable: false, reason: 'use_call' });
    expect(reachability({ ...base, channel: 'email' })).toEqual({ reachable: false, reason: 'no_text_dispatch' });
  });

  it('an opt-out beats everything, even an open conversation', () => {
    expect(reachability({ ...base, channel: 'whatsapp', optedOut: true, hasOpenConversation: true })).toEqual({
      reachable: false,
      reason: 'opted_out',
    });
  });

  it('an open conversation on Messenger can keep going (the contact started it)', () => {
    expect(reachability({ ...base, channel: 'facebook', hasOpenConversation: true })).toEqual({ reachable: true });
  });

  function startSetup(tags: string[] = []) {
    const rows: Row[] = [
      { id: 'fb', organization_id: ORG, contact_id: 'c1', channel: 'facebook', status: 'open', bot_active: true },
    ];
    const conversationRepo = memoryRepo(rows);
    const service = new ConversationManagementService(
      conversationRepo as never,
      {} as never,
      { emit: jest.fn() } as never,
      {
        findById: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'c1', phone: '+34600000000', channel_ids: { facebook: 'psid' }, tags })),
        findByIds: jest.fn(async () => [{ id: 'c1', first_name: 'Ana', tags }]),
      } as never,
      { findActiveByType: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'waha' })) } as never,
    );
    return { service, rows };
  }

  it('a person starting WhatsApp for a Facebook lead takes the whole lead over', async () => {
    const { service, rows } = startSetup();
    const conv = await service.startConversation(ORG, 'c1', 'whatsapp', HUMAN);
    expect(conv.channel).toBe('whatsapp');
    expect(conv.bot_active).toBe(false);
    expect(rows.find((r) => r.id === 'fb')?.bot_active).toBe(false);
  });

  it('refuses to start a channel the contact opted out of', async () => {
    const { service } = startSetup(['opt-out:whatsapp']);
    const err = await service.startConversation(ORG, 'c1', 'whatsapp', HUMAN).catch((e) => e);
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(ConflictException);
    expect((err as ConflictException).getResponse()).toMatchObject({ errors: { code: 'CHANNEL_OPTED_OUT' } });
  });
});

import { CLOSED_CONVERSATION_STATUSES } from './conversation-control';
/**
 * The Inbox lists leads, not conversations: one row per contact across all
 * their channels. These are the saved views of that list.
 */
export const INBOX_VIEWS = ['open', 'needs_human', 'ai', 'unread', 'hot', 'resolved', 'all'] as const;
export type InboxView = (typeof INBOX_VIEWS)[number];
/** Same threshold the UI uses for the 🔥 badge. */
export const HOT_LEAD_SCORE = 70;
export interface InboxLeadsQuery {
  view?: InboxView;
  search?: string;
  channel?: string;
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
}
export interface InboxLead {
  contact: {
    id: string;
    first_name: string;
    last_name: string | null;
    email: string | null;
    phone: string | null;
    lead_score: number;
    tags: string[];
  };
  /** Channels with an active conversation (what the lead is talking to us on now). */
  channels: string[];
  /** true while the AI answers this lead; false once a person took over. */
  bot_active: boolean;
  has_active_conversation: boolean;
  is_pinned: boolean;
  unread_count: number;
  last_message_at: string | null;
  last_message: { content: string; created_at: string; direction: string; channel: string; conversation_id: string } | null;
  /** The conversation the lead last wrote on, for legacy links and replies. */
  latest_conversation_id: string | null;
}
interface BuiltQuery {
  sql: string;
  params: unknown[];
}
const CLOSED = CLOSED_CONVERSATION_STATUSES.map((s) => `'${s}'`).join(', ');
/** SQL for one page of leads. Values are always bound, never interpolated. */
export function buildInboxLeadsQuery(organizationId: string, query: InboxLeadsQuery): BuiltQuery {
  const params: unknown[] = [organizationId];
  const bind = (value: unknown) => {
    params.push(value);
    return `$${params.length}`;
  };
  const channelFilter = query.channel ? `AND c.channel = ${bind(query.channel)}` : '';
  const viewFilter = (() => {
    switch (query.view ?? 'open') {
      case 'needs_human':
        return 'leads.human_control';
      case 'ai':
        return 'leads.has_active AND NOT leads.human_control';
      case 'unread':
        return 'leads.has_active AND leads.unread_count > 0';
      case 'hot':
        return `leads.has_active AND ct.lead_score >= ${bind(HOT_LEAD_SCORE)}`;
      case 'resolved':
        return 'NOT leads.has_active';
      case 'all':
        return 'TRUE';
      case 'open':
      default:
        return 'leads.has_active';
    }
  })();
  const search = query.search?.trim();
  const searchFilter = search
    ? (() => {
        const q = bind(`%${search}%`);
        return `AND (ct.first_name ILIKE ${q} OR ct.last_name ILIKE ${q} OR ct.email ILIKE ${q} OR ct.phone ILIKE ${q}
                 OR (ct.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(ct.last_name, '')) ILIKE ${q})`;
      })()
    : '';
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(query.limit) || 30, 1), 100);
  const page = Math.max(Number(query.page) || 1, 1);
  const limitParam = bind(limit);
  const offsetParam = bind((page - 1) * limit);
  const sql = `
    WITH conv AS (
      SELECT c.id, c.contact_id, c.channel, c.bot_active, c.is_pinned, c.last_message_at, c.last_read_at,
             (c.status NOT IN (${CLOSED})) AS is_active
        FROM conversations.conversations c
       WHERE c.organization_id = $1 ${channelFilter}
    ),
    unread AS (
      SELECT m.conversation_id, COUNT(*)::int AS n
        FROM conversations.messages m
        JOIN conv ON conv.id = m.conversation_id
       WHERE m.direction = 'inbound'
         AND m.sent_at > COALESCE(conv.last_read_at, 'epoch'::timestamptz)
       GROUP BY m.conversation_id
    ),
    leads AS (
      SELECT conv.contact_id,
             BOOL_OR(conv.is_active) AS has_active,
             BOOL_OR(conv.is_active AND NOT conv.bot_active) AS human_control,
             BOOL_OR(conv.is_pinned) AS is_pinned,
             MAX(conv.last_message_at) AS last_message_at,
             COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT conv.channel) FILTER (WHERE conv.is_active), '{}') AS channels,
             COALESCE(SUM(unread.n) FILTER (WHERE conv.is_active), 0)::int AS unread_count
        FROM conv
        LEFT JOIN unread ON unread.conversation_id = conv.id
       GROUP BY conv.contact_id
    )
    SELECT leads.*, ct.first_name, ct.last_name, ct.email, ct.phone, ct.lead_score, ct.tags,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM leads
      JOIN clients.contacts ct ON ct.id = leads.contact_id AND ct.organization_id = $1
     WHERE ${viewFilter} ${searchFilter}
     ORDER BY leads.is_pinned DESC, leads.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST, ct.created_at DESC
     LIMIT ${limitParam} OFFSET ${offsetParam}`;
  return { sql, params };
}
/** Latest message of each lead on the page, across all their conversations. */
export function buildLastMessagesQuery(organizationId: string, contactIds: string[]): BuiltQuery {
  return {
    sql: `
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.contact_id)
             c.contact_id, m.conversation_id, m.content, m.sent_at, m.direction, c.channel
        FROM conversations.messages m
        JOIN conversations.conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id
       WHERE c.organization_id = $1 AND c.contact_id = ANY($2) AND m.type <> 'system'
       ORDER BY c.contact_id, m.sent_at DESC`,
    params: [organizationId, contactIds],
  };
}
export interface LeadRow {
  contact_id: string;
  has_active: boolean;
  human_control: boolean;
  is_pinned: boolean;
  last_message_at: Date | string | null;
  channels: string[] | string;
  unread_count: number | string;
  first_name: string;
  last_name: string | null;
  email: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
  lead_score: number | null;
  tags: string[] | string | null;
  total: number | string;
}
export interface LastMessageRow {
  contact_id: string;
  conversation_id: string;
  content: string;
  sent_at: Date | string;
  direction: string;
  channel: string;
}
/** node-postgres returns text[] as JS arrays, but be defensive with '{a,b}'. */
function pgArray(value: string[] | string | null | undefined): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
  if (!value || value === '{}') return [];
  return value.replace(/^\{|\}$/g, '').split(',').filter(Boolean);
}
function iso(value: Date | string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!value) return null;
  return value instanceof Date ? value.toISOString() : new Date(value).toISOString();
}
export function toInboxLead(row: LeadRow, last: LastMessageRow | undefined): InboxLead {
  return {
    contact: {
      id: row.contact_id,
      first_name: row.first_name,
      last_name: row.last_name ?? null,
      email: row.email ?? null,
      phone: row.phone ?? null,
      lead_score: Number(row.lead_score ?? 0),
      tags: pgArray(row.tags),
    },
    channels: pgArray(row.channels).sort(),
    bot_active: !row.human_control,
    has_active_conversation: !!row.has_active,
    is_pinned: !!row.is_pinned,
    unread_count: Number(row.unread_count ?? 0),
    last_message_at: iso(row.last_message_at),
    last_message: last
      ? {
          content: last.content,
          created_at: iso(last.sent_at) as string,
          direction: last.direction,
          channel: last.channel,
          conversation_id: last.conversation_id,
        }
      : null,
    latest_conversation_id: last?.conversation_id ?? null,
  };
}

/**
 * The lead-centric Inbox against a real PostgreSQL built from
 * packages/database/schemas:
 *   TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://... pnpm --filter @crm/api test inbox.integration
 * Skipped when TEST_DATABASE_URL is not set.
 */
import 'reflect-metadata';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';
import { ConversationManagementService } from './conversation-management.service';
import { ConversationEntity } from './conversation.entity';
import { MessageEntity } from './message.entity';
import { ClientManagementService } from '../client-management/client-management.service';
import { ContactEntity } from '../client-management/contact.entity';
import { ContactDataUpdateEntity } from '../client-management/contact-data-update.entity';
import { CallEntity } from '../voice/call.entity';
import { AppointmentEntity } from '../scheduling/appointment.entity';
import { ContactFunnelHistoryEntity } from '../funnels/contact-funnel-history.entity';
import { FunnelStageEntity } from '../funnels/funnel-stage.entity';
import { FunnelEntity } from '../funnels/funnel.entity';
import { AI_ACTOR } from './conversation-control';
const url = process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL;
const describeDb = url ? describe : describe.skip;
jest.setTimeout(60_000);
describeDb('lead-centric inbox against PostgreSQL', () => {
  let ds: DataSource;
  let inbox: ConversationManagementService;
  let clients: ClientManagementService;
  const emitted: Array<{ queue: string; data: Record<string, unknown> }> = [];
  const notifications: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
  let org: string;
  const ids: Record<string, string> = {};
  const minutesAgo = (m: number) => new Date(Date.now() - m * 60_000);
  beforeAll(async () => {
    ds = new DataSource({ type: 'postgres', url, entities: [`${__dirname}/../../**/*.entity.ts`] });
    await ds.initialize();
    clients = new ClientManagementService(
      ds.getRepository(ContactEntity),
      ds.getRepository(ContactDataUpdateEntity),
      ds.getRepository(ConversationEntity),
      ds.getRepository(MessageEntity),
      ds.getRepository(CallEntity),
      ds.getRepository(AppointmentEntity),
      ds.getRepository(ContactFunnelHistoryEntity),
      ds.getRepository(FunnelStageEntity),
      ds.getRepository(FunnelEntity),
      {} as never,
    );
    inbox = new ConversationManagementService(
      ds.getRepository(ConversationEntity),
      ds.getRepository(MessageEntity),
      { emit: (queue: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) => emitted.push({ queue, data }) } as never,
      clients,
      { findActiveByType: async () => ({ id: 'waha' }) } as never,
      undefined,
      undefined,
      undefined,
      { notifyOrg: async (_org: string, n: Record<string, unknown>) => void notifications.push(n) } as never,
      undefined,
    );
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await ds?.destroy();
  });
  async function conversation(contact: string, channel: string, opts: { status?: string; bot_active?: boolean; at: Date }) {
    const id = randomUUID();
    await ds.query(
      `INSERT INTO conversations.conversations (id, organization_id, contact_id, channel, status, bot_active, last_message_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)`,
      [id, org, contact, channel, opts.status ?? 'open', opts.bot_active ?? true, opts.at],
    );
    return id;
  }
  async function message(conversationId: string, channel: string, direction: string, content: string, at: Date, senderType = 'user') {
    await ds.query(
      `INSERT INTO conversations.messages (organization_id, conversation_id, content, direction, channel, sender_type, sent_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)`,
      [org, conversationId, content, direction, channel, senderType, at],
    );
  }
  beforeEach(async () => {
    emitted.length = 0;
    notifications.length = 0;
    org = randomUUID();
    await ds.query(`INSERT INTO core.organizations (id, name, slug) VALUES ($1, 'Clinic', $2)`, [org, `clinic-${org}`]);
    for (const [key, first, last, score, phone] of [
      ['ana', 'Ana', 'Pérez', 85, '+34600000001'],
      ['luis', 'Luis', 'Gómez', 20, '+34600000002'],
      ['marta', 'Marta', 'Ruiz', 40, null],
      ['pedro', 'Pedro', 'Sanz', 10, '+34600000004'],
    ] as const) {
      ids[key] = randomUUID();
      await ds.query(
        `INSERT INTO clients.contacts (id, organization_id, first_name, last_name, phone, lead_score) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)`,
        [ids[key], org, first, last, phone, score],
      );
    }
    // Ana writes on WhatsApp and SMS (AI answering); Luis was taken over by a
    // person; Pedro's only conversation is resolved; Marta never wrote.
    ids.anaWa = await conversation(ids.ana, 'whatsapp', { at: minutesAgo(5) });
    ids.anaSms = await conversation(ids.ana, 'sms', { at: minutesAgo(30) });
    ids.luisWa = await conversation(ids.luis, 'whatsapp', { bot_active: false, at: minutesAgo(10) });
    ids.pedroSms = await conversation(ids.pedro, 'sms', { status: 'resolved', at: minutesAgo(300) });
    await message(ids.anaSms, 'sms', 'inbound', 'hola', minutesAgo(30));
    await message(ids.anaWa, 'whatsapp', 'inbound', '¿Tenéis cita el martes?', minutesAgo(5));
    await message(ids.luisWa, 'whatsapp', 'inbound', 'necesito ayuda', minutesAgo(11));
    await message(ids.luisWa, 'whatsapp', 'outbound', 'te ayudo yo', minutesAgo(10), 'agent');
    await message(ids.pedroSms, 'sms', 'inbound', 'gracias', minutesAgo(300));
  });
  const names = (items: Array<{ contact: { first_name: string } }>) => items.map((i) => i.contact.first_name);
  it('lists one row per lead with all its channels, newest activity first', async () => {
    const { items, meta } = await inbox.findLeads(org, { view: 'open' });
    expect(names(items)).toEqual(['Ana', 'Luis']);
    expect(meta.total).toBe(2);
    const [ana, luis] = items;
    expect(ana.channels).toEqual(['sms', 'whatsapp']);
    expect(ana.bot_active).toBe(true);
    expect(ana.unread_count).toBe(2);
    expect(ana.last_message).toMatchObject({ content: '¿Tenéis cita el martes?', channel: 'whatsapp', direction: 'inbound' });
    expect(ana.latest_conversation_id).toBe(ids.anaWa);
    expect(luis.bot_active).toBe(false);
    expect(luis.unread_count).toBe(1);
  });
  it.each([
    ['needs_human', ['Luis']],
    ['ai', ['Ana']],
    ['hot', ['Ana']],
    ['unread', ['Ana', 'Luis']],
    ['resolved', ['Pedro']],
    ['all', ['Ana', 'Luis', 'Pedro']],
  ] as const)('view %s', async (view, expected) => {
    const { items } = await inbox.findLeads(org, { view });
    expect(names(items)).toEqual(expected);
  });
  it('searches leads by name, phone or email', async () => {
    expect(names((await inbox.findLeads(org, { view: 'all', search: 'gómez' })).items)).toEqual(['Luis']);
    expect(names((await inbox.findLeads(org, { view: 'all', search: 'Ana Pérez' })).items)).toEqual(['Ana']);
    expect(names((await inbox.findLeads(org, { view: 'all', search: '600000004' })).items)).toEqual(['Pedro']);
  });
  it('the conversations endpoint search works too (it used to ignore the term)', async () => {
    const { items } = await inbox.findAll(org, { search: 'luis' });
    expect(items.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([ids.luisWa]);
  });
  it('opening a lead marks every channel read', async () => {
    await inbox.markLeadRead(org, ids.ana);
    const ana = (await inbox.findLeads(org, { view: 'open' })).items.find((i) => i.contact.id === ids.ana);
    expect(ana?.unread_count).toBe(0);
  });
  it('a pinned lead stays on top', async () => {
    await inbox.setLeadPinned(org, ids.luis, true);
    expect(names((await inbox.findLeads(org, { view: 'open' })).items)).toEqual(['Luis', 'Ana']);
  });
  it('taking a lead over covers all its active channels, and the AI is then silenced', async () => {
    await inbox.setLeadControl(org, ids.ana, false);
    const state = await inbox.getLeadControl(org, ids.ana);
    expect(state.bot_active).toBe(false);
    expect(state.conversations.map((c) => c.bot_active)).toEqual([false, false]);
    expect(await inbox.isUnderHumanControl(org, { conversationId: ids.anaSms })).toBe(true);
    await expect(inbox.sendMessage(ids.anaWa, org, { content: 'soy la IA' }, AI_ACTOR)).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(emitted.filter((e) => e.queue === 'conversation.assign')).toHaveLength(2);
  });
  it('a new channel for a human-owned lead starts human-owned; once resolved, the AI takes the next one', async () => {
    const { conversation } = await inbox.findOrCreateActiveConversation(org, ids.luis, '', 'sms');
    expect(conversation.bot_active).toBe(false);
    await ds.query(`UPDATE conversations.conversations SET status = 'resolved' WHERE contact_id = $1`, [ids.luis]);
    expect(await inbox.isUnderHumanControl(org, { contactId: ids.luis })).toBe(false);
    const next = await inbox.findOrCreateActiveConversation(org, ids.luis, '', 'whatsapp');
    expect(next.conversation.bot_active).toBe(true);
  });
  it('a person can start WhatsApp for a lead with a phone, and owns the lead afterwards', async () => {
    const channels = await inbox.getReachableChannels(org, ids.pedro);
    expect(channels.find((c) => c.channel === 'whatsapp')).toMatchObject({ reachable: true, conversation_id: null });
    expect(channels.find((c) => c.channel === 'instagram')).toMatchObject({ reachable: false, reason: 'contact_must_start' });
    const conv = await inbox.startConversation(org, ids.pedro, 'whatsapp', { kind: 'human', userId: null });
    expect(conv).toMatchObject({ channel: 'whatsapp', bot_active: false });
    expect((await inbox.getLeadControl(org, ids.pedro)).bot_active).toBe(false);
  });
  it('shows payment links in the lead activity, with who created them', async () => {
    const userId = randomUUID();
    await ds.query(
      `INSERT INTO core.users (id, organization_id, email, full_name, role) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'Carla Agent', 'agent')`,
      [userId, org, `carla-${org}@example.com`],
    );
    const serviceId = randomUUID();
    await ds.query(`INSERT INTO payments.services (id, organization_id, name, amount) VALUES ($1, $2, 'Consulta', 5000)`, [serviceId, org]);
    await ds.query(
      `INSERT INTO payments.payments (organization_id, service_id, contact_id, conversation_id, amount, currency, status, checkout_url, metadata, created_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 5000, 'eur', 'pending', 'https://stripe.test/pay', $5, $6)`,
      [org, serviceId, ids.ana, ids.anaWa, JSON.stringify({ origin: 'human', created_by: userId }), minutesAgo(2)],
    );
    const { events } = await clients.getActivity(ids.ana, org);
    const payment = events.find((e) => e.type === 'payment');
    expect(payment).toMatchObject({
      status: 'pending',
      amount: 5000,
      currency: 'eur',
      service_name: 'Consulta',
      origin: 'human',
      actor: 'Carla Agent',
      checkout_url: 'https://stripe.test/pay',
      conversation_id: ids.anaWa,
    });
    // Outbound messages stored before sender_type was recorded are never shown as the contact's.
    const reply = (await clients.getActivity(ids.luis, org)).events.find((e) => e.type === 'message' && e.direction === 'outbound');
    expect(reply).toMatchObject({ sender: 'agent', status: 'pending' });
  });
});

export function MessageBubble({ message }: MessageBubbleProps) {
  // Calls are persisted with type 'system' — the messages CHECK constraint has
  // no 'voice' value — so they are matched on the call metadata written by
  // CallsService.upsertCallMessage, and before the generic system branch or
  // they render as a plain text event with no player.
  const meta = message.metadata as
    | {
        call_id?: string;
        duration_seconds?: number;
        transcript?: string;
        summary?: string;
        recording_url?: string;
        direction?: 'inbound' | 'outbound';
      }
    | undefined;
  if (meta?.call_id && message.channel === 'voice') {
    return (
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        className={cn(
          'flex my-1',
          message.direction === 'outbound' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start',
        )}
      >
        <VoiceCallCard
          duration={meta.duration_seconds}
          transcript={meta.transcript}
          summary={meta.summary}
          recordingUrl={meta.recording_url}
          direction={meta.direction}
        />
      </motion.div>
    );
  }
  if (message.type === 'system') {
    return <SystemEvent content={message.content} timestamp={message.created_at} />;
  }
  const isOutbound = message.direction === 'outbound';
  const isAI = message.sender_type === 'ai';
  if (isAI && !isOutbound) {
    return (
      <AIResponseBubble
        content={message.content}
        timestamp={message.created_at}
        channel={message.channel}
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      className={cn('flex my-1 min-w-0 max-w-full', isOutbound ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start')}
      style={{ width: '100%' }}
    >
      <div className={cn('max-w-[70%] min-w-0 space-y-1', isOutbound ? 'items-end' : 'items-start', 'flex flex-col')}>
        {isOutbound && isAI && <AIResponseIndicator />}
        <div
          className={cn(
            'rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm w-fit max-w-full min-w-0 box-border',
            isOutbound
              ? 'border border-accent/15 bg-olive-dark text-primary rounded-br-sm'
              : 'border border-surface/6 bg-surface-raised text-primary rounded-bl-sm',
          )}
        >
          <MessageContent content={message.content} isOutbound={isOutbound} />
        </div>
        <div className={cn('flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 max-w-full', isOutbound ? 'flex-row-reverse' : 'flex-row')}>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted truncate">
            {formatRelativeTime(message.created_at)}
          </span>
          <ChannelBadge channel={message.channel} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

import { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAddTag, useRemoveTag } from '@/hooks/useContacts';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
interface ContactTagsProps {
  contactId: string;
  tags: string[];
}
export function ContactTags({ contactId, tags }: ContactTagsProps) {
  const [newTag, setNewTag] = useState('');
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const addTag = useAddTag();
  const removeTag = useRemoveTag();
  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const tag = newTag.trim();
      if (!tag) return;
      addTag.mutate({ contactId, tag });
      setNewTag('');
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
        {tags.map((tag) => (
          <Badge
            key={tag}
            variant="secondary"
            className="text-[10px] gap-1 pr-1"
          >
            {tag}
            <button
              onClick={() => removeTag.mutate({ contactId, tagId: tag })}
              className="hover:text-danger transition-colors"
            >
              <X className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
            </button>
          </Badge>
        ))}
      </div>
      <Input
        ref={inputRef}
        placeholder="Add tag…"
        value={newTag}
        onChange={(e) => setNewTag(e.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        className="h-6 text-xs px-2"
        disabled={addTag.isPending}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';

import { useRealtime } from '@/providers/realtime-provider';
function formatTime(seconds: number): string {
  const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const s = (seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
  return `${m}:${s}`;
}
interface ActiveCallIndicatorProps {
  conversationId: string;
}
export function ActiveCallIndicator({ conversationId }: ActiveCallIndicatorProps) {
  const { activeCalls } = useRealtime();
  const call = activeCalls.get(conversationId);
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const callId = call?.callId;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!callId) {
      setElapsed(0);
      return;
    }
    const t = setInterval(() => setElapsed((e) => e + 1), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [callId]);
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {call && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
          className="overflow-hidden"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-accent/10 border-b border-accent/30 shrink-0">
            <motion.div
              animate={{ scale: [1, 1.2, 1] }}
              transition={{ duration: 1, repeat: Infinity }}
              className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-accent/70"
            />
            <Phone className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-accent/75" />
            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-accent/75">
              Active call{call.callerName ? ` · ${call.callerName}` : ''}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-accent/75 ml-auto font-mono">
              {formatTime(elapsed)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { FunnelStage } from '@/services/funnels.service';
import { useUpdateContactStage } from '@/hooks/useFunnels';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import { KanbanColumn } from './KanbanColumn';
import { NoStages } from './NoStages';
interface Props {
  stages: FunnelStage[];
  onConfigure: () => void;
}
export function FunnelKanbanView({ stages, onConfigure }: Props) {
  const [draggingContactId, setDraggingContactId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const updateContactStage = useUpdateContactStage();
  const sorted = [...stages].sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position);
  const handleDrop = (stageId: string) => {
    if (!draggingContactId) return;
    updateContactStage.mutate(
      { contactId: draggingContactId, stageId },
      { onError: () => toast({ title: 'Failed to move contact', variant: 'error' }) },
    );
    setDraggingContactId(null);
  };
  if (sorted.length === 0) return <NoStages onConfigure={onConfigure} />;
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-4 overflow-x-auto pb-4 pt-1 min-h-96">
      {sorted.map((stage) => (
        <KanbanColumn
          key={stage.id}
          stage={stage}
          onDragStart={setDraggingContactId}
          onDrop={handleDrop}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
'use client';

interface Props {

}
export const COLUMN_LIMIT = 50;
export function KanbanColumn({ stage, onDragStart, onDrop }: Props) {
  const [isDragOver, setIsDragOver] = useState(false);
  const { data, isLoading } = useStageContacts(stage.id, COLUMN_LIMIT);
  const contacts = data?.items ?? [];
  const total = data?.meta.total ?? contacts.length;
  const hidden = total - contacts.length;
  return (
    <section
      aria-label={stage.name}
      className="flex flex-col shrink-0 w-72"
      onDragOver={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setIsDragOver(true);
      }}

      onDrop={() => {
        setIsDragOver(false);
        onDrop(stage.id);
      }}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 px-1">
        <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: stageColor(stage.color) }} />
        <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary flex-1 truncate">{stage.name}</h3>
        {isLoading ? (
          <Skeleton className="h-4 w-6 rounded-full" />
        ) : (
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-secondary bg-surface-raised border border-subtle rounded-full px-1.5">
            {total}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      <div
        className={cn(
          'flex-1 min-h-24 rounded-card border p-1.5 space-y-1.5 transition-colors',
          isDragOver ? 'border-accent/30 bg-olive-dark' : 'border-dashed border-subtle bg-surface-raised/60',
        )}
      >
        {isLoading ? (
          <>
            <Skeleton className="h-20 rounded-xl" />
            <Skeleton className="h-20 rounded-xl" />
          </>
        ) : contacts.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted text-center pt-4">No contacts</p>
        ) : (
          contacts.map((contact) => (
            <KanbanContactCard key={contact.id} contact={contact} onDragStart={onDragStart} />
          ))
        )}
        {hidden > 0 && (
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted text-center py-1.5">
            {hidden} more in this stage — see the List view
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import { authClient } from '@/lib/auth-client';
import type { PaginatedResponse } from './conversations.service';

/** Saved views of the lead list (API: GET /conversations/leads?view=). */
export type InboxLeadView = 'open' | 'needs_human' | 'ai' | 'unread' | 'hot' | 'resolved' | 'all';

/** One row of the Inbox: a lead across all their channels. */
export interface InboxLead {
  contact: {
    id: string;
    first_name: string;
    last_name: string | null;
    email: string | null;
    phone: string | null;
    lead_score: number;
    tags: string[];
  };
  channels: string[];
  bot_active: boolean;
  has_active_conversation: boolean;
  is_pinned: boolean;
  unread_count: number;
  last_message_at: string | null;
  last_message: {
    content: string;
    created_at: string;
    direction: 'inbound' | 'outbound' | string;
    channel: string;
    conversation_id: string;
  } | null;
  latest_conversation_id: string | null;
}

export interface LeadConversation {
  id: string;
  contact_id: string;
  channel: string;
  status: string;
  bot_active: boolean;
  last_message_at: string | null;
  last_read_at?: string | null;
}

/** Who handles the lead: the AI (bot_active) or a person. Applies to every active channel. */
export interface LeadControl {
  contact_id: string;
  bot_active: boolean;
  conversations: LeadConversation[];
}

export type UnreachableReason =
  | 'opted_out'
  | 'no_phone'
  | 'channel_not_connected'
  | 'contact_must_start'
  | 'use_call'
  | 'no_text_dispatch';

export interface ReachableChannel {
  channel: string;
  reachable: boolean;
  reason?: UnreachableReason;
  conversation_id?: string | null;
}

export interface InboxLeadsParams {
  view?: InboxLeadView;
  search?: string;
  channel?: string;
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
}

export const inboxService = {
  getLeads: (params: InboxLeadsParams = {}) => {
    const qs = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.view) qs.set('view', params.view);
    if (params.search) qs.set('search', params.search);
    if (params.channel) qs.set('channel', params.channel);
    if (params.page) qs.set('page', String(params.page));
    if (params.limit) qs.set('limit', String(params.limit));
    const q = qs.toString();
    return authClient.get<PaginatedResponse<InboxLead>>(`/conversations/leads${q ? `?${q}` : ''}`);
  },

  getControl: (contactId: string) => authClient.get<LeadControl>(`/contacts/${contactId}/control`),

  /** false = a person takes the lead over; true = give it back to the AI. */
  setControl: (contactId: string, botActive: boolean) =>
    authClient.post<LeadControl>(`/contacts/${contactId}/handoff`, { bot_active: botActive }),

  markRead: (contactId: string) => authClient.post<void>(`/contacts/${contactId}/read`, {}),

  setPinned: (contactId: string, pinned: boolean) =>
    authClient.patch<void>(`/contacts/${contactId}/pin`, { pinned }),

  getReachableChannels: (contactId: string) =>
    authClient.get<ReachableChannel[]>(`/contacts/${contactId}/reachable-channels`),

  startConversation: (contactId: string, channel: 'whatsapp' | 'sms') =>
    authClient.post<LeadConversation>(`/contacts/${contactId}/conversations`, { channel }),
};

'use client';

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient, type QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { inboxService, type InboxLeadsParams } from '@/services/inbox.service';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';

/** Query keys for everything that shows one lead. Mutations invalidate through these. */
export const leadKeys = {
  leads: (params?: InboxLeadsParams) => (params ? (['inbox-leads', params] as const) : (['inbox-leads'] as const)),
  control: (contactId: string) => ['lead-control', contactId] as const,
  reachable: (contactId: string) => ['reachable-channels', contactId] as const,
  contact: (contactId: string) => ['contacts', contactId] as const,
  activity: (contactId: string) => ['contact-activity', contactId] as const,
  capturedFields: (contactId: string) => ['captured-fields', contactId] as const,
  conversations: (contactId: string) => ['contact-messages', contactId] as const,
  appointments: (contactId: string) => ['contact-appointments', contactId] as const,
  calls: (contactId: string) => ['contact-calls', contactId] as const,
  payments: (contactId: string) => ['payments', contactId] as const,
  sequences: (contactId: string) => ['sequences', 'contact', contactId] as const,
};

/** Everything about a lead may have changed (new message, handoff, data capture…). */
export function invalidateLead(queryClient: QueryClient, contactId: string) {
  for (const key of [
    leadKeys.control(contactId),
    leadKeys.reachable(contactId),
    leadKeys.contact(contactId),
    leadKeys.activity(contactId),
    leadKeys.capturedFields(contactId),
    leadKeys.conversations(contactId),
  ]) {
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: key });
  }
  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: leadKeys.leads() });
  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['conversations'] });
}

export function useInboxLeads(params: InboxLeadsParams, enabled = true) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: leadKeys.leads(params),
    queryFn: () => inboxService.getLeads(params),
    enabled,
    refetchInterval: 8000,
    refetchIntervalInBackground: false,
    placeholderData: (previous) => previous,
  });
}

export function useLeadControl(contactId: string | null) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: leadKeys.control(contactId ?? ''),
    queryFn: () => inboxService.getControl(contactId!),
    enabled: !!contactId,
    staleTime: 5_000,
  });
}

export function useReachableChannels(contactId: string | null) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: leadKeys.reachable(contactId ?? ''),
    queryFn: () => inboxService.getReachableChannels(contactId!),
    enabled: !!contactId,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

/** Take the lead over (botActive=false) or give it back to the AI (true). */
export function useSetLeadControl(contactId: string | null) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (botActive: boolean) => inboxService.setControl(contactId!, botActive),
    onSuccess: (control) => {
      qc.setQueryData(leadKeys.control(control.contact_id), control);
      invalidateLead(qc, control.contact_id);
    },
    onError: (err) => toast({ title: (err as Error).message || 'Could not change who handles this lead', variant: 'error' }),
  });
}

export function useMarkLeadRead() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (contactId: string) => inboxService.markRead(contactId),
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: leadKeys.leads() }),
  });
}

export function useSetLeadPinned() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ contactId, pinned }: { contactId: string; pinned: boolean }) =>
      inboxService.setPinned(contactId, pinned),
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: leadKeys.leads() }),
  });
}

export function useStartConversation(contactId: string | null) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (channel: 'whatsapp' | 'sms') => inboxService.startConversation(contactId!, channel),
    onSuccess: () => {
      if (contactId) invalidateLead(qc, contactId);
    },
    onError: (err) => toast({ title: (err as Error).message || 'Could not start the conversation', variant: 'error' }),
  });
}

export function formatTime(seconds: number): string {
  const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const s = seconds % 60;
  return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}
export function getInitials(name: string): string {
  return name
    .split(' ')
    .map((w) => w[0])
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase()
    .slice(0, 2);
}
export function formatRelativeTime(date: string | Date): string {
  const d = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date;
  const now = new Date();
  const diff = now.getTime() - d.getTime();
  const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (mins < 1) return 'just now';
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m`;
  const hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  if (hrs < 24) return `${hrs}h`;
  const days = Math.floor(hrs / 24);
  if (days < 7) return `${days}d`;
  return d.toLocaleDateString();
}
export function formatMoney(cents: number, currency: string): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
    style: 'currency',
    currency: (currency || 'usd').toUpperCase(),
  }).format(cents / 100);
}

/** One way to show a person's name, everywhere a lead appears. */
export interface NamedContact {
  first_name?: string | null;
  last_name?: string | null;
}

export function leadName(contact: NamedContact | null | undefined, fallback = 'Unknown contact'): string {
  if (!contact) return fallback;
  return [contact.first_name, contact.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ').trim() || 'Anonymous';
}

export function leadInitials(contact: NamedContact | null | undefined): string {
  const name = leadName(contact, '?');
  return (
    name
      .split(/\s+/)
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map((w) => w[0])
      .join('')
      .toUpperCase()
      .slice(0, 2) || '?'
  );
}

/** "2m 05s" for call durations. */
export function formatCallDuration(seconds: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (seconds == null) return '—';
  const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const s = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
  return m > 0 ? `${m}m ${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}s` : `${s}s`;
}

/** "03:12" running timer. */
export function formatTimer(seconds: number): string {
  const safe = Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds));
  return `${String(Math.floor(safe / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(safe % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

const CHANNEL_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  whatsapp: 'WhatsApp',
  sms: 'SMS',
  voice: 'Voice',
  webchat: 'Web chat',
  facebook: 'Messenger',
  instagram: 'Instagram',
  email: 'Email',
};

export function channelLabel(channel: string): string {
  return CHANNEL_LABELS[channel] ?? channel;
}

import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { vi, type Mock } from 'vitest';
import { RealtimeClient } from '@/lib/realtime-client';
type Listener = { type: string; event?: string; callback: (arg: unknown) => void };
/** Minimal stand-in for a Supabase RealtimeChannel that tests can drive. */
export class FakeChannel {
  listeners: Listener[] = [];
  presence: Record<string, unknown[]> = {};
  state: 'closed' | 'errored' | 'joined' | 'joining' | 'leaving' = 'closed';
  subscribe: Mock<(callback?: (status: string) => void) => FakeChannel> = vi.fn((callback) => {
    this.state = 'joined';
    callback?.('SUBSCRIBED');
    return this;
  });
  unsubscribe: Mock<() => void> = vi.fn();
  send: Mock<(message: { type: string; event: string; payload: unknown }) => void> = vi.fn();
  track: Mock<(state: unknown) => Promise<string>> = vi.fn(async () => 'ok');
  untrack: Mock<() => Promise<string>> = vi.fn(async () => 'ok');
  constructor(public name: string) {}
  on(type: string, filter: { event?: string }, callback: (arg: unknown) => void) {
    if ((this.state === 'joined' || this.state === 'joining') && type === 'presence') {
      throw new Error(`cannot add \`${type}\` callbacks for realtime:${this.name} after \`subscribe()\`.`);
    }
    this.listeners.push({ type, event: filter.event, callback });
    return this;
  }
  presenceState() {
    return this.presence;
  }
  /** Delivers a broadcast event as Supabase would: `{ payload }`. */
  broadcast(event: string, payload: unknown) {
    this.emit('broadcast', event, { type: 'broadcast', event, payload });
  }
  emit(type: string, event: string, arg: unknown) {
    this.listeners.filter((l) => l.type === type && l.event === event).forEach((l) => l.callback(arg));
  }
}
export function createFakeRealtime() {
  const channels: FakeChannel[] = [];
  const supabase = {
    channel: vi.fn((name: string) => {
      const channel = new FakeChannel(name);
      channels.push(channel);
      return channel;
    }),
  };
  const client = new RealtimeClient(supabase as unknown as SupabaseClient);
  return {
    client,
    channels,
    /** Most recently created channel with this name. */
    channel(name: string) {
      const found = channels.filter((c) => c.name === name).at(-1);
      if (!found) throw new Error(`No realtime channel "${name}" was created`);
      return found;
    },
  };
}

So on this version a second subscribe() is harmless, but presence listeners must be registered before the first subscribe() (the fake mirrors that). The real remaining problem is that the first hook to unmount tears down the shared channel for the others. I'll add reference counting to RealtimeClient: acquire/release, unsubscribing only when the last user leaves.

bash
command:
cd /workspace/apps/web/src && cat > lib/realtime-client.ts <<'EOF'
import type { SupabaseClient, RealtimeChannel } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

export class RealtimeClient {
  private supabase: SupabaseClient;
  private channels = new Map<string, RealtimeChannel>();
  /** How many hooks currently use each shared channel (typing, presence, streaming…). */
  private refs = new Map<string, number>();

  constructor(client: SupabaseClient) {
    this.supabase = client;
  }

  getOrCreate(name: string): RealtimeChannel {
    if (this.channels.has(name)) return this.channels.get(name)!;
    const ch = this.supabase.channel(name);
    this.channels.set(name, ch);
    return ch;
  }

  /**
   * Shared channel for one user of it. Pair every acquire with a release:
   * the channel is only torn down when its last user releases it, so one
   * hook unmounting no longer cuts typing/presence for the others.
   */
  acquire(name: string): RealtimeChannel {
    this.refs.set(name, (this.refs.get(name) ?? 0) + 1);
    return this.getOrCreate(name);
  }

  release(name: string) {
    const left = (this.refs.get(name) ?? 1) - 1;
    if (left > 0) {
      this.refs.set(name, left);
      return;
    }
    this.refs.delete(name);
    this.unsubscribe(name);
  }

  unsubscribe(name: string) {
    const ch = this.channels.get(name);
    if (ch) {
      ch.unsubscribe();
      this.channels.delete(name);
    }
  }

  broadcast(name: string, event: string, payload: unknown) {
    this.getOrCreate(name).send({ type: 'broadcast', event, payload });
  }

  unsubscribeAll() {
    this.channels.forEach((ch) => ch.unsubscribe());
    this.channels.clear();
    this.refs.clear();
  }
}

'use client';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useRealtime } from '@/providers/realtime-provider';
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import type { PresenceUser } from '@/types/realtime.types';
export function usePresence(conversationId: string | null) {
  const { client } = useRealtime();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [presentUsers, setPresentUsers] = useState<PresenceUser[]>([]);
  const [subscribed, setSubscribed] = useState(false);
  const channelRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof client.acquire> | null>(null);
  // The channel lives as long as the conversation is open — independent of
  // the signed-in user, so a user update never tears it down and rejoins.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!conversationId) return;
    const channelName = `conversation:${conversationId}`;
    const ch = client.acquire(channelName);
    channelRef.current = ch;
    const syncPresence = () => {
      setPresentUsers(Object.values(ch.presenceState<PresenceUser>()).flat());
    };
    const channelState = ch.state;
    const alreadySubscribed =
      channelState === 'joined' || channelState === 'joining' || channelState === 'leaving';
    if (alreadySubscribed) {
      // Presence listeners can't be added after subscribe(); another hook
      // already joined, so just announce ourselves.
      setSubscribed(true);
    } else {
      ch.on('presence', { event: 'sync' }, syncPresence).subscribe((status) => {
        if (status === 'SUBSCRIBED') setSubscribed(true);
      });
    }
    return () => {
      void ch.untrack();
      channelRef.current = null;
      setSubscribed(false);
      client.release(channelName);
    };
  }, [conversationId, client]);
  // Announce (or re-announce) the current user once the channel is joined.
  useEffect(() => {
    const ch = channelRef.current;
    if (!ch || !subscribed || !user) return;
    void ch.track({
      userId: user.id,
      userName: user.user_metadata?.full_name ?? user.email ?? 'Agent',
      role: user.user_metadata?.role ?? 'agent',
      onlineAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    } satisfies PresenceUser);
  }, [subscribed, user]);
  return { presentUsers };
}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Phone, PhoneIncoming, PhoneOutgoing } from 'lucide-react';
import { useRealtime } from '@/providers/realtime-provider';
import { formatTimer } from '@/components/lead/lead-format';
import type { ActiveCall } from '@/types/realtime.types';

/** After this long without an end event, the call's state is unknown (lost webhook). */
export const STALE_CALL_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;

/** The call Retell is handling with this lead right now, if any. */
export function useActiveCallForLead(contactId: string | null | undefined): ActiveCall | null {
  const { activeCalls } = useRealtime();
  return useMemo(() => {
    if (!contactId) return null;
    for (const call of activeCalls.values()) {
      if (call.contactId === contactId) return call;
    }
    return null;
  }, [activeCalls, contactId]);
}

function useElapsedSeconds(startedAt: string | null): number {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!startedAt) return;
    setNow(Date.now());
    const t = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [startedAt]);
  return startedAt ? Math.max(0, Math.floor((now - new Date(startedAt).getTime()) / 1000)) : 0;
}

/**
 * Retell runs the call on its side: we know it is in progress and for how
 * long, but what is said only arrives when the call ends (transcript,
 * recording, summary). The banner says exactly that.
 */
export function LiveCallBanner({ contactId }: { contactId: string | null | undefined }) {
  const call = useActiveCallForLead(contactId);
  const elapsed = useElapsedSeconds(call?.startedAt ?? null);
  const stale = elapsed * 1000 > STALE_CALL_MS;
  const DirectionIcon = call?.direction === 'outbound' ? PhoneOutgoing : call?.direction === 'inbound' ? PhoneIncoming : Phone;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {call && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
          className="overflow-hidden"
        >
          <div role="status" className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-accent/30 bg-accent/10 px-4 py-2 shrink-0">
            {!stale && (
              <motion.span
                aria-hidden
                animate={{ scale: [1, 1.25, 1] }}
                transition={{ duration: 1, repeat: Infinity }}
                className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-accent/70"
              />
            )}
            <DirectionIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-accent/80" />
            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-accent/90">
              {stale ? 'Call status unknown — waiting for Retell to report the end' : 'Call in progress · handled by Retell AI'}
            </span>
            <span className="hidden text-[11px] text-secondary md:inline">
              · transcript and recording will appear here when the call ends
            </span>
            {!stale && <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-xs text-accent/80">{formatTimer(elapsed)}</span>}
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
EOF

  /** API view for `kind: 'leads'`. */
  leadView?: InboxLeadView;
  hint: string;
}

export const INBOX_VIEWS: InboxViewDef[] = [
  { id: 'open', label: 'All open', icon: Inbox, kind: 'leads', leadView: 'open', hint: 'Every lead with an open conversation' },
  { id: 'needs_human', label: 'Needs human', icon: AlertCircle, kind: 'leads', leadView: 'needs_human', hint: 'Leads a person has taken over — the AI is silent' },
  { id: 'your_turn', label: 'Your turn', icon: UserCheck, kind: 'your_turn', hint: 'Follow-ups waiting for a person' },
  { id: 'unread', label: 'Unread', icon: Mail, kind: 'leads', leadView: 'unread', hint: 'Leads with messages nobody has opened' },
  { id: 'hot', label: 'Hot', icon: Flame, kind: 'leads', leadView: 'hot', hint: 'Lead score 70 or more' },
  { id: 'ai', label: 'AI active', icon: Bot, kind: 'leads', leadView: 'ai', hint: 'Leads the AI is handling' },
  { id: 'resolved', label: 'Resolved', icon: CheckCheck, kind: 'leads', leadView: 'resolved', hint: 'Leads with no open conversation' },
  { id: 'calls', label: 'Calls', icon: Phone, kind: 'calls', hint: 'Every voice call' },
  { id: 'contacts', label: 'All contacts', icon: Users, kind: 'contacts', hint: 'Every contact, including those who never wrote' },
  { id: 'pipeline', label: 'Pipeline', icon: Columns3, kind: 'pipeline', hint: 'Leads by funnel stage' },
];

export const DEFAULT_VIEW: InboxViewId = 'open';

export function inboxView(id: string | null | undefined): InboxViewDef {
  return INBOX_VIEWS.find((v) => v.id === id) ?? INBOX_VIEWS.find((v) => v.id === DEFAULT_VIEW)!;
}

'use client';

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { inboxView, type InboxViewId } from './inbox-views';

type InboxParam = 'view' | 'lead' | 'q' | 'call' | 'funnel' | 'stage' | 'conversationId' | 'contactId';

/**
 * Everything the Inbox shows lives in the URL, so a link (or the back button)
 * reopens exactly the same view, lead, search and drawer.
 */
export function useInboxUrl() {
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const update = useCallback(
    (patch: Partial<Record<InboxParam, string | null>>) => {
      const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString());
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(patch)) {
        if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') next.delete(key);
        else next.set(key, value);
      }
      const qs = next.toString();
      router.replace(qs ? `${pathname}?${qs}` : pathname, { scroll: false });
    },
    [params, router, pathname],
  );

  const view = inboxView(params.get('view'));

  return {
    view,
    lead: params.get('lead'),
    search: params.get('q') ?? '',
    call: params.get('call'),
    funnel: params.get('funnel'),
    stage: params.get('stage'),
    /** Legacy links: `?conversationId=` (notifications) and `?contactId=` (old contact page). */
    legacyConversationId: params.get('conversationId'),
    legacyContactId: params.get('contactId'),
    update,
    selectLead: (leadId: string | null) => update({ lead: leadId }),
    setView: (id: InboxViewId) => update({ view: id, q: null, stage: null }),
    setSearch: (q: string) => update({ q }),
    openCall: (callId: string | null) => update({ call: callId }),
  };
}

export type InboxUrl = ReturnType<typeof useInboxUrl>;

'use client';
import { Flame, Phone, Pin, UserRound } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn, formatRelativeTime } from '@/lib/utils';
import { ChannelBadge } from './channel-badge';
import { leadInitials, leadName } from '@/components/lead/lead-format';
import type { InboxLead } from '@/services/inbox.service';
export const HOT_LEAD_SCORE = 70;
interface LeadListItemProps {
  lead: InboxLead;
  isActive: boolean;
  onCall: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  onTogglePin: () => void;
}
export function LeadListItem({ lead, isActive, onCall, onClick, onTogglePin }: LeadListItemProps) {
  const name = leadName(lead.contact);
  const isUnread = lead.unread_count > 0;
  const hot = lead.contact.lead_score >= HOT_LEAD_SCORE;
  const time = lead.last_message?.created_at ?? lead.last_message_at;
  const preview = lead.last_message
    ? `${lead.last_message.direction === 'outbound' ? '↑ ' : ''}${lead.last_message.content}`
    : 'No messages yet';
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'group relative flex w-full items-start gap-3 border-b border-l-2 border-subtle px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors',
        isActive ? 'border-l-accent/50 bg-olive-dark' : 'border-l-transparent hover:bg-surface-raised',
      )}
    >
      <button onClick={onClick} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start gap-3 text-left" aria-current={isActive ? 'true' : undefined}>
        <div className="relative mt-0.5 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-olive-dark text-xs font-bold text-accent">
            {leadInitials(lead.contact)}
          </div>
          {isUnread && (
            <span className="absolute -right-0.5 -top-0.5 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-accent ring-2 ring-surface" aria-hidden />
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="grid items-center gap-1" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(0,1fr) auto' }}>
            <p className={cn('truncate text-sm', isUnread ? 'font-bold' : 'font-medium', isActive ? 'text-accent' : 'text-primary')}>
              {name}
            </p>
            <span className="whitespace-nowrap pr-4 text-[10px] text-muted">{time ? formatRelativeTime(time) : ''}</span>
          </div>
          <p className={cn('mt-0.5 truncate text-xs', isUnread ? 'font-medium text-primary' : 'text-muted')}>{preview}</p>
          <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            {lead.channels.map((channel) => (
              <ChannelBadge key={channel} channel={channel} className="px-1.5" />
            ))}
            {!lead.bot_active && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full border border-warning/25 bg-warning/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-warning">
                <UserRound className="h-3 w-3" /> Human
              </span>
            )}
            {hot && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full bg-warning/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-warning">
                <Flame className="h-3 w-3" fill="currentColor" /> {lead.contact.lead_score}
              </span>
            )}
            {onCall && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full bg-accent/15 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-accent">
                <Phone className="h-3 w-3" /> On a call
              </span>
            )}
            {isUnread && (
              <span className="ml-auto inline-flex h-4 min-w-[16px] items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-on-accent">
                {lead.unread_count}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </button>
      <button
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          onTogglePin();
        }}
        title={lead.is_pinned ? 'Unpin lead' : 'Pin lead'}
        aria-label={lead.is_pinned ? `Unpin ${name}` : `Pin ${name}`}
        className={cn(
          'absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 rounded-md p-1 transition-opacity',
          lead.is_pinned ? 'text-accent opacity-100' : 'text-muted opacity-0 hover:bg-surface-hover hover:text-secondary group-hover:opacity-100',
        )}
      >
        <Pin className={cn('h-3.5 w-3.5', lead.is_pinned && 'fill-accent')} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Inbox as InboxIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { useInboxLeads, useSetLeadPinned } from '@/hooks/useInbox';
import { useRealtime } from '@/providers/realtime-provider';
import type { InboxLeadView } from '@/services/inbox.service';
import { LeadListItem } from './lead-list-item';
const PAGE_SIZE = 30;
interface LeadListProps {
  view: InboxLeadView;
  search: string;
  selectedId: string | null;
  onSelect: (contactId: string) => void;
  emptyHint: string;
}
export function LeadList({ view, search, selectedId, onSelect, emptyHint }: LeadListProps) {
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(PAGE_SIZE);
  const { data, isLoading, isFetching } = useInboxLeads({ view, search: search || undefined, limit });
  const setPinned = useSetLeadPinned();
  const { activeCalls } = useRealtime();
  const leadsOnCall = new Set([...activeCalls.values()].map((c) => c.contactId).filter(Boolean));
  const items = data?.items ?? [];
  const total = data?.meta.total ?? 0;
  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-2 p-3" aria-label="Loading leads">
        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="flex gap-3 px-1 py-2">
            <Skeleton className="h-9 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-2 pt-0.5">
              <Skeleton className="h-3.5 w-3/4" />
              <Skeleton className="h-3 w-1/2" />
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (items.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 py-16 text-center">
        <div className="mb-3 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-surface-raised">
          <InboxIcon className="h-5 w-5 text-muted" />
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-secondary">{search ? 'No leads match your search' : 'Nothing here'}</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted">{search ? 'Try a name, phone or email.' : emptyHint}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <ScrollArea className="min-h-0 flex-1">
      <div role="list" aria-label="Leads">
        {items.map((lead) => (
          <div role="listitem" key={lead.contact.id}>
            <LeadListItem
              lead={lead}
              isActive={lead.contact.id === selectedId}
              onCall={leadsOnCall.has(lead.contact.id)}
              onClick={() => onSelect(lead.contact.id)}
              onTogglePin={() => setPinned.mutate({ contactId: lead.contact.id, pinned: !lead.is_pinned })}
            />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {items.length < total && (
        <div className="flex justify-center p-3">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={isFetching} onClick={() => setLimit((l) => l + PAGE_SIZE)}>
            {isFetching ? 'Loading…' : `Load more (${total - items.length})`}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </ScrollArea>
  );
}

function DeliveryState({ message }: { message: Message }) {
  const meta = message.metadata as { optimistic?: boolean; delivery_error?: string } | undefined;
  if (meta?.optimistic) return <span className="text-[10px] text-muted">Sending…</span>;
  if (message.status === 'failed') {
