import { CreditCard, ExternalLink } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn, formatMoney, formatRelativeTime } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { ActivityEvent } from '@/services/activity.service';

type PaymentActivity = Extract<ActivityEvent, { type: 'payment' }>;

const STATUS: Record<string, { label: string; className: string }> = {
  pending: { label: 'Waiting for payment', className: 'text-warning' },
  paid: { label: 'Paid', className: 'text-success' },
  expired: { label: 'Link expired', className: 'text-muted' },
  canceled: { label: 'Cancelled', className: 'text-muted' },
  failed: { label: 'Payment failed', className: 'text-danger' },
  refunded: { label: 'Refunded', className: 'text-muted' },
};

/** A payment link in the lead's thread: who sent it, for what, and what happened. */
export function PaymentEvent({ event }: { event: PaymentActivity }) {
  const status = STATUS[event.status] ?? { label: event.status, className: 'text-secondary' };
  const who = event.origin === 'human' ? `sent by ${event.actor}` : event.origin === 'webhook' ? 'sent by an integration' : 'sent by the AI';

  return (

          <span className="text-muted"> · link {who}</span>

        )}
        <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted">{formatRelativeTime(event.paid_at ?? event.timestamp)}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Now the reply logic, as pure functions so it's unit-testable:


Target: replies go to the lead's active conversation on the channel of its latest inbound message, falling back to the most recent active one.
Composer state: derived from the lead's control state, opt-out tags and channel.

cd /workspace/apps/web/src/components/inbox && cat > reply-target.ts <<'EOF'
import { isOptedOut } from '@crm/shared';
import type { ActivityEvent } from '@/services/activity.service';
import type { LeadControl, LeadConversation } from '@/services/inbox.service';

const CLOSED_STATUSES = new Set(['resolved', 'closed', 'archived']);
/** Channels a person can type into from the Inbox. Voice → Call; email has no chat dispatch. */
const TEXT_CHANNELS = new Set(['whatsapp', 'sms', 'facebook', 'instagram', 'webchat']);

export function isActiveConversation(conversation: Pick<LeadConversation, 'status'>): boolean {
  return !CLOSED_STATUSES.has(conversation.status ?? 'open');
}

export function isTextChannel(channel: string): boolean {
  return TEXT_CHANNELS.has(channel);
}

/**
 * Where a reply to this lead goes: the active conversation on the channel the
 * contact last wrote on; otherwise the most recently active conversation.
 * (The "Reply via" picker is gone — the lead's own behaviour decides.)
 */
export function pickReplyConversation(
  conversations: LeadConversation[],
  events: ActivityEvent[],
): LeadConversation | null {
  const active = conversations.filter(isActiveConversation);
  if (active.length === 0) return null;

  const latestInbound = events
    .filter((e): e is Extract<ActivityEvent, { type: 'message' }> => e.type === 'message' && e.direction === 'inbound')
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime())[0];
  if (latestInbound) {
    const sameChannel = active.find((c) => c.channel === latestInbound.channel);
    if (sameChannel) return sameChannel;
  }

  return [...active].sort(
    (a, b) => new Date(b.last_message_at ?? 0).getTime() - new Date(a.last_message_at ?? 0).getTime(),
  )[0];
}

export type ComposerState =
  | { kind: 'loading' }
  | { kind: 'no_conversation' }
  | { kind: 'opted_out'; target: LeadConversation }
  | { kind: 'no_text'; target: LeadConversation }
  | { kind: 'ai_control'; target: LeadConversation }
  | { kind: 'ready'; target: LeadConversation };

/**
 * What the composer lets the agent do. Order matters: an opt-out blocks
 * everyone; then channels that can't carry text; then who has control.
 */
export function composerStateFor(input: {
  control: LeadControl | undefined;
  target: LeadConversation | null;
  tags: string[] | undefined;
}): ComposerState {
  if (!input.control) return { kind: 'loading' };
  const { target } = input;
  if (!target) return { kind: 'no_conversation' };
  if (isOptedOut(input.tags, target.channel)) return { kind: 'opted_out', target };
  if (!isTextChannel(target.channel)) return { kind: 'no_text', target };
  if (input.control.bot_active) return { kind: 'ai_control', target };
  return { kind: 'ready', target };
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { ActivityEvent } from '@/services/activity.service';
import type { LeadConversation } from '@/services/inbox.service';
import { composerStateFor, pickReplyConversation } from './reply-target';

const conv = (id: string, channel: string, extra: Partial<LeadConversation> = {}): LeadConversation => ({
  id,
  contact_id: 'c1',
  channel,
  status: 'open',
  bot_active: false,
  last_message_at: '2026-03-15T10:00:00Z',
  ...extra,
});

const inbound = (channel: string, timestamp: string): ActivityEvent => ({
  type: 'message',
  id: `m-${channel}-${timestamp}`,
  content: 'hola',
  sender: 'contact',
  sender_type: 'user',
  channel,
  direction: 'inbound',
  timestamp,
});

describe('where a reply goes', () => {
  it('answers on the channel the contact last wrote on', () => {
    const wa = conv('wa', 'whatsapp', { last_message_at: '2026-03-15T12:00:00Z' });
    const sms = conv('sms', 'sms', { last_message_at: '2026-03-15T09:00:00Z' });
    const events = [inbound('whatsapp', '2026-03-15T08:00:00Z'), inbound('sms', '2026-03-15T09:00:00Z')];
    expect(pickReplyConversation([wa, sms], events)?.id).toBe('sms');
  });

  it('falls back to the most recent active conversation', () => {
    const wa = conv('wa', 'whatsapp', { last_message_at: '2026-03-15T12:00:00Z' });
    const sms = conv('sms', 'sms', { last_message_at: '2026-03-15T09:00:00Z' });
    expect(pickReplyConversation([sms, wa], [])?.id).toBe('wa');
  });

  it('never replies into a resolved conversation', () => {
    const resolved = conv('wa', 'whatsapp', { status: 'resolved' });
    expect(pickReplyConversation([resolved], [inbound('whatsapp', '2026-03-15T08:00:00Z')])).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('what the composer allows', () => {
  const human = { contact_id: 'c1', bot_active: false, conversations: [] };
  const ai = { ...human, bot_active: true };

  it('waits for the control state', () => {
    expect(composerStateFor({ control: undefined, target: null, tags: [] }).kind).toBe('loading');
  });

  it('is locked while the AI has control', () => {
    expect(composerStateFor({ control: ai, target: conv('wa', 'whatsapp'), tags: [] }).kind).toBe('ai_control');
  });

  it('is open once a person has taken over', () => {
    expect(composerStateFor({ control: human, target: conv('wa', 'whatsapp'), tags: [] }).kind).toBe('ready');
  });

  it('blocks a channel the contact opted out of, even for a person', () => {
    expect(composerStateFor({ control: human, target: conv('wa', 'whatsapp'), tags: ['opt-out:whatsapp'] }).kind).toBe('opted_out');
    expect(composerStateFor({ control: human, target: conv('sms', 'sms'), tags: ['opt-out:whatsapp'] }).kind).toBe('ready');
  });

  it('does not offer typing on voice or email', () => {
    expect(composerStateFor({ control: human, target: conv('v', 'voice'), tags: [] }).kind).toBe('no_text');
    expect(composerStateFor({ control: human, target: conv('e', 'email'), tags: [] }).kind).toBe('no_text');
  });

  it('asks to start a conversation when there is none open', () => {
    expect(composerStateFor({ control: human, target: null, tags: [] }).kind).toBe('no_conversation');
  });
});

'use client';

import { useMutation, useQueryClient, type InfiniteData } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { conversationsService } from '@/services/conversations.service';
import type { ActivityEvent, ActivityPage } from '@/services/activity.service';
import { ApiError } from '@/lib/auth-client';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import { invalidateLead, leadKeys } from '@/hooks/useInbox';

const REFUSALS: Record<string, string> = {
  AI_HAS_CONTROL: 'The AI is handling this lead. Take over to reply.',
  HUMAN_HAS_CONTROL: 'A person is handling this lead.',
  CHANNEL_OPTED_OUT: 'The contact opted out of this channel.',
};

export function sendErrorMessage(err: unknown): string {
  if (err instanceof ApiError && err.code && REFUSALS[err.code]) return REFUSALS[err.code];
  return (err as Error)?.message || 'Failed to send';
}

interface SendInput {
  conversationId: string;
  channel: string;
  content: string;
}

/**
 * Sends a reply to a lead. The message appears in the thread immediately
 * (written into the activity cache the thread renders from) and is replaced
 * by the stored one once the API answers.
 */
export function useSendLeadMessage(contactId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const key = leadKeys.activity(contactId);

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ conversationId, content }: SendInput) =>
      conversationsService.sendMessage(conversationId, { content }),

    onMutate: async ({ conversationId, channel, content }) => {
      await qc.cancelQueries({ queryKey: key });
      const previous = qc.getQueryData<InfiniteData<ActivityPage>>(key);
      const optimistic: ActivityEvent = {
        type: 'message',
        id: `optimistic-${Date.now()}`,
        content,
        sender: 'agent',
        sender_type: 'agent',
        channel,
        conversation_id: conversationId,
        direction: 'outbound',
        status: 'pending',
        metadata: { optimistic: true },
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      qc.setQueryData<InfiniteData<ActivityPage>>(key, (old) => {
        if (!old?.pages.length) {
          return { pages: [{ events: [optimistic], next_cursor: null }], pageParams: [undefined] };
        }
        const [first, ...rest] = old.pages;
        return { ...old, pages: [{ ...first, events: [optimistic, ...first.events] }, ...rest] };
      });
      return { previous };
    },

    onError: (err, _input, ctx) => {
      qc.setQueryData(key, ctx?.previous);
      toast({ title: sendErrorMessage(err), variant: 'error' });
    },

    onSettled: () => invalidateLead(qc, contactId),
  });
}

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { CreditCard } from 'lucide-react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useCreatePayment, usePaymentServices } from '@/hooks/usePayments';
import { invalidateLead } from '@/hooks/useInbox';
import { ApiError } from '@/lib/auth-client';
import { formatMoney } from '@/lib/utils';
export interface CreatedPaymentLink {
  url: string;
  amount: number;
  currency: string;
  serviceName: string;
}
interface PaymentLinkDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  contactId: string;
  /** The conversation the link is for. Only allowed while a person has taken the lead over. */
  conversationId?: string | null;
  onCreated: (link: CreatedPaymentLink) => void;
}
function errorText(err: unknown): string {
  if (err instanceof ApiError) {
    if (err.code === 'AI_HAS_CONTROL') return 'The AI is handling this lead. Take over before sending a payment link.';
    if (/booking required/i.test(err.message)) {
      return 'This service is charged when booking a time. Use “Book” to pick the slot; the payment link is sent from there.';
    }
  }
  return (err as Error)?.message || 'Could not create the payment link';
}
/** A person charges a lead for a service (a Stripe Checkout link on the org's account). */
export function PaymentLinkDialog({ open, onOpenChange, contactId, conversationId, onCreated }: PaymentLinkDialogProps) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { data: services = [], isLoading } = usePaymentServices();
  const createPayment = useCreatePayment();
  const [serviceId, setServiceId] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const active = services.filter((s) => s.is_active);
  const selected = active.find((s) => s.id === serviceId);
  const submit = async () => {
    if (!selected) return;
    setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await createPayment.mutateAsync({
        contact_id: contactId,
        service_id: selected.id,
        ...(conversationId ? { conversation_id: conversationId } : {}),
      });
      invalidateLead(qc, contactId);
      onCreated({ url: result.url, amount: result.amount, currency: result.currency, serviceName: result.service_name });
      setServiceId('');
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(errorText(err));
    }
  };
  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        if (!next) setError(null);
        onOpenChange(next);
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent className="max-w-sm">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CreditCard className="h-4 w-4 text-accent" /> Payment link
          </DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {isLoading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-secondary">Loading services…</p>
          ) : active.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-secondary">
              There are no active services to charge for. An admin can add them in Settings › Payments setup.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <Select value={serviceId} onValueChange={setServiceId}>
              <SelectTrigger aria-label="Service">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Choose what to charge for" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {active.map((service) => (
                  <SelectItem key={service.id} value={service.id}>
                    {service.name} · {formatMoney(service.amount, '')}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          )}
          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="text-xs text-danger">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={submit} disabled={!selected || createPayment.isPending}>
              {createPayment.isPending ? 'Creating…' : 'Create link'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Bot, CreditCard, Loader2, MessageSquarePlus, Phone, Send, ShieldOff, UserRound } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { formatMoney } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useReachableChannels, useSetLeadControl, useStartConversation } from '@/hooks/useInbox';
import { useSendLeadMessage } from '@/hooks/useLeadMessages';
import { useTypingIndicator } from '@/hooks/useTypingIndicator';
import { PaymentLinkDialog } from '@/components/lead/payment-link-dialog';
import { channelLabel } from '@/components/lead/lead-format';
import { ChannelBadge } from './channel-badge';
import { TemplateSelector } from './template-selector';
import type { ComposerState } from './reply-target';
interface ComposerProps {
  contactId: string;
  state: ComposerState;
  /** Called with the channel the lead should be called on (voice). */
  onCall?: () => void;
}
const NOT_REACHABLE: Record<string, string> = {
  opted_out: 'opted out',
  no_phone: 'no phone number',
  channel_not_connected: 'not connected',
  contact_must_start: 'the contact must write first',
};
function Notice({ icon: Icon, children, action }: { icon: typeof Bot; children: React.ReactNode; action?: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="shrink-0 border-t border-subtle px-4 py-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-subtle bg-surface-raised px-3 py-2.5">
        <Icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-muted" />
        <p className="flex-1 text-xs text-secondary">{children}</p>
        {action}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
/** No open conversation: start one on a channel the lead can be reached on (WhatsApp/SMS). */
function StartConversation({ contactId }: { contactId: string }) {
  const { data: channels = [], isLoading } = useReachableChannels(contactId);
  const start = useStartConversation(contactId);
  const startable = channels.filter((c) => (c.channel === 'whatsapp' || c.channel === 'sms') && c.reachable);
  const blocked = channels.filter((c) => (c.channel === 'whatsapp' || c.channel === 'sms') && !c.reachable);
  return (
    <Notice
      icon={MessageSquarePlus}
      action={
        <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1.5">
          {startable.map((c) => (
            <Button
              key={c.channel}
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              disabled={start.isPending}
              onClick={() => start.mutate(c.channel as 'whatsapp' | 'sms')}
            >
              Start on {channelLabel(c.channel)}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
      }
    >
      {isLoading
        ? 'Checking how to reach this lead…'
        : startable.length
          ? 'No open conversation. Starting one makes you the owner of this lead (the AI stays silent).'
          : `No open conversation, and it can't be started from here${
              blocked.length
                ? ` (${blocked.map((c) => `${channelLabel(c.channel)}: ${NOT_REACHABLE[c.reason ?? ''] ?? c.reason}`).join(' · ')})`
                : ''
            }.`}
    </Notice>
  );
}
/**
 * One composer, five states. While the AI has control the textbox is locked;
 * a person takes over to write. Replies always go to the lead's current
 * channel — there is no channel picker.
 */
export function Composer({ contactId, state, onCall }: ComposerProps) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');
  const [paymentOpen, setPaymentOpen] = useState(false);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const takeOver = useSetLeadControl(contactId);
  const send = useSendLeadMessage(contactId);
  const target = 'target' in state ? state.target : null;
  const { sendTyping, stopTyping } = useTypingIndicator(state.kind === 'ready' ? target?.id ?? null : null);
  if (state.kind === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center border-t border-subtle px-4 py-4 text-muted">
        <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" aria-label="Loading" />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (state.kind === 'no_conversation') return <StartConversation contactId={contactId} />;
  if (state.kind === 'opted_out') {
    return (
      <Notice icon={ShieldOff}>
        The contact opted out of {channelLabel(state.target.channel)}. Remove the opt-out in the lead panel to contact them
        there again.
      </Notice>
    );
  }
  if (state.kind === 'no_text') {
    return (
      <Notice
        icon={Phone}
        action={
          state.target.channel === 'voice' && onCall ? (
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={onCall}>
              <Phone className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Call
            </Button>
          ) : undefined
        }
      >
        {channelLabel(state.target.channel)} conversations can&apos;t receive text from here.
      </Notice>
    );
  }
  if (state.kind === 'ai_control') {
    return (
      <Notice
        icon={Bot}
        action={
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => takeOver.mutate(false)} disabled={takeOver.isPending}>
            <UserRound className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Take over
          </Button>
        }
      >
        The AI is handling this lead on every channel. Take over to reply yourself — the AI stays silent until you return it.
      </Notice>
    );
  }
  const conversation = state.target;
  const handleSend = () => {
    const content = draft.trim();
    if (!content || send.isPending) return;
    setDraft('');
    if (textareaRef.current) textareaRef.current.style.height = 'auto';
    stopTyping();
    send.mutate({ conversationId: conversation.id, channel: conversation.channel, content });
  };
  return (
    <div className="shrink-0 border-t border-subtle px-4 py-3">
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="text-xs text-secondary">Replying on</span>
        <ChannelBadge channel={conversation.channel} showLabel />
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-end gap-2">
        <div className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-subtle bg-surface-raised px-3 py-2">
          <textarea
            ref={textareaRef}
            rows={1}
            aria-label="Message"
            placeholder="Type a message…"
            value={draft}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setDraft(e.target.value);
              sendTyping();
            }}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                e.preventDefault();
                handleSend();
              }
            }}
            onBlur={stopTyping}
            onInput={(e) => {
              const el = e.currentTarget;
              el.style.height = 'auto';
              el.style.height = el.scrollHeight + 'px';
            }}
            className="max-h-32 w-full resize-none bg-transparent text-sm text-primary outline-hidden placeholder:text-muted"
            style={{ height: 'auto', minHeight: '24px' }}
          />
          <p className="mt-1 hidden text-right text-[10px] text-muted sm:block">Enter to send · Shift+Enter for new line</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            className="h-8 w-8 shrink-0"
            onClick={() => setPaymentOpen(true)}
            aria-label="Payment link"
            title="Send a payment link"
          >
            <CreditCard className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
          <TemplateSelector channel={conversation.channel} onSelect={(content) => setDraft(content)} />
          <Button
            size="icon"
            onClick={handleSend}
            disabled={!draft.trim() || send.isPending}
            className={cn('h-8 w-8 shrink-0')}
            aria-label="Send"
          >
            <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <PaymentLinkDialog
        open={paymentOpen}
        onOpenChange={setPaymentOpen}
        contactId={contactId}
        conversationId={conversation.id}
        onCreated={(link) => {
          const line = `Here is your payment link for ${link.serviceName} (${formatMoney(link.amount, link.currency)}): ${link.url}`;
          setDraft((d) => (d.trim() ? `${d.trim()}\n${line}` : line));
          textareaRef.current?.focus();
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { Bot, UserRound } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useLeadControl, useSetLeadControl } from '@/hooks/useInbox';

interface OwnerToggleProps {
  contactId: string;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md';
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Who answers this lead — on every channel. The single control for the
 * AI/human decision (the contact's "created by" origin is a different thing).
 */
export function OwnerToggle({ contactId, size = 'sm', className }: OwnerToggleProps) {
  const { data: control, isLoading } = useLeadControl(contactId);
  const setControl = useSetLeadControl(contactId);
  const hasConversation = (control?.conversations.length ?? 0) > 0;

  if (isLoading || !control) {
    return <span className={cn('h-7 w-40 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-surface-raised', className)} aria-label="Loading owner" />;
  }

  const aiHandles = control.bot_active;
  return (
    <div className={cn('flex items-center gap-2', className)}>
      <span
        className={cn(
          'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium',
          aiHandles ? 'border-accent/20 bg-olive-dark text-accent' : 'border-warning/25 bg-warning/10 text-warning',
        )}
      >
        {aiHandles ? <Bot className="h-3 w-3" /> : <UserRound className="h-3 w-3" />}
        {aiHandles ? 'AI handling' : 'Person handling'}
      </span>
      {hasConversation && (
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant={aiHandles ? 'default' : 'outline'}
          className={cn(size === 'sm' && 'h-7 px-2.5 text-xs')}
          disabled={setControl.isPending}
          onClick={() => setControl.mutate(!aiHandles)}
        >
          {aiHandles ? 'Take over' : 'Return to AI'}
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Resolve the lead: closes every open conversation. The next message from the
 * contact opens a new conversation handled by the AI.
 */
export function useResolveLead(contactId: string | null) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (conversationIds: string[]) => {
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
      const { conversationsService } = await import('@/services/conversations.service');
      await Promise.all(conversationIds.map((id) => conversationsService.resolveConversation(id)));
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      if (contactId) invalidateLead(qc, contactId);
      toast({ title: 'Lead resolved' });
    },
    onError: (err) => toast({ title: (err as Error).message || 'Could not resolve the lead', variant: 'error' }),
  });
}

'use client';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { CheckCheck, UserX } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useContact } from '@/hooks/useContacts';
import { useContactActivity } from '@/hooks/useContactActivity';
import { leadKeys, useLeadControl, useMarkLeadRead, useResolveLead } from '@/hooks/useInbox';
import { useTypingIndicator } from '@/hooks/useTypingIndicator';
import { ApiError } from '@/lib/auth-client';
import { leadInitials, leadName } from '@/components/lead/lead-format';
import { ActivityTimeline, THREAD_FILTERS, type ThreadFilter } from './activity-timeline';
import { ChannelBadge } from './channel-badge';
import { Composer } from './composer';
import { LiveCallBanner } from './live-call-banner';
import { OwnerToggle } from './owner-toggle';
import { PresenceIndicators } from './presence-indicators';
import { composerStateFor, isActiveConversation, pickReplyConversation } from './reply-target';
interface LeadThreadProps {
  contactId: string;
  onOpenCall: (callId: string) => void;
  onCall?: () => void;
  /** The lead no longer exists (deleted, or a stale link). */
  onMissing: () => void;
}
/**
 * The lead's single thread: every channel, call, appointment, payment and
 * stage change in order, with one composer that replies where the lead is.
 */
export function LeadThread({ contactId, onOpenCall, onCall, onMissing }: LeadThreadProps) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { data: contact, isLoading, error } = useContact(contactId);
  const { data: control } = useLeadControl(contactId);
  const { data: activity } = useContactActivity(contactId);
  const markRead = useMarkLeadRead();
  const resolve = useResolveLead(contactId);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<ThreadFilter>('all');
  const events = useMemo(() => activity?.pages.flatMap((p) => p.events) ?? [], [activity?.pages]);
  const conversations = control?.conversations ?? [];
  const activeConversations = conversations.filter(isActiveConversation);
  const target = pickReplyConversation(conversations, events);
  const composerState = composerStateFor({ control, target, tags: contact?.tags });
  const { typingUsers } = useTypingIndicator(target?.id ?? null);
  // Opening the lead (and every new message while it is open) reads it.
  const lastEventId = events[0]?.id;
  useEffect(() => {
    markRead.mutate(contactId);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [contactId, lastEventId]);
  // The AI captured data or a rule moved the stage: refresh the lead panel
  // too (the thread already shows the event; the panel would lag otherwise).
  const latestChange = events.find((e) => e.type === 'contact_data_updated' || e.type === 'funnel_change')?.id;
  const seenChange = useRef(latestChange);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (latestChange && latestChange !== seenChange.current) {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: leadKeys.contact(contactId) });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: leadKeys.capturedFields(contactId) });
    }
    seenChange.current = latestChange;
  }, [latestChange, contactId, qc]);
  const missing = error instanceof ApiError && (error.status === 404 || error.status === 400);
  if (missing) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-surface-raised">
        <div className="px-6 text-center">
          <UserX className="mx-auto mb-3 h-6 w-6 text-muted" />
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-secondary">This contact no longer exists</p>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="mt-3" onClick={onMissing}>
            Back to the list
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col bg-surface">
      <div className="flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-subtle px-4">
        {isLoading || !contact ? (
          <Skeleton className="h-5 w-40" />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-olive-dark text-xs font-bold text-accent">
              {leadInitials(contact)}
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-primary">{leadName(contact)}</p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                {activeConversations.length ? (
                  activeConversations.map((c) => <ChannelBadge key={c.id} channel={c.channel} showLabel />)
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-muted">No open conversation</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3">
          {target && <PresenceIndicators conversationId={target.id} />}
          <OwnerToggle contactId={contactId} />
          {activeConversations.length > 0 && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              className="h-7 gap-1.5 px-2.5 text-xs"
              disabled={resolve.isPending}
              onClick={() => resolve.mutate(activeConversations.map((c) => c.id))}
              title="Close every open conversation — the next message goes back to the AI"
            >
              <CheckCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Resolve
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <LiveCallBanner contactId={contactId} />
      <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-subtle px-4 py-1.5" role="tablist" aria-label="Show in thread">
        {THREAD_FILTERS.map((f) => (
          <button
            key={f.id}
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={filter === f.id}
            onClick={() => setFilter(f.id)}
            className={cn(
              'whitespace-nowrap rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors',
              filter === f.id ? 'bg-olive-dark text-accent' : 'text-secondary hover:bg-surface-hover hover:text-primary',
            )}
          >
            {f.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <ActivityTimeline
        key={`${contactId}-${filter}`}
        conversationId={target?.id ?? null}
        contactId={contactId}
        typingUsers={typingUsers}
        filter={filter}
        onOpenCall={onOpenCall}
      />
      <Composer key={contactId} contactId={contactId} state={composerState} onCall={onCall} />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useFunnels, useCreateFunnel, useFunnelStages } from '@/hooks/useFunnels';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { FunnelTemplateSelector } from './FunnelTemplateSelector';
import { FunnelKanbanView } from './FunnelKanbanView';
import { FunnelListView } from './FunnelListView';
import { StagesDrawer } from './StagesDrawer';
interface PipelineViewProps {
  /** Funnel in the URL (?funnel=); the first funnel when absent. */
  funnelId: string | null;
  onFunnelChange: (funnelId: string) => void;
  selectedId: string | null;
  onOpen: (contactId: string) => void;
}
/**
 * Leads by funnel stage, inside the Inbox. Clicking a card opens the lead in
 * the panel next to the board — the same lead panel every view uses.
 */
export function PipelineView({ funnelId, onFunnelChange, selectedId, onOpen }: PipelineViewProps) {
  const { data: funnels, isLoading: funnelsLoading } = useFunnels();
  const createFunnel = useCreateFunnel();
  const [layout, setLayout] = useState<'board' | 'list'>('board');
  const [configureOpen, setConfigureOpen] = useState(false);
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newFunnelName, setNewFunnelName] = useState('');
  const selectedFunnel = funnels?.find((f) => f.id === funnelId) ?? funnels?.[0];
  const { data: stages = [] } = useFunnelStages(selectedFunnel?.id ?? null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!funnelId && funnels?.length) onFunnelChange(funnels[0].id);
  }, [funnelId, funnels, onFunnelChange]);
  const handleCreateFunnel = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newFunnelName.trim()) return;
    try {
      const funnel = await createFunnel.mutateAsync({ name: newFunnelName.trim() });
      onFunnelChange(funnel.id);
      setCreateOpen(false);
      setNewFunnelName('');
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'Failed to create funnel', variant: 'error' });
    }
  };
  if (funnelsLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex gap-4 p-4">
        {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
          <Skeleton key={i} className="h-80 w-72 shrink-0 rounded-card" />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!funnels?.length) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
        <FunnelTemplateSelector onCreated={onFunnelChange} />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
      <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-b border-subtle px-4 py-2.5">
        <Select value={selectedFunnel?.id} onValueChange={onFunnelChange}>
          <SelectTrigger aria-label="Funnel" className="h-8 w-48 text-sm">
            <SelectValue placeholder="Select a funnel" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {funnels.map((f) => (
              <SelectItem key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                {f.name}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <div className="flex rounded-lg border border-subtle p-0.5" role="tablist" aria-label="Layout">
          {(['board', 'list'] as const).map((id) => (
            <button
              key={id}
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={layout === id}
              onClick={() => setLayout(id)}
              className={cn(
                'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium',
                layout === id ? 'bg-olive-dark text-accent' : 'text-secondary hover:text-primary',
              )}
            >
              {id === 'board' ? <Columns3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <List className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
              {id === 'board' ? 'Board' : 'List'}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="ml-auto flex gap-2">
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setConfigureOpen(true)} disabled={!selectedFunnel}>
            <Settings2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Configure stages
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>
            <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> New funnel
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-auto p-4">
        {layout === 'board' ? (
          <FunnelKanbanView stages={stages} onConfigure={() => setConfigureOpen(true)} onOpen={onOpen} selectedId={selectedId} />
        ) : (
          <FunnelListView stages={stages} onConfigure={() => setConfigureOpen(true)} onOpen={onOpen} selectedId={selectedId} />
        )}
      </div>
      {selectedFunnel && <StagesDrawer funnel={selectedFunnel} open={configureOpen} onOpenChange={setConfigureOpen} />}
      <Dialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-sm">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>New funnel</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <form onSubmit={handleCreateFunnel} className="mt-2 space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="new-funnel-name" className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-primary">
                Name
              </label>
              <Input
                id="new-funnel-name"
                required
                value={newFunnelName}
                onChange={(e) => setNewFunnelName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Sales Q2, Main Pipeline…"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={createFunnel.isPending || !newFunnelName.trim()}>
                {createFunnel.isPending ? 'Creating…' : 'Create'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

export function useUpdateContact() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, body }: { id: string; body: Partial<Contact> }) =>
      contactsService.updateContact(id, body),
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['contacts'] });
    },
  });
}
}
export function useUpdateCapturedFields(contactId: string | null) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (fields: Record<string, string>) =>
      contactsService.updateCapturedData(contactId!, fields),
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['captured-fields', contactId] });
    },
  });
}
export function useCreateSequence() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: CreateSequenceInput) => automationService.createSequence(input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['sequences'] });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['appointments'] });
    },
  });
}
export function useCancelSequence() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => automationService.cancelSequence(id),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['sequences'] });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['appointments'] });
    },
  });
}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const STORAGE_PREFIX = 'lead-panel:collapsed:';

interface PanelSectionProps {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Small text next to the title (counts, totals). */
  meta?: React.ReactNode;
  action?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Collapsible sections remember their state per user (localStorage). */
  collapsible?: boolean;
  defaultCollapsed?: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function PanelSection({
  id,
  title,
  icon,
  meta,
  action,
  collapsible = false,
  defaultCollapsed = false,
  children,
}: PanelSectionProps) {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(collapsible && defaultCollapsed);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!collapsible) return;
    const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_PREFIX + id);
    if (saved !== null) setCollapsed(saved === '1');
  }, [collapsible, id]);

  const toggle = () => {
    const next = !collapsed;
    setCollapsed(next);
    window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_PREFIX + id, next ? '1' : '0');
  };

  const heading = (
    <>
      {collapsible &&
        (collapsed ? <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted" /> : <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted" />)}
      {icon && <span className="text-muted">{icon}</span>}
      <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted">{title}</span>
      {meta && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted normal-case">· {meta}</span>}
    </>
  );

  return (
    <section className="border-b border-subtle px-4 py-3" aria-label={title}>
      <div className="mb-2.5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
        {collapsible ? (
          <button type="button" onClick={toggle} className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-1.5 text-left" aria-expanded={!collapsed}>
            {heading}
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-1.5">{heading}</div>
        )}
        {action}
      </div>
      <div className={cn(collapsed && 'hidden')}>{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

'use client';

import { Copy, Flame, Mail, Phone, Plus, ShieldOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { optedOutChannels } from '@crm/shared';
import { cn, formatRelativeTime } from '@/lib/utils';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import { useReachableChannels, useStartConversation } from '@/hooks/useInbox';
import { ChannelBadge } from '@/components/inbox/channel-badge';
import type { Contact } from '@/services/contacts.service';
import { channelLabel, leadInitials, leadName } from '../lead-format';
import { isHot } from '../contact-helpers';

function CopyLine({ icon: Icon, value, label }: { icon: typeof Phone; value: string; label: string }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => {
        void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(value);
        toast({ title: `${label} copied` });
      }}
      className="group flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-left text-xs text-secondary hover:text-primary"
      title={`Copy ${label.toLowerCase()}`}
    >
      <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted" />
      <span className="truncate">{value}</span>
      <Copy className="ml-auto h-3 w-3 shrink-0 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100" />
    </button>
  );
}

/**
 * Who the lead is and where they talk to us: active channels, channels they
 * opted out of, and channels a person can start (WhatsApp/SMS with their phone).
 */
export function IdentitySection({ contact }: { contact: Contact }) {
  const hot = isHot(contact);
  const { data: channels = [] } = useReachableChannels(contact.id);
  const start = useStartConversation(contact.id);
  const optedOut = optedOutChannels(contact.tags);

  const active = channels.filter((c) => c.conversation_id && c.reachable);
  const blocked = channels.filter((c) => c.reason === 'opted_out');
  const startable = channels.filter(
    (c) => !c.conversation_id && c.reachable && (c.channel === 'whatsapp' || c.channel === 'sms'),
  );

  return (
    <section className="border-b border-subtle px-4 py-4" aria-label="Lead">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div
          className={cn(
            'flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-base font-bold',
            hot ? 'border-2 border-warning/50 text-warning' : 'bg-olive-dark text-accent',
          )}
        >
          {leadInitials(contact)}
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-primary">{leadName(contact)}</p>
            {hot && (
              <span className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full bg-warning/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-warning">
                <Flame className="h-3 w-3" fill="currentColor" /> Hot
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted">
            {contact.handled_by === 'human' ? 'Created manually' : 'Created by AI'}
            {contact.last_contacted_at ? ` · active ${formatRelativeTime(contact.last_contacted_at)}` : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
        {contact.phone && <CopyLine icon={Phone} value={contact.phone} label="Phone" />}
        {contact.email && <CopyLine icon={Mail} value={contact.email} label="Email" />}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5" aria-label="Channels">
        {active.map((c) => (
          <ChannelBadge key={c.channel} channel={c.channel} showLabel />
        ))}
        {blocked.map((c) => (
          <span
            key={c.channel}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-danger/25 bg-danger/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-danger"
            title={`Opted out of ${channelLabel(c.channel)} — nobody contacts them there`}
          >
            <ShieldOff className="h-3 w-3" /> {channelLabel(c.channel)}
          </span>
        ))}
        {optedOut === 'all' && (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-danger/25 bg-danger/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-danger">
            <ShieldOff className="h-3 w-3" /> Opted out of every channel
          </span>
        )}
        {startable.map((c) => (
          <button
            key={c.channel}
            type="button"
            disabled={start.isPending}
            onClick={() => start.mutate(c.channel as 'whatsapp' | 'sms')}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-dashed border-subtle px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-secondary hover:border-strong hover:text-primary disabled:opacity-50"
            title={`Start a ${channelLabel(c.channel)} conversation with the phone the contact gave (you take the lead over)`}
          >
            <Plus className="h-3 w-3" /> {channelLabel(c.channel)}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

'use client';

import { StageSelect } from '@/components/funnel/stage-select';
import { OwnerToggle } from '@/components/inbox/owner-toggle';
import { useUpdateContactStage } from '@/hooks/useFunnels';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { Contact } from '@/services/contacts.service';
import { HOT_THRESHOLD } from '../contact-helpers';

function Row({ label, children }: { label: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="grid items-center gap-2" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '56px minmax(0,1fr)' }}>
      <span className="text-[11px] text-muted">{label}</span>
      <div className="min-w-0">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** The decisions about a lead, each with exactly one control. */
export function DecisionsSection({ contact }: { contact: Contact }) {
  const updateStage = useUpdateContactStage();
  const score = contact.lead_score ?? 0;

  return (
    <section className="space-y-2.5 border-b border-subtle px-4 py-3" aria-label="Decisions">
      <Row label="Owner">
        <OwnerToggle contactId={contact.id} />
      </Row>
      <Row label="Stage">
        <StageSelect
          value={contact.lead_stage}
          disabled={updateStage.isPending}
          className="h-8"
          onValueChange={(stageId) =>
            updateStage.mutate(
              { contactId: contact.id, stageId },
              { onError: () => toast({ title: 'Failed to update stage', variant: 'error' }) },
            )
          }
        />
      </Row>
      <Row label="Score">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2" title="Calculated from what the lead told us (budget, timeline, urgency…)">
          <div className="h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full bg-surface-raised">
            <div
              className={cn('h-1.5 rounded-full', score >= HOT_THRESHOLD ? 'bg-warning' : 'bg-accent')}
              style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, score))}%` }}
            />
          </div>
          <span className="w-7 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-primary">{score}</span>
        </div>
      </Row>
    </section>
  );
}

import { voiceService } from '@/services/voice.service';
import { useActiveCallForLead } from '@/components/inbox/live-call-banner';
import { isActiveConversation } from '@/components/inbox/reply-target';
import type { Contact } from '@/services/contacts.service';
import { PaymentLinkDialog } from '../payment-link-dialog';
import { leadHref } from '../lead-chip';
import { leadName } from '../lead-format';

interface ActionsSectionProps {
  contact: Contact;
  /** In a drawer outside the Inbox the first action opens the lead in the Inbox. */
  variant: 'inbox' | 'drawer';
}

function ActionButton({
  icon: Icon,
  label,
  onClick,
  disabled,
  title,
}: {
  icon: typeof Phone;
  label: string;
  onClick?: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  title?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <Button
      type="button"
      variant="outline"
      size="sm"
      className="h-8 flex-1 basis-[calc(50%-4px)] gap-1.5 px-2 text-xs"
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      title={title}
    >
      <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> {label}
    </Button>
  );
}

export function ActionsSection({ contact, variant }: ActionsSectionProps) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { data: control } = useLeadControl(contact.id);
  const { data: calendars = [] } = useCalendars();
  const activeCall = useActiveCallForLead(contact.id);
  const [drawer, setDrawer] = useState<null | 'book' | 'follow_up'>(null);
  const [paymentOpen, setPaymentOpen] = useState(false);

  const bookCalendar = calendars.find((c) => c.is_active && c.type !== 'follow_up');
  const followUpCalendar = calendars.find((c) => c.type === 'follow_up');
  const humanHandles = control ? !control.bot_active : false;
  const conversation = control?.conversations.find(isActiveConversation) ?? null;
  const voiceBlocked = isOptedOut(contact.tags, 'voice');

  const call = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => voiceService.startCall({ contact_id: contact.id }),
    onSuccess: () => toast({ title: 'Call started', description: 'Retell is calling the contact.' }),
    onError: (err) =>
      toast({
        title:
          err instanceof ApiError && err.code === 'CHANNEL_OPTED_OUT'
            ? 'The contact opted out of calls'
            : (err as Error).message || 'Could not start the call',
        variant: 'error',
      }),
  });

  const callTitle = !contact.phone
    ? 'No phone number'
    : voiceBlocked
      ? 'The contact opted out of calls'
      : activeCall
        ? 'A call is already in progress'
        : 'Call the lead (Retell AI)';

  return (
    <section className="border-b border-subtle px-4 py-3" aria-label="Actions">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {variant === 'drawer' && (
          <Button asChild size="sm" className="h-8 flex-1 basis-full gap-1.5 text-xs">
            <Link href={leadHref(contact.id)}>
              <MessageSquare className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Open in Inbox
            </Link>
          </Button>
        )}
        <ActionButton
          icon={Phone}
          label="Call"
          onClick={() => call.mutate()}
          disabled={!contact.phone || voiceBlocked || !!activeCall || call.isPending}
          title={callTitle}
        />
        <ActionButton
          icon={CalendarPlus}
          label="Book"
          onClick={() => setDrawer('book')}
          disabled={!bookCalendar}
          title={bookCalendar ? 'Book an appointment' : 'No calendar to book on'}
        />
        <ActionButton
          icon={CreditCard}
          label="Payment link"
          onClick={() => setPaymentOpen(true)}
          disabled={!humanHandles}
          title={humanHandles ? 'Charge the lead for a service' : 'The AI charges while it handles the lead. Take over to send a link yourself.'}
        />
        <ActionButton
          icon={Repeat}
          label="Follow-up"
          onClick={() => setDrawer('follow_up')}
          disabled={!followUpCalendar}
          title="Schedule a follow-up or start a sequence"
        />
      </div>

      <AppointmentDrawer
        open={drawer !== null}
        onClose={() => {
          setDrawer(null);
          invalidateLead(qc, contact.id);
          qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['contact-appointments', contact.id] });
          qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['sequences', 'contact', contact.id] });
        }}
        calendarId={(drawer === 'follow_up' ? followUpCalendar?.id : bookCalendar?.id) ?? null}
        initialContact={{ id: contact.id, label: leadName(contact) }}
      />

      <PaymentLinkDialog
        open={paymentOpen}
        onOpenChange={setPaymentOpen}
        contactId={contact.id}
        conversationId={conversation?.id ?? null}
        onCreated={(link) => {
          void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(link.url);
          toast({ title: 'Payment link copied', description: 'Paste it in the conversation to send it.' });
        }}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

  {
    variants: {

  private recordStageChange(
    contact: ContactEntity,
    organizationId: string,
    fromStageId: string | null,
    toStageId: string,
    changedBy: string | null,
    source: 'manual' | 'automation',
    reason: string | null,
  ): void {
    // Fire-and-forget history log
    void this.historyRepo.save(
      this.historyRepo.create({
        contact_id: contact.id,
        from_stage_id: fromStageId,
        to_stage_id: toStageId,
        changed_by: changedBy,
        source,
        reason,
      }),
    );
    this.rmqClient?.emit(RABBITMQ_QUEUES.CONTACT_STAGE_CHANGED, {
      organization_id: organizationId,
      contact_id: contact.id,
      first_name: contact.first_name,
  });
}

'use client';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { AlertTriangle, CalendarClock, Copy, CreditCard, Repeat, UserCheck, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { AppointmentStatusBadge } from '@/components/agenda/appointment-status-badge';
import { useContactAppointments } from '@/hooks/useContacts';
import { useConfirmAppointment, useResendConfirmation } from '@/hooks/useAppointments';
import { useCancelSequence, useCompleteFollowUp, useContactFollowUps } from '@/hooks/useAutomation';
import { usePayments } from '@/hooks/usePayments';
import { useSequenceSteps } from '@/hooks/useSequenceTemplates';
import { usePermissions } from '@/hooks/usePermissions';
import { invalidateLead, leadKeys } from '@/hooks/useInbox';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import { formatMoney, formatRelativeTime } from '@/lib/utils';
import { automationService } from '@/services/automation.service';
import { actionMeta, SEQUENCE_TYPE_LABELS } from '@/components/sequences/sequence-constants';
import type { Contact } from '@/services/contacts.service';
import { recommendedAction } from '../contact-helpers';
import { PanelSection } from '../panel-section';
const UPCOMING_STATUSES = new Set(['held', 'scheduled', 'confirmed']);
function Item({ icon: Icon, children, tone = 'default' }: { icon: typeof Zap; children: React.ReactNode; tone?: 'default' | 'danger' | 'warning' }) {
  const color = tone === 'danger' ? 'text-danger' : tone === 'warning' ? 'text-warning' : 'text-accent';
  return (
    <li className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-subtle bg-surface-raised px-2.5 py-2">
      <Icon className={`mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 ${color}`} />
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1.5 text-xs">{children}</div>
    </li>
  );
}
function formatWhen(iso: string): string {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleString(undefined, { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
}
/** What happens next with this lead. Only rows that exist are shown. */
export function NextSection({ contact }: { contact: Contact }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { canResolvePaymentAttention } = usePermissions();
  const { data: appointments = [] } = useContactAppointments(contact.id);
  const { data: payments = [] } = usePayments(contact.id);
  const { data: yourTurn = [] } = useContactFollowUps(contact.id, { status: 'awaiting_user' });
  const { data: sequences } = useQuery({
    queryKey: leadKeys.sequences(contact.id),
    queryFn: () => automationService.listSequences({ contact_id: contact.id, status: 'active' }),
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
  const sequence = sequences?.items?.[0];
  const { data: steps } = useSequenceSteps(sequence?.id ?? null);
  const confirm = useConfirmAppointment();
  const resend = useResendConfirmation();
  const complete = useCompleteFollowUp();
  const cancelSequence = useCancelSequence();
  const now = Date.now();
  const nextAppointment = [...appointments]
    .filter((a) => UPCOMING_STATUSES.has(a.status) && new Date(a.ends_at ?? a.starts_at).getTime() > now)
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.starts_at).getTime() - new Date(b.starts_at).getTime())[0];
  const attention = payments.find((p) => p.attention_reason && !p.resolved_at);
  const pending = payments.find((p) => p.status === 'pending');
  const currentStep = steps?.find((s) => s.position === sequence?.current_attempt);
  const suggestion = recommendedAction(contact);
  const refresh = () => {
    invalidateLead(qc, contact.id);
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: leadKeys.appointments(contact.id) });
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['contact-follow-ups', contact.id] });
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: leadKeys.sequences(contact.id) });
  };
  const run = async (action: () => Promise<unknown>, success: string) => {
    try {
      await action();
      toast({ title: success });
      refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      toast({ title: (err as Error).message || 'Action failed', variant: 'error' });
    }
  };
  const nothing = !nextAppointment && !attention && !pending && !sequence && yourTurn.length === 0;
  return (
    <PanelSection id="next" title="Next">
      {nothing && !suggestion ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted">Nothing pending for this lead.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="space-y-2">
          {yourTurn.map((task) => (
            <Item key={task.id} icon={UserCheck} tone="warning">
              <p className="font-medium text-primary">Your turn: {task.title}</p>
              <p className="text-muted">Due {formatRelativeTime(task.due_at)} ago · {actionMeta(task.action).label}</p>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                className="h-7 text-[11px]"
                disabled={complete.isPending}
                onClick={() => run(() => complete.mutateAsync(task.id), 'Follow-up marked as done')}
              >
                Mark done
              </Button>
            </Item>
          ))}
          {nextAppointment && (
            <Item icon={CalendarClock}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <p className="truncate font-medium text-primary">{nextAppointment.title}</p>
                <AppointmentStatusBadge status={nextAppointment.status} />
              </div>
              <p className="text-muted">{formatWhen(nextAppointment.starts_at)}</p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {nextAppointment.status === 'scheduled' && (
                  <>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      className="h-7 text-[11px]"
                      disabled={confirm.isPending}
                      onClick={() => run(() => confirm.mutateAsync(nextAppointment.id), 'Appointment confirmed')}
                    >
                      Confirm
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="ghost"
                      className="h-7 text-[11px]"
                      disabled={resend.isPending}
                      onClick={() => run(() => resend.mutateAsync(nextAppointment.id), 'Confirmation link sent again')}
                    >
                      Resend link
                    </Button>
                  </>
                )}
                <Link
                  href={`/schedule?appointment=${nextAppointment.id}`}
                  className="inline-flex h-7 items-center px-2 text-[11px] font-medium text-accent hover:text-accent-hover"
                >
                  Open in schedule
                </Link>
              </div>
            </Item>
          )}
          {attention && (
            <Item icon={AlertTriangle} tone="danger">
              <p className="font-medium text-primary">
                Paid {formatMoney(attention.amount, attention.currency)} — needs a person
              </p>
              <p className="text-muted">{(attention.attention_reason ?? '').replace(/_/g, ' ')}</p>
              {canResolvePaymentAttention && (
                <Link href="/payments?tab=attention" className="text-[11px] font-medium text-accent hover:text-accent-hover">
                  Resolve in Payments
                </Link>
              )}
            </Item>
          )}
          {pending && (
            <Item icon={CreditCard}>
              <p className="font-medium text-primary">
                {formatMoney(pending.amount, pending.currency)} waiting for payment
                {pending.service?.name ? ` · ${pending.service.name}` : ''}
              </p>
              <p className="text-muted">Link sent {formatRelativeTime(pending.created_at)} ago</p>
              {pending.checkout_url && (
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="ghost"
                  className="h-7 gap-1 text-[11px]"
                  onClick={() => {
                    void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(pending.checkout_url!);
                    toast({ title: 'Payment link copied' });
                  }}
                >
                  <Copy className="h-3 w-3" /> Copy link
                </Button>
              )}
            </Item>
          )}
          {sequence && (
            <Item icon={Repeat}>
              <p className="font-medium text-primary">
                {SEQUENCE_TYPE_LABELS[sequence.sequence_type] ?? sequence.sequence_type} · step {sequence.current_attempt} of{' '}
                {sequence.max_attempts}
              </p>
              {currentStep && <p className="text-muted">Next: {actionMeta(currentStep.action).label}</p>}
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="ghost"
                className="h-7 text-[11px] text-danger hover:bg-danger/10 hover:text-danger"
                disabled={cancelSequence.isPending}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (window.confirm('Cancel the automatic follow-up for this lead?')) {
                    void run(() => cancelSequence.mutateAsync(sequence.id), 'Follow-up cancelled');
                  }
                }}
              >
                Cancel follow-up
              </Button>
            </Item>
          )}
          {suggestion && (
            <Item icon={Zap}>
              <p className="font-medium text-primary">Suggested: {suggestion.title}</p>
              <p className="text-muted">{suggestion.description}</p>
            </Item>
          )}
        </ul>
      )}
    </PanelSection>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { ListChecks } from 'lucide-react';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { useCaptureFieldLabels } from '@/hooks/useAIAgents';
import { useUpdateCapturedFields } from '@/hooks/useCapturedFields';
import { usePermissions } from '@/hooks/usePermissions';
import { leadKeys } from '@/hooks/useInbox';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import type { Contact } from '@/services/contacts.service';
import { fieldIcon, fieldLabel, visibleCustomFields } from '../contact-helpers';
import { PanelSection } from '../panel-section';

/**
 * What the lead told us (budget, timeline, service…), with the labels the
 * agent uses. Saving goes through captured-data, so lead scoring and funnel
 * rules react exactly as when the AI captures it.
 */
export function QualificationSection({ contact }: { contact: Contact }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { data: labels } = useCaptureFieldLabels();
  const update = useUpdateCapturedFields(contact.id);
  const { canManageConfiguration } = usePermissions();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const fields = visibleCustomFields(contact);

  const save = (key: string) => {
    const value = editing[key];
    setEditing((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      delete next[key];
      return next;
    });
    const current = fields.find(([k]) => k === key)?.[1];
    if (value === undefined || value === current) return;
    update.mutate(
      { [key]: value },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: leadKeys.contact(contact.id) });
          qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: leadKeys.activity(contact.id) });
        },
        onError: () => toast({ title: 'Could not save the field', variant: 'error' }),
      },
    );
  };

  return (
    <PanelSection
      id="qualification"
      title="Qualification"
      icon={<ListChecks className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
      meta={fields.length ? `${fields.length}` : undefined}
      collapsible
      action={
        canManageConfiguration ? (
          <Link href="/config/agents" className="text-[10px] font-medium text-muted hover:text-accent" title="Choose which data the agent captures">
            Configure
          </Link>
        ) : undefined
      }
    >
      {fields.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted">Nothing captured yet. The AI fills this in as the lead talks.</p>
      ) : (
        <dl className="space-y-1.5">
          {fields.map(([key, value]) => {
            const Icon = fieldIcon(key);
            return (
              <div key={key} className="grid items-center gap-2" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.2fr)' }}>
                <dt className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted">
                  <Icon className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate">{fieldLabel(key, labels)}</span>
                </dt>
                <dd>
                  <Input
                    aria-label={fieldLabel(key, labels)}
                    className="h-6 border-transparent bg-transparent px-1.5 text-right text-[11px] hover:border-subtle focus:border-subtle"
                    value={editing[key] ?? value}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditing((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: e.target.value }))}
                    onBlur={() => save(key)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === 'Enter') (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
                    }}
                  />
                </dd>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </dl>
      )}
    </PanelSection>
  );
}

'use client';

import { Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { Contact } from '@/services/contacts.service';
import { prettifySentiment } from '../contact-helpers';
import { PanelSection } from '../panel-section';

/** The AI's read on the lead. Shown only when there is one. */
export function InsightsSection({ contact }: { contact: Contact }) {
  const insights = contact.ai_insights;
  if (!insights?.summary && !insights?.intent && !insights?.sentiment) return null;
  const sentiment = prettifySentiment(insights.sentiment);

  return (
    <PanelSection id="insights" title="AI summary" icon={<Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} collapsible>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {(insights.intent || sentiment) && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
            {insights.intent && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-surface-raised px-2 py-0.5 capitalize text-secondary">Intent: {insights.intent}</span>
            )}
            {sentiment && (
              <span
                className={cn(
                  'rounded-full px-2 py-0.5',
                  sentiment === 'Positive' ? 'bg-success/10 text-success' : sentiment === 'Negative' ? 'bg-danger/10 text-danger' : 'bg-surface-raised text-secondary',
                )}
              >
                {sentiment}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        {insights.summary && <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-secondary">{insights.summary}</p>}
      </div>
    </PanelSection>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Calendar, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, CreditCard, ExternalLink, MessageSquare, Phone, Repeat } from 'lucide-react';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { AppointmentStatusBadge } from '@/components/agenda/appointment-status-badge';
import { ChannelBadge } from '@/components/inbox/channel-badge';
import { isActiveConversation } from '@/components/inbox/reply-target';
import { useContactAppointments, useContactCalls } from '@/hooks/useContacts';
import { useContactFollowUps } from '@/hooks/useAutomation';
import { useLeadControl } from '@/hooks/useInbox';
import { usePayments } from '@/hooks/usePayments';
import { actionMeta } from '@/components/sequences/sequence-constants';
import { formatMoney, formatRelativeTime } from '@/lib/utils';
import { formatCallDuration } from '../lead-format';
const PAYMENT_STATUS: Record<string, { label: string; variant: 'success' | 'warn' | 'default' | 'destructive' }> = {
  paid: { label: 'Paid', variant: 'success' },
  pending: { label: 'Pending', variant: 'warn' },
  expired: { label: 'Expired', variant: 'default' },
  canceled: { label: 'Cancelled', variant: 'default' },
  failed: { label: 'Failed', variant: 'destructive' },
  refunded: { label: 'Refunded', variant: 'default' },
};
function Group({
  title,
  icon: Icon,
  count,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  icon: typeof Phone;
  count?: React.ReactNode;
  children: (open: boolean) => React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="border-b border-subtle last:border-b-0">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        aria-expanded={open}
        className="flex w-full items-center gap-1.5 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-primary"
      >
        {open ? <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted" /> : <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted" />}
        <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted" />
        {title}
        {count !== undefined && <span className="text-muted">({count})</span>}
      </button>
      {open && <div className="pb-2.5 pl-5">{children(open)}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}
const Empty = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => <p className="text-[11px] text-muted">{children}</p>;
function AppointmentsList({ contactId }: { contactId: string }) {
  const { data: appointments = [], isLoading } = useContactAppointments(contactId);
  if (isLoading) return <Empty>Loading…</Empty>;
  if (!appointments.length) return <Empty>No appointments.</Empty>;
  return (
    <ul className="space-y-1.5">
      {appointments.map((a) => (
        <li key={a.id}>
          <Link href={`/schedule?appointment=${a.id}`} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] hover:text-accent">
            <span className="min-w-0">
              <span className="block truncate font-medium text-primary">{a.title}</span>
              <span className="text-muted">{new Date(a.starts_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
            </span>
            <AppointmentStatusBadge status={a.status} />
          </Link>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
function PaymentsList({ contactId }: { contactId: string }) {
  const { data: payments = [], isLoading } = usePayments(contactId);
  if (isLoading) return <Empty>Loading…</Empty>;
  if (!payments.length) return <Empty>No payment links yet.</Empty>;
  return (
    <ul className="space-y-1.5">
      {payments.map((p) => {
        const status = PAYMENT_STATUS[p.status] ?? PAYMENT_STATUS.pending;
        return (
          <li key={p.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px]">
            <span className="min-w-0">
              <span className="block truncate font-medium text-primary">
                {formatMoney(p.amount, p.currency)} · {p.service?.name ?? 'Service'}
              </span>
              <span className="text-muted">{formatRelativeTime(p.paid_at ?? p.created_at)}</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5">
              <Badge variant={status.variant}>{status.label}</Badge>
              {p.status === 'pending' && p.checkout_url && (
                <a href={p.checkout_url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open payment link" className="text-accent">
                  <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
                </a>
              )}
            </span>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}
function FollowUpsList({ contactId }: { contactId: string }) {
  const { data: steps = [], isLoading } = useContactFollowUps(contactId);
  if (isLoading) return <Empty>Loading…</Empty>;
  if (!steps.length) return <Empty>No follow-ups.</Empty>;
  return (
    <ul className="space-y-1.5">
      {steps.slice(0, 10).map((s) => (
        <li key={s.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px]">
          <span className="min-w-0">
            <span className="block truncate font-medium text-primary">{s.title || actionMeta(s.action).label}</span>
            <span className="text-muted">{new Date(s.due_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
          </span>
          <span className="shrink-0 capitalize text-muted">{s.status.replace('_', ' ')}</span>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
function CallsList({ contactId, onOpenCall }: { contactId: string; onOpenCall?: (callId: string) => void }) {
  const { data, isLoading } = useContactCalls(contactId);
  const calls = data?.calls ?? [];
  if (isLoading) return <Empty>Loading…</Empty>;
  if (!calls.length) return <Empty>No calls.</Empty>;
  return (
    <ul className="space-y-1.5">
      {calls.map((c) => (
        <li key={c.id}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onOpenCall?.(c.id)}
            disabled={!onOpenCall}
            className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 text-left text-[11px] hover:text-accent disabled:cursor-default"
          >
            <span className="text-primary">{new Date(c.started_at ?? c.created_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
            <span className="shrink-0 text-muted">
              {formatCallDuration(c.duration_seconds ?? null)} · {c.status.replace('_', ' ')}
            </span>
          </button>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
function ConversationsList({ contactId }: { contactId: string }) {
  const { data: control } = useLeadControl(contactId);
  const conversations = control?.conversations ?? [];
  if (!conversations.length) return <Empty>No open conversations.</Empty>;
  return (
    <ul className="space-y-1.5">
      {conversations.map((c) => (
        <li key={c.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px]">
          <ChannelBadge channel={c.channel} showLabel />
          <span className="text-muted">
            {isActiveConversation(c) ? (c.bot_active ? 'AI' : 'Person') : c.status}
            {c.last_message_at ? ` · ${formatRelativeTime(c.last_message_at)}` : ''}
          </span>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
/** Everything linked to the lead, collapsed until needed (nothing loads before it opens). */
export function RelatedSection({ contactId, onOpenCall }: { contactId: string; onOpenCall?: (callId: string) => void }) {
  return (
    <section className="border-b border-subtle px-4 py-1" aria-label="Related">
      <Group title="Appointments" icon={Calendar}>
        {() => <AppointmentsList contactId={contactId} />}
      </Group>
      <Group title="Payments" icon={CreditCard}>
        {() => <PaymentsList contactId={contactId} />}
      </Group>
      <Group title="Follow-ups" icon={Repeat}>
        {() => <FollowUpsList contactId={contactId} />}
      </Group>
      <Group title="Calls" icon={Phone}>
        {() => <CallsList contactId={contactId} onOpenCall={onOpenCall} />}
      </Group>
      <Group title="Conversations" icon={MessageSquare}>
        {() => <ConversationsList contactId={contactId} />}
      </Group>
    </section>
  );
}
