'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { ShieldOff, Tag, UserPen, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { OPT_OUT_TAG, optOutTag } from '@crm/shared';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { ContactTags } from '@/components/inbox/contact-tags';
import { useAddTag, useRemoveTag, useUpdateContact } from '@/hooks/useContacts';
import { invalidateLead } from '@/hooks/useInbox';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import type { Contact } from '@/services/contacts.service';
import { channelLabel } from '../lead-format';
import { PanelSection } from '../panel-section';
const OPT_OUT_CHANNELS = ['whatsapp', 'sms', 'voice', 'email', 'facebook', 'instagram'];
const FIELDS: Array<{ key: 'first_name' | 'last_name' | 'email' | 'phone'; label: string; type?: string }> = [
  { key: 'first_name', label: 'First name' },
  { key: 'last_name', label: 'Last name' },
  { key: 'email', label: 'Email', type: 'email' },
  { key: 'phone', label: 'Phone' },
];
function ContactFields({ contact }: { contact: Contact }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const update = useUpdateContact();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ first_name: '', last_name: '', email: '', phone: '' });
  const start = () => {
    setForm({
      first_name: contact.first_name ?? '',
      last_name: contact.last_name ?? '',
      email: contact.email ?? '',
      phone: contact.phone ?? '',
    });
    setEditing(true);
  };
  const save = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await update.mutateAsync({ id: contact.id, body: form });
      invalidateLead(qc, contact.id);
      setEditing(false);
      toast({ title: 'Contact updated' });
    } catch (err) {
      toast({ title: (err as Error).message || 'Could not update the contact', variant: 'error' });
    }
  };
  if (!editing) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <dl className="space-y-1 text-[11px]">
          {FIELDS.map((f) => (
            <div key={f.key} className="flex justify-between gap-2">
              <dt className="text-muted">{f.label}</dt>
              <dd className="truncate text-right text-primary">{contact[f.key] || '—'}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
            <dt className="text-muted">Created</dt>
            <dd className="text-right text-primary">{new Date(contact.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-7 gap-1 px-2 text-[11px]" onClick={start}>
          <UserPen className="h-3 w-3" /> Edit details
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <form onSubmit={save} className="space-y-2">
      {FIELDS.map((f) => (
        <label key={f.key} className="block text-[11px] text-muted">
          {f.label}
          <Input
            type={f.type ?? 'text'}
            required={f.key === 'first_name'}
            className="mt-0.5 h-7 text-xs"
            value={form[f.key]}
            onChange={(e) => setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [f.key]: e.target.value }))}
          />
        </label>
      ))}
      <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
        <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-7 text-[11px]" onClick={() => setEditing(false)}>
          Cancel
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit" size="sm" className="h-7 text-[11px]" disabled={update.isPending}>
          Save
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
/** Per-channel opt-outs: nobody (person, AI or automation) contacts the lead there. */
function OptOuts({ contact }: { contact: Contact }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const addTag = useAddTag();
  const removeTag = useRemoveTag();
  const [channel, setChannel] = useState('');
  const tags = contact.tags ?? [];
  const all = tags.includes(OPT_OUT_TAG);
  const channels = OPT_OUT_CHANNELS.filter((c) => tags.includes(optOutTag(c)));
  const available = OPT_OUT_CHANNELS.filter((c) => !channels.includes(c));
  const refresh = () => invalidateLead(qc, contact.id);
  const remove = (tag: string) => removeTag.mutate({ contactId: contact.id, tagId: tag }, { onSuccess: refresh });
  const add = (c: string) => {
    addTag.mutate({ contactId: contact.id, tag: optOutTag(c) }, { onSuccess: refresh });
    setChannel('');
  };
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
        {all && (
          <Badge variant="destructive" className="gap-1 pr-1 text-[10px]">
            <ShieldOff className="h-2.5 w-2.5" /> Every channel
            <button onClick={() => remove(OPT_OUT_TAG)} aria-label="Remove the opt-out of every channel" className="hover:text-primary">
              <X className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
            </button>
          </Badge>
        )}
        {channels.map((c) => (
          <Badge key={c} variant="destructive" className="gap-1 pr-1 text-[10px]">
            <ShieldOff className="h-2.5 w-2.5" /> {channelLabel(c)}
            <button onClick={() => remove(optOutTag(c))} aria-label={`Remove the ${channelLabel(c)} opt-out`} className="hover:text-primary">
              <X className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
            </button>
          </Badge>
        ))}
        {!all && channels.length === 0 && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted">The contact can be reached on every channel.</p>}
      </div>
      {!all && available.length > 0 && (
        <Select value={channel} onValueChange={add}>
          <SelectTrigger className="h-7 text-[11px]" aria-label="Stop contacting on a channel">
            <SelectValue placeholder="Stop contacting on…" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {available.map((c) => (
              <SelectItem key={c} value={c} className="text-xs">
                {channelLabel(c)}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export function DetailsSection({ contact }: { contact: Contact }) {
  const generalTags = (contact.tags ?? []).filter((t) => t !== OPT_OUT_TAG && !t.startsWith(`${OPT_OUT_TAG}:`));
  return (
    <>
      <PanelSection id="details" title="Details" icon={<UserPen className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} collapsible defaultCollapsed>
        <ContactFields contact={contact} />
      </PanelSection>
      <PanelSection id="tags" title="Tags" icon={<Tag className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} collapsible>
        <ContactTags contactId={contact.id} tags={generalTags} />
      </PanelSection>
      <PanelSection id="opt-outs" title="Opt-outs" icon={<ShieldOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} collapsible defaultCollapsed>
        <OptOuts contact={contact} />
      </PanelSection>
    </>
  );
}

'use client';

import { UserX } from 'lucide-react';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useContact } from '@/hooks/useContacts';
import { IdentitySection } from './sections/identity-section';
import { DecisionsSection } from './sections/decisions-section';
import { ActionsSection } from './sections/actions-section';
import { NextSection } from './sections/next-section';
import { QualificationSection } from './sections/qualification-section';
import { InsightsSection } from './sections/insights-section';
import { RelatedSection } from './sections/related-section';
import { DetailsSection } from './sections/details-section';

interface LeadPanelProps {
  contactId: string;
  /** Inbox right column, or the drawer other pages open on a contact name. */
  variant?: 'inbox' | 'drawer';
  onOpenCall?: (callId: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Contact 360: the one place every decision about a lead is made — the same
 * component in the Inbox and in the drawer opened from any other page.
 */
export function LeadPanel({ contactId, variant = 'inbox', onOpenCall, className }: LeadPanelProps) {
  const { data: contact, isLoading, isError } = useContact(contactId);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={cn('space-y-3 p-4', className)} aria-label="Loading lead">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Skeleton className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full" />
          <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
            <Skeleton className="h-4 w-32" />
            <Skeleton className="h-3 w-24" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Skeleton className="h-20 w-full rounded-lg" />
        <Skeleton className="h-16 w-full rounded-lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isError || !contact) {
    return (
      <div className={cn('flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center', className)}>
        <UserX className="mb-2 h-5 w-5 text-muted" />
        <p className="text-xs text-muted">This contact no longer exists.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={cn('flex flex-col', className)} aria-label={`Lead ${contact.first_name}`}>
      <IdentitySection contact={contact} />
      <DecisionsSection contact={contact} />
      <ActionsSection contact={contact} variant={variant} />
      <NextSection contact={contact} />
      <QualificationSection contact={contact} />
      <InsightsSection contact={contact} />
      <RelatedSection contactId={contact.id} onOpenCall={onOpenCall} />
      <DetailsSection contact={contact} />
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { UserCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { useFollowUps } from '@/hooks/useAutomation';
import { actionMeta } from '@/components/sequences/sequence-constants';
import { cn, formatRelativeTime } from '@/lib/utils';
import { leadName } from '@/components/lead/lead-format';

interface YourTurnListProps {
  selectedId: string | null;
  onSelect: (contactId: string) => void;
}

/**
 * Follow-up steps waiting for a person: steps a person owns, create_task
 * steps, and automated steps that were due while someone had taken the lead over.
 */
export function YourTurnList({ selectedId, onSelect }: YourTurnListProps) {
  const { data, isLoading } = useFollowUps({ status: 'awaiting_user', sort: 'asc', limit: 100 });
  const items = data?.items ?? [];

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-2 p-3">
        {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
          <Skeleton key={i} className="h-14 w-full rounded-lg" />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!items.length) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 py-16 text-center">
        <UserCheck className="mb-3 h-6 w-6 text-muted" />
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-secondary">Nothing waiting for you</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted">Follow-ups that need a person show up here.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ScrollArea className="min-h-0 flex-1">
      <ul aria-label="Follow-ups waiting for a person">
        {items.map((step) => {
          const Icon = actionMeta(step.action).icon;
          return (
            <li key={step.id}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSelect(step.contact_id)}
                className={cn(
                  'flex w-full items-start gap-3 border-b border-l-2 border-subtle px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors',
                  step.contact_id === selectedId ? 'border-l-accent/50 bg-olive-dark' : 'border-l-transparent hover:bg-surface-raised',
                )}
              >
                <span className="mt-0.5 flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-warning/10 text-warning">
                  <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
                </span>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="block truncate text-sm font-medium text-primary">{leadName(step.contact)}</span>
                  <span className="block truncate text-xs text-secondary">{step.title || actionMeta(step.action).label}</span>
                  <span className="block text-[10px] text-muted">Due {formatRelativeTime(step.due_at)} ago</span>
                </span>
              </button>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </ScrollArea>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Phone, PhoneIncoming, PhoneOutgoing } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { useVoiceCallStats, useVoiceCalls } from '@/hooks/useVoice';
import { cn, formatRelativeTime } from '@/lib/utils';
import { formatCallDuration, leadName } from '@/components/lead/lead-format';
import type { VoiceCall, VoiceCallDirection, VoiceCallStatus } from '@/services/voice.service';
const PAGE_SIZE = 30;
const STATUS_LABEL: Record<VoiceCallStatus, string> = {
  in_progress: 'In progress',
  completed: 'Completed',
  failed: 'Failed',
  initiated: 'Ringing',
};
const FILTERS: Array<{ id: string; label: string; status?: VoiceCallStatus; direction?: VoiceCallDirection }> = [
  { id: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { id: 'in_progress', label: 'Live', status: 'in_progress' },
  { id: 'inbound', label: 'Inbound', direction: 'inbound' },
  { id: 'outbound', label: 'Outbound', direction: 'outbound' },
];
interface CallsListProps {
  selectedCallId: string | null;
  onSelect: (call: VoiceCall) => void;
}
/** Every voice call (the old Voice page), worked from the Inbox. */
export function CallsList({ selectedCallId, onSelect }: CallsListProps) {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all');
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(PAGE_SIZE);
  const active = FILTERS.find((f) => f.id === filter) ?? FILTERS[0];
  const { data, isLoading, isFetching } = useVoiceCalls({ limit, offset: 0, status: active.status, direction: active.direction });
  const { data: stats } = useVoiceCallStats();
  const calls = data?.items ?? [];
  const total = data?.meta.total ?? 0;
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col">
      <div className="grid shrink-0 grid-cols-3 gap-2 border-b border-subtle px-4 py-2.5 text-center">
        {[
          ['Total', String(stats?.total ?? '—')],
          ['Live now', String(stats?.active ?? '—')],
          ['Avg', formatCallDuration(stats?.avg_duration_seconds ?? null)],
        ].map(([label, value]) => (
          <div key={label}>
            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">{label}</p>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">{value}</p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1 border-b border-subtle px-4 py-2" role="tablist" aria-label="Filter calls">
        {FILTERS.map((f) => (
          <button
            key={f.id}
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={filter === f.id}
            onClick={() => {
              setFilter(f.id);
              setLimit(PAGE_SIZE);
            }}
            className={cn(
              'rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium',
              filter === f.id ? 'bg-olive-dark text-accent' : 'text-secondary hover:bg-surface-hover hover:text-primary',
            )}
          >
            {f.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="space-y-2 p-3">
          {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
            <Skeleton key={i} className="h-12 w-full rounded-lg" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : calls.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 py-16 text-center">
          <Phone className="mb-3 h-6 w-6 text-muted" />
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-secondary">No calls</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ScrollArea className="min-h-0 flex-1">
          <ul aria-label="Calls">
            {calls.map((call) => {
              const DirectionIcon = call.direction === 'outbound' ? PhoneOutgoing : PhoneIncoming;
              const phone = call.direction === 'outbound' ? call.phone_to : call.phone_from;
              return (
                <li key={call.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onSelect(call)}
                    className={cn(
                      'flex w-full items-center gap-3 border-b border-l-2 border-subtle px-4 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors',
                      call.id === selectedCallId ? 'border-l-accent/50 bg-olive-dark' : 'border-l-transparent hover:bg-surface-raised',
                    )}
                  >
                    <DirectionIcon className={cn('h-4 w-4 shrink-0', call.direction === 'outbound' ? 'text-accent' : 'text-success')} />
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="block truncate text-sm font-medium text-primary">
                        {call.contact ? leadName(call.contact) : phone}
                      </span>
                      <span className="block truncate text-[11px] text-muted">
                        {STATUS_LABEL[call.status] ?? call.status} · {formatCallDuration(call.duration_seconds)}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted">
                      {formatRelativeTime(call.started_at ?? call.created_at)}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
          {calls.length < total && (
            <div className="flex justify-center p-3">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={isFetching} onClick={() => setLimit((l) => l + PAGE_SIZE)}>
                {isFetching ? 'Loading…' : 'Load more'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </ScrollArea>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { Phone, PhoneIncoming, PhoneOutgoing } from 'lucide-react';
import { Drawer, DrawerContent } from '@/components/ui/drawer';
import { DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { CallRecordingPlayer } from '@/components/voice/call-recording-player';
import { useVoiceCall, useVoiceTranscripts } from '@/hooks/useVoice';
import { formatCallDuration, leadName } from '@/components/lead/lead-format';
import type { TranscriptSpeaker, VoiceCallStatus } from '@/services/voice.service';

const STATUS_CLASSES: Record<VoiceCallStatus, string> = {
  in_progress: 'bg-success/15 text-success',
  completed: 'bg-olive-dark text-accent',
  failed: 'bg-danger/15 text-danger',
  initiated: 'bg-surface-raised text-secondary',
};

const BUBBLE_CLASSES: Record<TranscriptSpeaker, { wrapper: string; bubble: string; label: string }> = {
  user: { wrapper: 'items-start', bubble: 'bg-surface-raised text-primary rounded-xl', label: 'text-[10px] text-muted mb-1' },
  ai: { wrapper: 'items-end', bubble: 'border border-accent/15 bg-olive-dark text-primary rounded-xl', label: 'text-[10px] text-muted mb-1 text-right' },
  system: {
    wrapper: 'items-center',
    bubble: 'bg-warning/10 text-warning border border-warning/25 rounded-xl',
    label: 'text-[10px] text-muted mb-1 text-center',
  },
};

function formatDate(iso: string | null): string {
  return iso ? new Date(iso).toLocaleString() : '—';
}

interface CallDrawerProps {
  callId: string | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}

/**
 * One call: metadata, recording and transcript. Retell runs the call, so while
 * it is in progress there is nothing to show yet — the content arrives when it ends.
 */
export function CallDrawer({ callId, onClose }: CallDrawerProps) {
  const { data: call, isLoading } = useVoiceCall(callId);
  const inProgress = call?.status === 'in_progress' || call?.status === 'initiated';
  // No live transcript from Retell: only fetch it once the call is over.
  const { data: transcripts, isLoading: transcriptsLoading } = useVoiceTranscripts(inProgress ? null : callId);

  return (
    <Drawer open={!!callId} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && onClose()}>
      <DrawerContent side="right" className="flex w-full max-w-lg flex-col gap-5 overflow-y-auto p-6" aria-describedby={undefined}>
        <DialogTitle className="sr-only">Call details</DialogTitle>
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="h-5 w-48 animate-pulse rounded-sm bg-surface-raised" />
            <div className="h-4 w-64 animate-pulse rounded-sm bg-surface-raised" />
          </div>
        ) : !call ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted">Call not found.</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-olive-dark text-accent">
                  <Phone className="h-4 w-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-primary">{call.contact ? leadName(call.contact) : 'Unknown contact'}</p>
                    {call.direction === 'outbound' ? (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-accent">
                        <PhoneOutgoing className="h-3 w-3" /> Outbound
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-success">
                        <PhoneIncoming className="h-3 w-3" /> Inbound
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-secondary">
                    {call.phone_from} → {call.phone_to}
                  </p>
                  <p className="font-mono text-[10px] text-muted">{call.external_call_id}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium ${STATUS_CLASSES[call.status] ?? 'bg-surface-raised text-secondary'}`}>
                {call.status.replace('_', ' ')}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 border-t border-subtle pt-4">
              {[
                ['Duration', formatCallDuration(call.duration_seconds)],
                ['Started', formatDate(call.started_at)],
                ['Ended', formatDate(call.ended_at)],
              ].map(([label, value]) => (
                <div key={label}>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted">{label}</p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-medium text-primary">{value}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {inProgress ? (
              <p role="status" className="rounded-lg border border-accent/25 bg-accent/10 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-accent">
                Call in progress · handled by Retell AI. The recording and transcript appear here when the call ends.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="border-t border-subtle pt-4">
                  <p className="mb-2 text-xs text-muted">Recording</p>
                  <CallRecordingPlayer recordingUrl={call.recording_url} emptyState={<p className="text-sm text-muted">No recording available.</p>} />
                </div>
                <div className="border-t border-subtle pt-4">
                  <h3 className="mb-3 text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Transcript</h3>
                  {transcriptsLoading ? (
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                        <div key={i} className="h-10 animate-pulse rounded-sm bg-surface-raised" />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : !transcripts?.length ? (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted">No transcript available.</p>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      {transcripts.map((t) => {
                        const styles = BUBBLE_CLASSES[t.speaker] ?? BUBBLE_CLASSES.system;
                        return (
                          <div key={t.id} className={`flex flex-col ${styles.wrapper}`}>
                            <p className={styles.label}>
                              {t.speaker}
                              {t.timestamp_seconds != null && <span className="ml-1.5">{t.timestamp_seconds}s</span>}
                            </p>
                            <div className={`max-w-[85%] px-3 py-2 text-sm ${styles.bubble}`}>{t.content}</div>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </DrawerContent>
    </Drawer>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Download, Plus, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAllFunnelStages, useContactStats, useContacts, useCreateContact } from '@/hooks/useContacts';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import { contactsService, type Contact } from '@/services/contacts.service';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { leadInitials, leadName } from '@/components/lead/lead-format';
import { HOT_THRESHOLD } from '@/components/lead/contact-helpers';
const PAGE_SIZE = 30;
function csvCell(value: unknown): string {
  const text = String(value ?? '');
  return /[",\n]/.test(text) ? `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : text;
}
async function exportContacts() {
  const contacts = (await contactsService.exportContacts()) as Contact[];
  const headers = ['ID', 'First Name', 'Last Name', 'Email', 'Phone', 'Lead Stage', 'Lead Score', 'Created By', 'Created At'];
  const rows = contacts.map((c) =>
    [c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.phone, c.lead_stage, c.lead_score ?? 0, c.handled_by === 'human' ? 'manual' : 'ai', c.created_at]
      .map(csvCell)
      .join(','),
  );
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([[headers.join(','), ...rows].join('\n')], { type: 'text/csv' }));
  Object.assign(document.createElement('a'), { href: url, download: 'contacts.csv' }).click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
interface ContactsListProps {
  search: string;
  stageId: string | null;
  onStageChange: (stageId: string | null) => void;
  selectedId: string | null;
  onSelect: (contactId: string) => void;
}
/** Every contact — including those who never wrote — worked from the Inbox. */
export function ContactsList({ search, stageId, onStageChange, selectedId, onSelect }: ContactsListProps) {
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(PAGE_SIZE);
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ first_name: '', last_name: '', email: '', phone: '' });
  const { data, isLoading, isFetching } = useContacts({ search: search || undefined, stage_id: stageId ?? undefined, page: 1, limit });
  const { data: stats } = useContactStats();
  const { data: stages = [] } = useAllFunnelStages();
  const createContact = useCreateContact();
  const contacts = data?.items ?? [];
  const total = data?.meta.total ?? 0;
  const handleCreate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const created = await createContact.mutateAsync(form);
      setCreateOpen(false);
      setForm({ first_name: '', last_name: '', email: '', phone: '' });
      onSelect(created.id);
    } catch (err) {
      toast({ title: (err as Error).message || 'Could not create the contact', variant: 'error' });
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col">
      <div className="shrink-0 space-y-2 border-b border-subtle px-4 py-2.5">
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted">
          {stats ? (
            <>
              {stats.total.toLocaleString()} contacts · {stats.new_this_month} new this month · {stats.ai_handled} created by AI ·{' '}
              {stats.human_handled} created manually
            </>
          ) : (
            'Loading…'
          )}
        </p>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Select value={stageId ?? 'all'} onValueChange={(v) => onStageChange(v === 'all' ? null : v)}>
            <SelectTrigger className="h-8 flex-1 text-xs" aria-label="Stage">
              <SelectValue placeholder="All stages" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All stages</SelectItem>
              {stages.map((s) => (
                <SelectItem key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                  {s.name}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-8 px-2" onClick={() => void exportContacts()} title="Export CSV" aria-label="Export CSV">
            <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" className="h-8 gap-1 px-2.5" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>
            <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Add
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="space-y-2 p-3">
          {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
            <Skeleton key={i} className="h-12 w-full rounded-lg" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : contacts.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 py-16 text-center">
          <Users className="mb-3 h-6 w-6 text-muted" />
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-secondary">{search ? 'No contacts match your search' : 'No contacts yet'}</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ScrollArea className="min-h-0 flex-1">
          <ul aria-label="Contacts">
            {contacts.map((contact) => {
              const stage = stages.find((s) => s.id === contact.lead_stage);
              const score = contact.lead_score ?? 0;
              return (
                <li key={contact.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onSelect(contact.id)}
                    className={cn(
                      'flex w-full items-center gap-3 border-b border-l-2 border-subtle px-4 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors',
                      contact.id === selectedId ? 'border-l-accent/50 bg-olive-dark' : 'border-l-transparent hover:bg-surface-raised',
                    )}
                  >
                    <span className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-olive-dark text-[11px] font-bold text-accent">
                      {leadInitials(contact)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="block truncate text-sm font-medium text-primary">{leadName(contact)}</span>
                      <span className="block truncate text-[11px] text-muted">{contact.phone ?? contact.email ?? '—'}</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex shrink-0 flex-col items-end gap-0.5">
                      {stage && <span className="rounded-full bg-surface-raised px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-primary">{stage.name}</span>}
                      <span className={cn('text-[10px]', score >= HOT_THRESHOLD ? 'font-semibold text-warning' : 'text-muted')}>
                        Score {score}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
          {contacts.length < total && (
            <div className="flex justify-center p-3">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={isFetching} onClick={() => setLimit((l) => l + PAGE_SIZE)}>
                {isFetching ? 'Loading…' : `Load more (${total - contacts.length})`}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </ScrollArea>
      )}
      <Dialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Add contact</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <form onSubmit={handleCreate} className="mt-2 space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <label className="text-xs font-medium text-primary">
                First name
                <Input required className="mt-1.5" value={form.first_name} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, first_name: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Ana" />
              </label>
              <label className="text-xs font-medium text-primary">
                Last name
                <Input className="mt-1.5" value={form.last_name} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, last_name: e.target.value }))} placeholder="García" />
              </label>
            </div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-primary">
              Email
              <Input type="email" className="mt-1.5" value={form.email} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, email: e.target.value }))} placeholder="ana@example.com" />
            </label>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-primary">
              Phone
              <Input className="mt-1.5" value={form.phone} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, phone: e.target.value }))} placeholder="+34 600 000 000" />
            </label>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={createContact.isPending}>
                {createContact.isPending ? 'Creating…' : 'Create contact'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { MessageSquare, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useConversation } from '@/hooks/useConversations';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import { voiceService } from '@/services/voice.service';
import { LeadList } from '@/components/inbox/lead-list';
import { YourTurnList } from '@/components/inbox/your-turn-list';
import { CallsList } from '@/components/inbox/calls-list';
import { ContactsList } from '@/components/inbox/contacts-list';
import { LeadThread } from '@/components/inbox/lead-thread';
import { INBOX_VIEWS } from '@/components/inbox/inbox-views';
import { useInboxUrl } from '@/components/inbox/use-inbox-url';
import { LeadPanel } from '@/components/lead/lead-panel';
import { CallDrawer } from '@/components/calls/call-drawer';
import { PipelineView } from '@/components/pipeline/pipeline-view';
/** Old links keep working: ?conversationId= (notifications) and ?contactId= (old contact page). */
function useLegacyLinks(url: ReturnType<typeof useInboxUrl>) {
  const { data: legacyConversation, isError } = useConversation(url.legacyConversationId);
  const { update, legacyContactId, legacyConversationId } = url;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (legacyContactId) update({ lead: legacyContactId, contactId: null });
  }, [legacyContactId, update]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!legacyConversationId) return;
    if (legacyConversation?.contact_id) update({ lead: legacyConversation.contact_id, conversationId: null });
    else if (isError) update({ conversationId: null });
  }, [legacyConversationId, legacyConversation?.contact_id, isError, update]);
}
function SearchBox({ value, onChange, placeholder }: { value: string; onChange: (q: string) => void; placeholder: string }) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => setDraft(value), [value]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (draft === value) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => onChange(draft.trim()), 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [draft, value, onChange]);
  return (
    <div className="relative w-full max-w-64">
      <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted" />
      <Input
        aria-label="Search leads"
        placeholder={placeholder}
        value={draft}
        onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
        className="h-8 border-subtle bg-surface-raised pl-8 text-xs"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
function EmptyThread() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-surface-raised">
      <div className="px-6 text-center">
        <div className="mx-auto mb-3 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-surface">
          <MessageSquare className="h-5 w-5 text-muted" />
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-secondary">Select a lead</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted">Their conversation, calls, appointments and payments open here.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
function InboxContent() {
  const url = useInboxUrl();
  useLegacyLinks(url);
  const { view, lead, search, update, selectLead } = url;
  const setSearch = useCallback((q: string) => update({ q }), [update]);
  const onFunnelChange = useCallback((funnelId: string) => update({ funnel: funnelId }), [update]);
  const startCall = async () => {
    if (!lead) return;
    try {
      await voiceService.startCall({ contact_id: lead });
      toast({ title: 'Call started', description: 'Retell is calling the contact.' });
    } catch (err) {
      toast({ title: (err as Error).message || 'Could not start the call', variant: 'error' });
    }
  };
  const searchable = view.kind === 'leads' || view.kind === 'contacts';
  const panel = lead ? (
    <aside className="thin-scrollbar hidden w-[340px] shrink-0 overflow-y-auto border-l border-subtle bg-surface lg:block" aria-label="Lead panel">
      <LeadPanel contactId={lead} onOpenCall={(id) => url.openCall(id)} />
    </aside>
  ) : null;
  return (
    <div className="panel-card flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3 border-b border-subtle px-3 py-2">
        <nav className="thin-scrollbar flex min-w-0 flex-1 gap-1 overflow-x-auto" aria-label="Inbox views">
          {INBOX_VIEWS.map((v, i) => {
            const Icon = v.icon;
            const separator = i > 0 && INBOX_VIEWS[i - 1].kind !== 'calls' && v.kind === 'calls';
            return (
              <div key={v.id} className="flex items-center gap-1">
                {separator && <span className="mx-1 h-5 w-px bg-divider" aria-hidden />}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  title={v.hint}
                  aria-current={view.id === v.id ? 'page' : undefined}
                  onClick={() => url.setView(v.id)}
                  className={cn(
                    'inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors',
                    view.id === v.id
                      ? 'border border-accent/20 bg-olive-dark text-accent'
                      : 'border border-transparent text-secondary hover:bg-surface-hover hover:text-primary',
                  )}
                >
                  <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  {v.label}
                </button>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </nav>
        {searchable && (
          <SearchBox
            value={search}
            onChange={setSearch}
            placeholder={view.kind === 'contacts' ? 'Search contacts…' : 'Search leads…'}
          />
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1">
        {view.kind === 'pipeline' ? (
          <>
            <PipelineView funnelId={url.funnel} onFunnelChange={onFunnelChange} selectedId={lead} onOpen={selectLead} />
            {panel}
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex w-[320px] shrink-0 flex-col border-r border-subtle bg-surface">
              {view.kind === 'leads' && (
                <LeadList
                  key={view.id}
                  view={view.leadView ?? 'open'}
                  search={search}
                  selectedId={lead}
                  onSelect={selectLead}
                  emptyHint={view.hint}
                />
              )}
              {view.kind === 'your_turn' && <YourTurnList selectedId={lead} onSelect={selectLead} />}
              {view.kind === 'calls' && (
                <CallsList
                  selectedCallId={url.call}
                  onSelect={(call) => update({ lead: call.contact_id ?? lead, call: call.id })}
                />
              )}
              {view.kind === 'contacts' && (
                <ContactsList
                  search={search}
                  stageId={url.stage}
                  onStageChange={(stage) => update({ stage })}
                  selectedId={lead}
                  onSelect={selectLead}
                />
              )}
            </div>
            {lead ? (
              <LeadThread
                key={lead}
                contactId={lead}
                onOpenCall={(id) => url.openCall(id)}
                onCall={startCall}
                onMissing={() => selectLead(null)}
              />
            ) : (
              <EmptyThread />
            )}
            {panel}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <CallDrawer callId={url.call} onClose={() => url.openCall(null)} />
    </div>
  );
}
export default function InboxPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <InboxContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

const PAGE_TITLES: Record<string, string> = {
  '/': 'Dashboard',
  '/inbox': 'Inbox',
  '/schedule': 'Schedule',
  '/payments': 'Payments',
  // Settings
  '/templates': 'Quick replies',
  '/config/agents': 'AI Agent',

  '/config/webhooks': 'Webhooks',

  '/config/communications': 'Notifications',

  '/admin/team': 'Team',
  '/admin/billing': 'Billing',
  '/admin/api-keys': 'API keys',
  '/admin/demo': 'Demo Requests',
  // Platform
  '/platform/demo-accounts': 'Demo Accounts',
};
const DETAIL_TITLES: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [];
function getPageTitle(pathname: string): string {
  const exact = PAGE_TITLES[pathname];
  if (exact) return exact;
  const detail = DETAIL_TITLES.find(([pattern]) => pattern.test(pathname));
  if (detail) return detail[1];
  const parent = Object.keys(PAGE_TITLES)
    .filter((route) => route !== '/' && pathname.startsWith(route + '/'))
    .sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)[0];
  return parent ? PAGE_TITLES[parent] : 'CRM';
}

  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { user, signOut } = useAuth();

'use client';
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { conversationsService, type ConversationListParams } from '@/services/conversations.service';
export function useConversations(filters?: ConversationListParams) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['conversations', filters],
    queryFn: () => conversationsService.getConversations(filters),
    // Poll the list so last-message preview, ordering and unread counts stay
    // current as messages come and go. Only while the tab is focused.
    refetchInterval: 8000,
    refetchIntervalInBackground: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: true,
  });
}
export function useConversation(id: string | null) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['conversations', id],
    queryFn: () => conversationsService.getConversation(id!),
    enabled: !!id,
  });
}
export function useResolveConversation() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => conversationsService.resolveConversation(id),
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['conversations'] });
    },
  });
}

/**

}

Found it: the header says "Dashboard", so RoleGate redirected to /. In React Query v5, a disabled query (auth user not known yet) reports isLoading: false. My gate therefore decided "no access" before the user loaded. The old layout only redirected once a user existed. I'll make usePermissions report loading until the user actually arrives (isPending).

bash
command:
cd /workspace/apps/web/src && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='hooks/usePermissions.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""export function usePermissions(): UsePermissionsResult {
  const { data: user, isLoading, isError } = useCurrentUser();
  return { ...permissionsFor(user), isLoading, isError };
}""","""export function usePermissions(): UsePermissionsResult {
  // `isPending`, not `isLoading`: until the auth user is known the query is
  // disabled, and a disabled query reports isLoading=false with no data —
  // deciding then would treat everyone as having no rights.
  const { data: user, isPending, isError } = useCurrentUser();
  return { ...permissionsFor(user), isLoading: isPending && !isError, isError };
}""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

/**
 * Serves every API call the app makes from `scenario`. Unexpected endpoints
 * get an empty list and are recorded so tests can surface them.
 */
export async function mockApi(page: Page, scenario: Scenario): Promise<{ unexpected: string[] }> {
  const unexpected: string[] = [];
  const user = {
    id: 'member-1',
    auth_user_id: testUser.id,
    organization_id: ORG_ID,
    email: testUser.email,
    full_name: scenario.user.full_name ?? 'Olivia Owner',
    role: scenario.user.role,
    is_active: true,
    is_platform_admin: scenario.user.is_platform_admin ?? false,
    created_at: '2026-01-05T09:00:00.000Z',
    updated_at: '2026-01-05T09:00:00.000Z',
  };
  const respond = async (route: Route, value: unknown) => {
    if (value === 'pending') return; // never fulfilled: keeps the UI in its loading state
    if (value === 'error') {
      return route.fulfill({ status: 500, json: { statusCode: 500, message: 'Service temporarily unavailable' } });
    }
    return route.fulfill({ json: { data: value, timestamp: '2026-06-15T12:00:00.000Z' } });
  };
  await page.route(`${API_URL}/api/v1/**`, async (route) => {
    const request = route.request();
    const url = new URL(request.url());
    const path = url.pathname.replace('/api/v1', '');
    const method = request.method();
    if (method !== 'GET') return respond(route, {});
    const mockList = <T>(value: Mocked<T[]> | undefined, fallback: T[] = []) =>
      value === 'pending' || value === 'error' ? value : paginated(value ?? fallback);
    switch (path) {
      case '/users/me':
        return respond(route, user);
      case '/users':
        return respond(route, TEAM);
      case '/organizations/me':
        return respond(route, { id: ORG_ID, name: 'Acme Dental', slug: 'acme-dental', plan: 'free', is_active: true, settings: {} });
      case '/organizations':
        return respond(route, [{ id: ORG_ID, name: 'Acme Dental', slug: 'acme-dental', plan: 'free', is_active: true, created_at: '2026-01-05T09:00:00.000Z' }]);
      case '/billing/status':
        return respond(route, scenario.access ?? billingAccess());
      case '/billing/subscription':
        return respond(route, scenario.overview);
      case '/billing/plans':
        return respond(route, scenario.plans ?? PLANS);
      case '/billing/invoices':
        return respond(route, mockList(scenario.invoices));
      case '/platform/billing/demo/defaults':
        return respond(route, scenario.demoDefaults);
      case '/platform/billing/demo/organizations':
        return respond(route, mockList(scenario.demoOrganizations));
      case '/communications/templates/system':
        return respond(route, SYSTEM_TEMPLATES);
      case '/communications/templates/events':
        return respond(route, ORG_COMMUNICATION_EVENTS);
      case '/communications/templates/events/platform':
        return respond(route, PLATFORM_COMMUNICATION_EVENTS);
      case '/communications/deliveries':
        return respond(route, { items: [], meta: { total: 0, page: 1, limit: 20, totalPages: 0 } });
      case '/communications/templates':
        return respond(route, []);
      case '/conversations':
        return respond(route, paginated([]));
      case '/contacts': {
        const stageId = url.searchParams.get('stage_id');
        const all = scenario.funnel?.contacts ?? [];
        const items = stageId ? all.filter((c) => c.lead_stage === stageId) : all;
        const limit = Number(url.searchParams.get('limit') ?? 20);
        return respond(route, {
          items: items.slice(0, limit),
          meta: { total: items.length, page: 1, limit, total_pages: Math.ceil(items.length / limit), has_next: items.length > limit, has_prev: false },
        });
      }
      case '/funnels':
        return respond(route, scenario.funnel?.funnels ?? []);
      case '/funnels/templates':
        return respond(route, scenario.funnel?.templates ?? []);
      case '/funnels/stages':
        return respond(route, scenario.funnel?.stages ?? []);
      case '/ai-agents':
        return respond(route, []);
      case '/payments/services':
      case '/payments':
        return respond(route, []);
      case '/payments/settings':
        return respond(route, {
          currency: 'usd',
          is_connected: true,
          stripe_secret_key: '••••4242',
          stripe_webhook_secret: '••••a1b2',
          webhook_url: `https://api.acme.test/api/v1/webhooks/payments/stripe/${ORG_ID}`,
          updated_at: '2026-06-01T00:00:00.000Z',
        });
      default: {
        const funnelStages = path.match(/^\/funnels\/([^/]+)\/stages$/);
        if (funnelStages) {
          return respond(route, (scenario.funnel?.stages ?? []).filter((st) => st.funnel_id === funnelStages[1]));
        }
        unexpected.push(`${method} ${path}`);
        return respond(route, []);
      }
    }
  });
  // Supabase Realtime: keep the socket open but silent.
  await page.routeWebSocket(/\/realtime\/v1\/websocket/, () => undefined);
  return { unexpected };
}

import type { Route } from '@playwright/test';
import { ACTIVITY, APPOINTMENTS, CALLS, CONTACTS, CONTROL, LEADS, PAYMENTS, REACHABLE, STAGES, YOUR_TURN } from './inbox';

type Respond = (route: Route, value: unknown) => Promise<void>;

const page = <T>(items: T[]) => ({ items, meta: { total: items.length, page: 1, limit: 30, total_pages: 1, has_next: false, has_prev: false } });

/** Inbox endpoints. Returns false when the path is not an Inbox one. */
export async function inboxRoute(route: Route, method: string, path: string, url: URL, respond: Respond): Promise<boolean> {
  const contactSub = path.match(/^\/contacts\/([^/]+)\/([^/]+)$/);
  const contactOnly = path.match(/^\/contacts\/([^/]+)$/);

  if (method === 'POST' && contactSub?.[2] === 'handoff') {
    const control = CONTROL[contactSub[1]];
    const body = route.request().postDataJSON() as { bot_active: boolean };
    control.bot_active = body.bot_active;
    control.conversations = control.conversations.map((c) => ({ ...(c as object), bot_active: body.bot_active }));
    await respond(route, control);
    return true;
  }
  if (method !== 'GET') return false;

  if (path === '/conversations/leads') {
    const view = url.searchParams.get('view') ?? 'open';
    const items =
      view === 'needs_human' ? LEADS.filter((l) => !l.bot_active) : view === 'ai' ? LEADS.filter((l) => l.bot_active) : LEADS;
    await respond(route, page(items));
    return true;
  }
  if (path === '/contacts/stats') {
    await respond(route, { total: 3, new_this_month: 3, ai_handled: 2, human_handled: 1 });
    return true;
  }
  if (contactOnly && contactOnly[1] !== 'stats' && contactOnly[1] !== 'export') {
    await respond(route, CONTACTS[contactOnly[1]] ?? null);
    return true;
  }
  if (contactSub) {
    const [, id, sub] = contactSub;
    const values: Record<string, unknown> = {
      control: CONTROL[id],
      activity: { events: ACTIVITY[id] ?? [], next_cursor: null },
      'reachable-channels': REACHABLE[id] ?? [],
      messages: { total: 0, conversations: CONTROL[id]?.conversations ?? [] },
      appointments: APPOINTMENTS[id] ?? [],
      calls: { total: 0, calls: [] },
      'captured-data': { fields: (CONTACTS[id] as { custom_fields?: object } | undefined)?.custom_fields ?? {} },
    };
    if (sub in values) {
      await respond(route, values[sub]);
      return true;
    }
  }
  if (path === '/payments') {
    await respond(route, PAYMENTS[url.searchParams.get('contact_id') ?? ''] ?? []);
    return true;
  }
  if (path === '/automation/sequences') {
    await respond(route, { items: [], total: 0 });
    return true;
  }
  if (path.startsWith('/automation/follow-ups/contact/')) {
    const id = path.split('/').pop()!;
    await respond(route, url.searchParams.get('status') === 'awaiting_user' ? YOUR_TURN.filter((s) => s.contact_id === id) : []);
    return true;
  }
  if (path === '/automation/follow-ups') {
    await respond(route, { items: YOUR_TURN, total: YOUR_TURN.length });
    return true;
  }
  if (path === '/voice/calls') {
    const status = url.searchParams.get('status');
    const items = status ? CALLS.filter((c) => c.status === status) : CALLS;
    await respond(route, { items, meta: { total: items.length, limit: 30, offset: 0 } });
    return true;
  }
  if (path === '/voice/calls/stats') {
    await respond(route, { total: 2, active: 1, avg_duration_seconds: 184 });
    return true;
  }
  if (path.startsWith('/voice/calls/') && path.endsWith('/transcripts')) {
    await respond(route, []);
    return true;
  }
  if (path.startsWith('/voice/calls/')) {
    await respond(route, CALLS.find((c) => c.id === path.split('/').pop()) ?? null);
    return true;
  }
  if (path === '/calendars') {
    await respond(route, [
      { id: 'cal-1', name: 'Appointments', type: 'appointments', is_active: true, timezone: 'Europe/Madrid', work_days: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], start_time: '09:00', end_time: '18:00' },
      { id: 'cal-fu', name: 'Follow-up', type: 'follow_up', is_active: true, timezone: 'Europe/Madrid', work_days: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], start_time: '09:00', end_time: '18:00' },
    ]);
    return true;
  }
  if (path === '/funnels/stages') {
    await respond(route, STAGES);
    return true;
  }
  if (path === '/funnels') {
    await respond(route, [{ id: 'funnel-1', name: 'Sales', is_default: true }]);
    return true;
  }
  if (path === '/sequences/templates' || path === '/automation/sequences/templates') {
    await respond(route, []);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

import { expect, test, type Page, type TestInfo } from '@playwright/test';
import { openView, settle } from './support/view';
import { billingAccess } from '@/test/fixtures/billing';
import { CONTROL } from './support/inbox';
/**
 * The lead-centric Inbox: every lead, contact, pipeline card and call is
 * worked from one place. These tests drive the real built app against a mocked
 * API and attach screenshots for review (no pixel baselines).
 */
const AGENT = { user: { role: 'agent' as const, full_name: 'Andy Agent' }, access: billingAccess(), inbox: true };
async function shot(page: Page, info: TestInfo, name: string) {
  await info.attach(name, { body: await page.screenshot({ fullPage: false }), contentType: 'image/png' });
}
test.describe('lead-centric inbox', () => {
  test.afterEach(() => {
    // The mock keeps handoff state in memory; restore it between tests.
    CONTROL['c-ana'].bot_active = true;
    CONTROL['c-ana'].conversations = CONTROL['c-ana'].conversations.map((c) => ({ ...(c as object), bot_active: true }));
  });
  test('one row per lead, one thread for all channels, composer locked while the AI handles it', async ({ page }, info) => {
    const view = await openView(page, '/inbox?lead=c-ana', AGENT);
    const leads = page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Leads' });
    await expect(leads.getByRole('listitem')).toHaveCount(3);
    await expect(leads.getByText('Ana Pérez')).toBeVisible();
    // Thread: messages from WhatsApp and SMS, the call and the payment link, in one place.
    await expect(page.getByText('¿Tenéis hueco el martes por la mañana?').first()).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText(/link sent by the AI/)).toBeVisible();
    // The AI is in control: nobody can type until a person takes over.
    await expect(page.getByText(/The AI is handling this lead on every channel/)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Message' })).toHaveCount(0);
    // Lead panel: hot lead, qualification with labels, SMS opt-out, payment link only after taking over.
    const panel = page.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'Lead panel' });
    await expect(panel.getByText('Hot', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(panel.getByText('Service Needed')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(panel.getByTitle(/Opted out of SMS/)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Payment link' })).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(panel.getByText('Consulta de valoración').first()).toBeVisible();
    await shot(page, info, 'inbox-ai-handling');
    expect(view.errors).toEqual([]);
  });
  test('taking over unlocks the composer and replies on the channel the lead last wrote on', async ({ page }, info) => {
    await openView(page, '/inbox?lead=c-ana', AGENT);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Take over' }).first().click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Message' })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Replying on')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Return to AI' }).first()).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('complementary', { name: 'Lead panel' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Payment link' })).toBeEnabled();
    await shot(page, info, 'inbox-person-handling');
  });
  test('a lead on a call shows the live call, handled by Retell', async ({ page }, info) => {
    await openView(page, '/inbox?lead=c-luis', AGENT, { settle: false });
    await expect(page.getByText('Call in progress · handled by Retell AI')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText(/transcript and recording will appear here when the call ends/)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Leads' }).getByText('On a call')).toBeVisible();
    await shot(page, info, 'inbox-live-call');
  });
  test('views: your turn, calls, all contacts and pipeline live in the Inbox', async ({ page }, info) => {
    await openView(page, '/inbox?view=your_turn', AGENT);
    await expect(page.getByText('Llamar a Luis para confirmar presupuesto')).toBeVisible();
    await shot(page, info, 'inbox-your-turn');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Calls' }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Calls' }).getByText('Luis Gómez')).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Calls' }).getByText('Ana Pérez').click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toContainText('Transcript');
    await shot(page, info, 'inbox-call-drawer');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'All contacts' }).click();
    await expect(page.getByText(/3 contacts · 3 new this month · 2 created by AI · 1 created manually/)).toBeVisible();
    await shot(page, info, 'inbox-all-contacts');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pipeline' }).click();
    await settle(page);
    await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Qualified' })).toBeVisible();
    await shot(page, info, 'inbox-pipeline');
  });
  test('old contact, funnel and voice links open the same place', async ({ page }) => {
    await openView(page, '/inbox', AGENT);
    for (const [from, to] of [
      ['/contacts/c-ana', /\/inbox\?lead=c-ana/],
      ['/contacts', /\/inbox\?view=contacts/],
      ['/config/funnel', /\/inbox\?view=pipeline/],
      ['/voice', /\/inbox\?view=calls/],
      ['/voice/call-ana-1', /\/inbox\?view=calls&call=call-ana-1/],
    ] as const) {
      await page.goto(from);
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(to);
    }
  });
  test('an agent sees only what they may change', async ({ page }, info) => {
    await openView(page, '/inbox', AGENT);
    const nav = page.getByRole('complementary').first();
    await nav.getByRole('button', { name: 'Expand sidebar' }).click();
    await expect(nav.getByRole('link', { name: 'Payments' })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(nav.getByRole('button', { name: 'Admin' })).toHaveCount(0);
    await nav.getByRole('button', { name: 'Settings' }).click();
    await expect(nav.getByRole('link', { name: 'Follow-up sequences' })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(nav.getByRole('link', { name: 'Channels' })).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(nav.getByRole('link', { name: 'AI Agent' })).toHaveCount(0);
    await shot(page, info, 'agent-settings-nav');
  });
  test('a wrong URL shows the 404 inside the app', async ({ page }, info) => {
    await openView(page, '/this/does/not/exist', AGENT);
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: "This page doesn't exist" })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('complementary').first()).toBeVisible();
    await shot(page, info, 'not-found');
  });
});

Now the rest of P4: a peek drawer. On any page other than the Inbox, a contact name opens the lead panel in a side drawer (?lead= on that page) with "Open in Inbox". I'll mount it once in the dashboard layout.

bash
command:
cd /workspace/apps/web/src && sed -i "s/import { Compass, MessageSquare, Users } from 'lucide-react';/import { Compass, LayoutDashboard, MessageSquare } from 'lucide-react';/; s#<Users className=\"h-4 w-4\" /> Dashboard#<LayoutDashboard className=\"h-4 w-4\" /> Dashboard#" "app/(dashboard)/not-found.tsx" && grep -n "LayoutDashboard" "app/(dashboard)/not-found.tsx" && cat > components/lead/lead-peek-drawer.tsx <<'EOF'
'use client';

import { Suspense } from 'react';
import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { Drawer, DrawerContent } from '@/components/ui/drawer';
import { DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { CallDrawer } from '@/components/calls/call-drawer';
import { LeadPanel } from './lead-panel';

/**
 * Outside the Inbox, a contact name opens the lead right there (?lead=<id>)
 * instead of leaving the page — the same LeadPanel, plus "Open in Inbox".
 * In the Inbox itself `?lead=` selects the lead, so the drawer stays closed.
 */
function LeadPeekDrawerInner() {
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();
  const lead = pathname.startsWith('/inbox') ? null : params.get('lead');
  const call = pathname.startsWith('/inbox') ? null : params.get('call');

  const clear = (key: 'lead' | 'call') => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString());
    next.delete(key);
    const qs = next.toString();
    router.replace(qs ? `${pathname}?${qs}` : pathname, { scroll: false });
  };

  const openCall = (callId: string) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString());
    next.set('call', callId);
    router.replace(`${pathname}?${next.toString()}`, { scroll: false });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Drawer open={!!lead} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && clear('lead')}>
        <DrawerContent side="right" className="thin-scrollbar w-full max-w-[380px] overflow-y-auto p-0" aria-describedby={undefined}>
          <DialogTitle className="sr-only">Lead</DialogTitle>
          {lead && <LeadPanel contactId={lead} variant="drawer" onOpenCall={openCall} className="pt-6" />}
        </DrawerContent>
      </Drawer>
      <CallDrawer callId={call} onClose={() => clear('call')} />
    </>
  );
}

export function LeadPeekDrawer() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <LeadPeekDrawerInner />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
EOF

'use client';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { AlertCircle, ArrowRight, CalendarCheck, CreditCard, UserCheck, UserRound } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { useInboxLeads } from '@/hooks/useInbox';
import { useCompleteFollowUp, useFollowUps } from '@/hooks/useAutomation';
import { useCompleteAppointment, useMarkNoShow } from '@/hooks/useAppointments';
import { usePaymentsNeedingAttention } from '@/hooks/usePayments';
import { usePermissions } from '@/hooks/usePermissions';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/useToast';
import { cn, formatMoney, formatRelativeTime } from '@/lib/utils';
import { schedulingService } from '@/services/scheduling.service';
import { actionMeta } from '@/components/sequences/sequence-constants';
import { leadName } from '@/components/lead/lead-format';
const ROWS = 4;
function Card({
  title,
  icon: Icon,
  count,
  href,
  tone,
  loading,
  empty,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  icon: typeof AlertCircle;
  count: number | undefined;
  href: string;
  tone: 'warning' | 'danger' | 'accent';
  loading: boolean;
  empty: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const toneClass = tone === 'danger' ? 'bg-danger/10 text-danger' : tone === 'warning' ? 'bg-warning/10 text-warning' : 'bg-olive-dark text-accent';
  return (
    <section className="panel-card flex min-h-44 flex-col p-4" aria-label={title}>
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className={cn('flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg', toneClass)}>
          <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        </span>
        <h2 className="flex-1 text-sm font-semibold text-primary">{title}</h2>
        {!!count && <span className={cn('rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold', toneClass)}>{count}</span>}
        <Link href={href} className="text-muted hover:text-accent" aria-label={`Open ${title}`}>
          <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
        </Link>
      </div>
      {loading ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Skeleton className="h-8 w-full" />
          <Skeleton className="h-8 w-full" />
        </div>
      ) : count ? (
        <ul className="space-y-1.5">{children}</ul>
      ) : (
        <p className="mt-auto pb-2 text-xs text-muted">{empty}</p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
function Row({ href, title, subtitle, action }: { href: string; title: string; subtitle: string; action?: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <li className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-row border border-subtle bg-surface-raised px-2.5 py-1.5">
      <Link href={href} className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p className="truncate text-xs font-medium text-primary hover:text-accent">{title}</p>
        <p className="truncate text-[11px] text-muted">{subtitle}</p>
      </Link>
      {action}
    </li>
  );
}
/**
 * Everything waiting for a person today, in one place: leads handed over to a
 * human, follow-ups that are their turn, appointments without an outcome and
 * paid bookings that need attention.
 */
export function TodayQueue() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { canResolvePaymentAttention } = usePermissions();
  const needsHuman = useInboxLeads({ view: 'needs_human', limit: ROWS });
  const yourTurn = useFollowUps({ status: 'awaiting_user', sort: 'asc', limit: ROWS });
  const needsOutcome = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['appointments', 'needs-outcome', ROWS],
    queryFn: () => schedulingService.getAppointments({ needs_outcome: true, sort: 'asc', limit: ROWS }),
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
  const attention = usePaymentsNeedingAttention(canResolvePaymentAttention);
  const completeStep = useCompleteFollowUp();
  const completeAppointment = useCompleteAppointment();
  const noShow = useMarkNoShow();
  const run = async (action: () => Promise<unknown>, success: string) => {
    try {
      await action();
      toast({ title: success });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['appointments'] });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['follow-ups'] });
    } catch (err) {
      toast({ title: (err as Error).message || 'Action failed', variant: 'error' });
    }
  };
  const small = 'h-7 shrink-0 px-2 text-[11px]';
  return (
    <div className={cn('grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2', canResolvePaymentAttention ? 'xl:grid-cols-4' : 'xl:grid-cols-3')} aria-label="Today">
      <Card
        title="Needs human"
        icon={UserRound}
        tone="warning"
        href="/inbox?view=needs_human"
        count={needsHuman.data?.meta.total}
        loading={needsHuman.isLoading}
        empty="No lead is waiting for a person."
      >
        {needsHuman.data?.items.map((lead) => (
          <Row
            key={lead.contact.id}
            href={`/inbox?view=needs_human&lead=${lead.contact.id}`}
            title={leadName(lead.contact)}
            subtitle={lead.last_message ? lead.last_message.content : 'No messages yet'}
          />
        ))}
      </Card>
      <Card
        title="Your turn"
        icon={UserCheck}
        tone="warning"
        href="/inbox?view=your_turn"
        count={yourTurn.data?.total}
        loading={yourTurn.isLoading}
        empty="No follow-up is waiting for you."
      >
        {yourTurn.data?.items.map((step) => (
          <Row
            key={step.id}
            href={`/inbox?view=your_turn&lead=${step.contact_id}`}
            title={`${leadName(step.contact)} · ${step.title || actionMeta(step.action).label}`}
            subtitle={`Due ${formatRelativeTime(step.due_at)} ago`}
            action={
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className={small} onClick={() => run(() => completeStep.mutateAsync(step.id), 'Follow-up marked as done')}>
                Done
              </Button>
            }
          />
        ))}
      </Card>
      <Card
        title="Needs outcome"
        icon={CalendarCheck}
        tone="accent"
        href="/schedule"
        count={needsOutcome.data?.total}
        loading={needsOutcome.isLoading}
        empty="Every past appointment has an outcome."
      >
        {needsOutcome.data?.items.map((appt) => (
          <Row
            key={appt.id}
            href={`/schedule?appointment=${appt.id}`}
            title={`${leadName(appt.contact)} · ${appt.title}`}
            subtitle={new Date(appt.starts_at).toLocaleString()}
            action={
              <span className="flex gap-1">
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className={small} onClick={() => run(() => completeAppointment.mutateAsync(appt.id), 'Marked as completed')}>
                  Done
                </Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className={small} onClick={() => run(() => noShow.mutateAsync(appt.id), 'Marked as no-show')}>
                  No-show
                </Button>
              </span>
            }
          />
        ))}
      </Card>
      {canResolvePaymentAttention && (
        <Card
          title="Payments attention"
          icon={CreditCard}
          tone="danger"
          href="/payments?tab=attention"
          count={attention.data?.length}

import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { mockApi } from '@/test/msw/api';
import { createQueryWrapper } from '@/test/query';
import type { LeadConversation } from '@/services/inbox.service';
import { Composer } from './composer';

const { toast } = vi.hoisted(() => ({ toast: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock('@/hooks/useToast', () => ({ toast }));
vi.mock('@/providers/realtime-provider', () => ({
  useRealtime: () => ({ client: { acquire: () => ({ on: () => ({}) }), release: vi.fn(), broadcast: vi.fn() }, activeCalls: new Map() }),
}));
vi.mock('@/hooks/useAuth', () => ({ useAuth: () => ({ user: null }) }));

const wa: LeadConversation = {
  id: 'conv-wa',
  contact_id: 'c1',
  channel: 'whatsapp',
  status: 'open',
  bot_active: false,
  last_message_at: '2026-03-15T10:00:00Z',
};

function renderComposer(state: Parameters<typeof Composer>[0]['state']) {
  const { wrapper } = createQueryWrapper();
  render(<Composer contactId="c1" state={state} />, { wrapper });
  return userEvent.setup();
}

beforeEach(() => toast.mockReset());

describe('Composer', () => {
  it('is locked while the AI handles the lead, and taking over asks the API for the whole lead', async () => {
    const handoff = mockApi('post', '/contacts/c1/handoff', { data: { contact_id: 'c1', bot_active: false, conversations: [wa] } });
    const user = renderComposer({ kind: 'ai_control', target: { ...wa, bot_active: true } });

    expect(screen.queryByRole('textbox', { name: 'Message' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/The AI is handling this lead on every channel/)).toBeInTheDocument();

    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Take over' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(handoff).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(handoff[0].body).toEqual({ bot_active: false });
  });

  it('replies on the lead’s channel once a person handles it — there is no channel picker', async () => {
    const sent = mockApi('post', '/conversations/conv-wa/messages', { data: { id: 'm1' } });
    const user = renderComposer({ kind: 'ready', target: wa });

    expect(screen.getByText('Replying on')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Reply via:')).not.toBeInTheDocument();

    await user.type(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Message' }), 'Te ayudo yo{Enter}');
    await waitFor(() => expect(sent).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(sent[0].body).toEqual({ content: 'Te ayudo yo' });
  });

  it('explains a refusal from the API (e.g. the AI took the lead back)', async () => {
    mockApi('post', '/conversations/conv-wa/messages', { status: 409, message: 'x', errors: { code: 'AI_HAS_CONTROL' } });
    const user = renderComposer({ kind: 'ready', target: wa });
    await user.type(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Message' }), 'hola{Enter}');
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(toast).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ title: 'The AI is handling this lead. Take over to reply.', variant: 'error' }),
    );
  });

  it('does not let anyone write on a channel the contact opted out of', () => {
    renderComposer({ kind: 'opted_out', target: wa });
    expect(screen.getByText(/The contact opted out of WhatsApp/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('textbox', { name: 'Message' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('offers a call instead of text on voice', () => {
    renderComposer({ kind: 'no_text', target: { ...wa, channel: 'voice' } });
    expect(screen.getByText(/Voice conversations can't receive text/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('starts WhatsApp or SMS when the lead has no open conversation', async () => {
    mockApi('get', '/contacts/c1/reachable-channels', {
      data: [
        { channel: 'whatsapp', reachable: true, conversation_id: null },
        { channel: 'sms', reachable: false, reason: 'opted_out', conversation_id: null },
      ],
    });
    const started = mockApi('post', '/contacts/c1/conversations', { data: wa });
    const user = renderComposer({ kind: 'no_conversation' });

    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Start on WhatsApp' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(started).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(started[0].body).toEqual({ channel: 'whatsapp' });
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Start on SMS' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { billingOverview, paidAccess, PRO_PLAN } from '@/test/fixtures/billing';
import type { Scenario } from './support/api-mock';
import { fitViewportToContent, openView } from './support/view';
/**
 * Screens that existed before the billing work and must look exactly as they
 * did: their baselines were captured from the original code (commit
 * 752ff16) and are compared pixel for pixel. Only intended changes are
 * masked, and each one is asserted separately.
 */
const PAID_IN_GOOD_STANDING: Omit<Scenario, 'user'> = {
  access: paidAccess(),
  overview: billingOverview({
    plan: PRO_PLAN,
    live: true,
    sub: {
      payment_method: { type: 'card', brand: 'visa', last4: '4242', exp_month: 12, exp_year: 2030, is_expired: false },
    },
  }),
};

import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { auditDesign, loadTemplatePalette, type AuditResult } from './support/design-audit';
import { NO_FUNNELS, SALES_FUNNEL } from './support/funnel';
import { fitViewportToContent, openView, VIEW_SCOPE, type OpenedView } from './support/view';
/**
 * Funnel page (Board / List / Configure). Every state must follow the design
 * system (palette, components, icons, fonts, language, accessible names, no
 * overflow) and match its screenshot. Stage colors in the fixture are the
 * legacy hex values real funnels still store, so this also covers their
 * on-palette rendering.
 */
const palette = loadTemplatePalette();
const CLEAN: AuditResult = {
  offPaletteColors: [],
  nativeControls: [],
  titleAttributes: [],
  nonLucideIcons: [],
  unlabeledControls: [],
  foreignFonts: [],
  spanishText: [],
  horizontalOverflow: [],
};
const OWNER = { role: 'owner' } as const;
async function expectView(page: Page, view: OpenedView, screenshot: string, options: { fit?: boolean } = {}) {
  if (options.fit !== false) await fitViewportToContent(page);
  expect(await auditDesign(page, { palette, scope: VIEW_SCOPE }), 'design system rules').toEqual(CLEAN);
  expect(view.errors, 'runtime errors').toEqual([]);
  expect(view.unexpectedRequests, 'unmocked API calls').toEqual([]);
  await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot(screenshot);
}
test.describe('Funnel page', () => {
  test('board', async ({ page }) => {
    const view = await openView(page, '/config/funnel', { user: OWNER, funnel: SALES_FUNNEL });
    await expect(page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Board', selected: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'New Lead' })).toContainText('Maria Gomez');
    await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Qualified' })).toContainText('HOT');
    await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Qualified' })).toContainText('Active 5m ago');
    await expectView(page, view, 'funnel-board.png');
  });
  test('list: contacts grouped by stage', async ({ page }) => {
    const view = await openView(page, '/config/funnel', { user: OWNER, funnel: SALES_FUNNEL });
    await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'List' }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /New Lead.*2 contacts/ })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /Appointment Confirmed.*0 contacts/ })).toBeVisible();
